We introduce Refiner-Bench, a video refinement benchmark constructed from the outputs of different video generators, and use a shared-input protocol to compare refiners at approximately 2K output resolution. At 2K, the one-step SoL-Refiner outperforms all external refiners on the VBench and UniPercept averages, while at $3840\!\times\!2176$ it improves both metrics over the three-step LTX-2.3 Refiner. With the complete acceleration stack, SoL-Refiner achieves an $8.91\times$ speedup in refinement latency over the same baseline in our 2K latency setting.

</details>


### [210] [ORMA: Optimization-based Monocular 4D Reconstruction of Articulated Animals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37986)
*Xuyi Hu,Francesco Palandra,Shangzhe Wu,Daniel Cremers,Riccardo Marin,Silvia Zuffi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ORMA 是一个无需训练的 4D 动物重建框架，将关节运动与形状解耦，利用生成式 3D 先验和 SMAL+ 模型恢复准确的几何与全局一致的动物运动，并提出了合成多物种基准 PAW4D。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从单目视频恢复动物的关节化 4D 表示面临挑战：四足动物形态多样性大、缺乏动物 4D 监督数据。现有基于学习的方法针对单张图像、依赖合成或模型拟合的 3D 监督，继承了强参数化先验的限制，对分布外物种泛化性差；对分布外动物往往只能恢复合理姿态却产生不准确的几何，因为底层形状模型无法忠实表达观测实例。

Method: 提出 ORMA，一个无需训练的重建框架，将关节运动与形状解耦：以预测姿态作为优化参考，同时利用生成式 3D 先验实现准确形状重建。给定参考图像，重建动物几何并将其配准到参数化模型 SMAL+，得到适配观测实例的关节化形状；随后将逐帧关节姿态估计与全局一致的相机姿态结合，在共享世界坐标系中恢复动物运动，并利用自监督 DINO 对应关系和时序一致性进一步细化重建。此外构建 PAW4D 合成多物种基准，提供真值 3D 几何与相机运动。

Result: 在 PAW4D、PFERD 以及具有挑战性的野外视频上，ORMA 提升了重建精度，并在多种四足物种上恢复了全局一致的动物运动。

Conclusion: ORMA 通过解耦关节运动与形状、结合生成式 3D 先验与参数化配准，实现了无需训练、跨物种泛化的 4D 动物重建，并配合新基准 PAW4D 支持定量评估。

Abstract: Recovering articulated 4D representations of animals from monocular videos remains challenging due to the large diversity of quadruped morphologies and lack of animal 4D supervision data. Existing learning-based reconstruction methods operate on individual images and rely on synthetic or model-fitted 3D supervision, which inherits the constraints of strong parametric priors and limits generalization to out-of-distribution species. When applied to out-of-distribution animals, they often recover a plausible pose while producing inaccurate geometry because the underlying shape model cannot faithfully represent the observed instance. We present ORMA, a training-free reconstruction framework that decouples articulation from shape, using the predicted pose as reference for optimization while leveraging generative 3D priors for accurate shape reconstruction. Given a reference image, we reconstruct the animal geometry and register it to the parametric model SMAL+, yielding an articulated shape adapted to the observed instance. We then combine per-frame articulated pose estimates with globally consistent camera poses to recover animal motion in a shared world coordinate frame, and further refine the reconstruction using self-supervised DINO correspondences and temporal consistency. To enable quantitative evaluation, we introduce PAW4D, a synthetic multi-species benchmark with ground-truth 3D geometry and camera motion. Experiments on PAW4D, PFERD, and challenging in-the-wild videos demonstrate that ORMA improves reconstruction accuracy while recovering globally consistend animal motion across diverse quadruped species.

</details>


### [211] [HybridCUA: Learning to Orchestrate GUI and CLI for Computer-Use Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38008)
*Tongbo Chen,Junbo Niu,Zhengxi Lu,Niu Lian,Fei Tang,Yuchen Yan,Yike Hong,Yong Du,Yizhou Liu,Bofan Chen,Yongliang Shen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出混合GUI与CLI的计算机使用代理范式HybridCUA，通过数据构建与两阶段训练框架，在OSWorld上取得53.6%准确率（较基座模型提升14.8个百分点）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有计算机使用代理（CUAs）存在两种局限：仅依赖GUI交互的方式效率低、易出错；而结合应用专用API或工具的方式则需要大量工程投入，难以跨应用扩展。因此作者主张下一代CUA应结合GUI的通用性与命令行界面（CLI）的高效性。核心挑战在于当前模型不知道在任务执行中何时以及如何使用CLI。

Method: 作者开发了数据构建流水线，生成三类轨迹：仅GUI、仅CLI、以及GUI与CLI交错轨迹，由此构建HybridCUA-8K数据集（含5K混合轨迹和3K经验证的RLVR任务）。在此基础上提出两阶段训练框架：先在构建的轨迹上进行监督微调，随后使用CLI感知奖励进行强化学习，鼓励代理有选择且可靠地使用CLI。

Result: HybridCUA-9B在OSWorld上达到53.6%准确率，较基座模型提升14.8个百分点；在WindowsAgentArena上性能提升4.0个百分点。

Conclusion: 实验结果证明了混合GUI与CLI范式在计算机使用代理中的有效性及跨平台泛化能力。

Abstract: Computer use agents (CUAs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in completing digital tasks. However, existing CUAs either rely solely on graphical user interface (GUI) interactions, which are often inefficient and error prone, or augment GUI interactions with application specific APIs or tools, which require substantial engineering effort and are difficult to scale across applications. We argue that the next generation of CUAs should combine GUI interactions with the command line interface (CLI), leveraging the generality of the GUI and the efficiency of shell commands. A critical challenge, however, is that current models do not know when or how to use the CLI during task execution. To address this challenge, we develop a data construction pipeline that produces three types of trajectories: GUI only, CLI only, and interleaved GUI and CLI trajectories. This pipeline results in HybridCUA-8K, containing 5K hybrid trajectories and 3K verified RLVR tasks. Building on these data, we propose a training framework with two stages: supervised fine tuning on the constructed trajectories, followed by reinforcement learning with our CLI aware rewards that encourages agents to use the CLI selectively and reliably. Experiments show that HybridCUA-9B achieves 53.6% accuracy on OSWorld, improving over the base model by 14.8 percentage points, and improves performance on WindowsAgentArena by 4.0 percentage points. These results demonstrate the effectiveness and cross platform generalizability of the hybrid GUI and CLI paradigm for computer use agents.

</details>


### [212] [From Unity Simulation to Diffusion-Based Augmentation: Quantifying Dataset Balance for Robust Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38010)
*Mohamed Benkedadra,Aissa Saoudi,Maxime Gloesener,Sidi Ahmed Mahmoudi,Matei Mancas*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 在真实数据稀缺的施工安全监测场景下，系统比较Unity仿真渲染与可控扩散生成（CIA）两种数据生成范式，通过统一框架的受控数据混合实验发现：单一合成数据无法最优迁移，混合策略显著提升检测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 关键领域（如施工安全监测）的标注数据采集成本高、风险大、受伦理约束，而现代视觉模型依赖大规模标注数据。因此需研究在真实数据稀缺条件下，如何利用合成与生成数据补充训练。

Method: 提出统一实验框架，支持在真实、仿真（Unity渲染）与生成（可控扩散CIA）三类来源间进行受控的数据集混合，并保持模型与训练设置完全一致；采用Precision、Recall、mAP及自定义Δ指标进行定量评估。

Result: 仅Unity训练时mAP@0.5相对真实数据下降约50%，仅CIA训练下降约16.5%；混合策略明显改善性能，90%真实+10% Unity取得最佳mAP@0.5为62.68%（较基线+7.64%），90%真实+10% CIA取得最高精确率74.45%。

Conclusion: 少量引入合成数据可增强泛化能力，但过量替换会引发域漂移；仿真与生成两种范式互补，合理混合优于任何单一来源。

Abstract: Modern computer vision models achieve high accuracy when trained on large-scale annotated datasets. In critical domains such as construction safety monitoring, data collection is costly, hazardous, and ethically constrained. This paper presents a systematic study comparing two complementary data generation paradigms, (1) Unity Simulation-based rendering and (2) Controllable Diffusion-based generation (CIA), for object detection under real data-scarce conditions. A unified experimental framework enables controlled dataset mixing across real, simulated, and generative sources, while maintaining identical model and training settings. Quantitative evaluation using Precision, Recall, mAP, and custom $Δ$-metrics, reveals that neither simulation nor generative augmentation alone achieves optimal transferability. Unity-only training yields an mAP@0.5 drop of $-50\%$ relative to real data, while CIA-only training shows a milder $-16.5\%$ degradation. Hybrid compositions significantly improve performance, with the 90\% real + 10\% Unity configuration achieving the best overall mAP@0.5 of $62.68\%$ ($+7.64\%$ over baseline), and the 90\% real + 10\% CIA configuration maximizing precision at $74.45\%$. Results demonstrate that limited synthetic inclusion enhances generalization, while excessive substitution induces domain drift.

</details>


### [213] [Beyond Lip Sync: Reference-Grounded Oral Refinement for Audio-Driven Portrait Animation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38019)
*Bangxun Tang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RGOR是一个音频驱动唇形同步框架，通过引入同一说话人独立录制帧与高清嘴部patch作为条件，并用配对判别器训练，使生成的嘴部忠实反映被配音者本人的唇齿形态，而非通用平均嘴型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有唇形同步系统虽能贴合音频并保持面部可辨识，但生成的嘴部是"平均嘴"：唇形、唇部纹理、牙齿排列及张口露齿程度均非该人所有。根因在于训练与评测均不要求还原本人嘴部：感知损失接受任意合理嘴型，面部身份主要由嘴周皮肤承载，且inpainting系统推理代码用未遮挡的目标帧作参考，掩盖了这一缺陷。

Method: RGOR对每一生成帧施加两类条件：(1)同一说话人另一次独立录制（enrollment）的帧；(2)绕过VAE的高清嘴部patch。同时训练生成器对抗一个配对判别器（paired judge），该判别器将渲染嘴部与本人参考对比，并学习拒绝"他人的真实嘴部"。此外构建了相应评测协议。

Result: 在留出身份（held-out identities）上对比开源与商业唇形同步系统，RGOR在多数指标上取得最优或次优结果，在保持同步性和其余面部完整的同时，保留了说话人自身的唇部与牙齿细节。

Conclusion: 通过将参考帧条件、高清嘴部patch旁路VAE以及配对判别器相结合，RGOR解决了唇形同步中"平均嘴"问题，实现身份相关的嘴部细节保真，并提供了相应的评测范式。

Abstract: We present RGOR (Reference-Grounded Oral Refinement), an audio-driven lip-sync framework that renders the mouth of the specific person being dubbed rather than a generic one. Existing lip-sync systems follow the audio closely and keep the face recognizable, yet the mouth they render is an average mouth: the shape and texture of the lips, the arrangement of the teeth, and how much of them shows as the mouth opens are not that person's. The problem persists because nothing in current training or evaluation asks for the person's own mouth: perceptual losses accept any plausible mouth, face identity is carried mostly by the skin around it, and the released inference code of inpainting systems uses the unmasked target frame as the reference, which hides the gap. To address this, RGOR conditions every generated frame on frames from separate enrollment recordings of the same person and on HD patches of the mouth that bypass the VAE, and trains the generator against a paired judge that compares each rendered mouth with the person's reference and learns to reject a realistic mouth of someone else. We further build an evaluation protocol and use it to compare open-source and commercial lip-sync systems on held-out identities. Experiments show that RGOR achieves the best or second-best result on most metrics, and preserves the person's own lip and dental detail while keeping synchronization and the rest of the face intact.

</details>


### [214] [EVO-WAM: Evolving World Action Models through Video-Action Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38057)
*Shiyang Zhou,Xionghao Wu,Wenbo Li,Shenghe Zheng,Jiyao Zhang,Songsong Yu,Yijun Yang,Jianhui Liu,Haoze Sun,Senqiao Yang,Li Jiang,Jingyong Su,Haoyang Huang,Zhuotao Tian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EVO-WAM 让世界动作模型通过自生成视频-动作轨迹进行自举式适配，无需额外专家演示或外部环境执行，在 RoboTwin 2.0 与真实长程任务上大幅提升成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人策略在新任务上的适配通常依赖额外专家演示，成本高。世界动作模型（WAMs）借助大规模视频先验可同时预测未来视频与动作，理论上能提供新任务的监督信号。但存在两个障碍：生成的视频可能未真正完成任务；即使视频看似成功，其对应动作也可能不一致，导致实际执行失败。

Method: 提出 EVO-WAM 框架：1）在 WAM 训练中引入状态预测与锚定多帧上下文，实现完整的自回归 rollout，无需外部执行反馈；2）用视觉语言模型筛选"完成任务"的前缀，并用逆动力学模型校验视频-动作一致性，从而识别可靠训练经验；3）在验证过的前缀上迭代训练 WAM，并用更新后的模型生成新 rollout，形成自举循环。

Result: 在 7 个未见过的 RoboTwin 2.0 任务上，平均成功率 Cosmos3 从 26.9% 提升至 68.0%（约 2.5×），DreamZero 从 28.5% 提升至 46.4%（约 1.6×）。在真实世界 3 个未见的长期组合任务上，Cosmos3 平均成功率从 20.0% 提升至 76.7%，提升 56.7 个百分点。

Conclusion: EVO-WAM 证明 WAM 可利用自身生成的、经筛选与一致性校验的视频-动作轨迹实现对新任务的自举式适配，在仿真与真实长程任务上均取得显著提升，为无需额外专家演示的机器人策略适配提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Improving robot policies on new tasks without collecting additional expert demonstrations remains a central challenge in robot learning. World action models (WAMs) use broad video priors to jointly predict future videos and actions, offering a potential source of supervision for adapting to new tasks. However, generated videos may fail to depict task completion, and even visually successful videos may be paired with inconsistent actions that lead to execution failure. We propose EVO-WAM, a framework that adapts WAMs to unseen tasks by learning from their own generated video-action trajectories, without executing candidate actions in an external environment. First, we augment WAM training with state prediction and anchored multi-frame context to enable complete autoregressive rollouts without external execution feedback. Second, we identify reliable training experience by selecting task-completing prefixes with a vision-language model and verifying their video-action consistency with an inverse dynamics model. Third, we iteratively train the WAM on verified prefixes and generate new rollouts with the updated model. On seven unseen RoboTwin 2.0 tasks, EVO-WAM increases average success rates from 26.9% to 68.0% for Cosmos3 and from 28.5% to 46.4% for DreamZero, reaching approximately $2.5\times$ and $1.6\times$ their initial success rates. On three unseen long-horizon composite tasks in the real world, it improves Cosmos3's average success rate from 20.0% to 76.7%, a gain of 56.7 percentage points. Project Page: https://evo-wam.github.io/.

</details>


<div id='cs.CL'></div>

# cs.CL [[Back]](#toc)

### [215] [FD-VAD: Semantic Endpoint Detection for Streaming Full-Duplex Speech](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35791)
*Puneet Mathur,Dinesh Manocha*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出FD-VAD，一种无需ASR的流式语义端点检测方法，将语义端点判定建模为因果音频-语言推理任务，直接把有界因果音频窗口映射为Continue/Stop决策，在多项评测中优于强基线并取得TurnBench最佳EOT召回。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全双工语音交互中的自然轮次切换，需要从部分语音判断停顿是犹豫还是完整对话意图。声学VAD缺乏语义信息，级联ASR端点检测则依赖转录并引入额外处理阶段，因此需要一种直接从流式音频进行语义端点判断的方法。

Method: 将语义端点检测形式化为因果音频-语言推理任务，提出FD-VAD：一个无需ASR的流式端点检测器，直接将有界因果音频窗口映射为Continue/Stop决策。模型结合冻结语音编码器、轻量模态适配器和参数高效适配的语言模型，采用last-chunk训练目标支持流式推理；并引入置信度门控端点提交以控制打断与延迟的权衡，以及边界聚焦难负样本采样以改善模糊轮次边界处的判断。

Result: 在域内与对话评测中，FD-VAD优于强流式与非流式语义轮次分类器；在零样本设定下，于TurnBench dev集取得合格系统中最高EOT召回0.853（FP<=0.10）。

Conclusion: 结果表明，语义端点检测可以直接基于流式音频完成，无需中间ASR或对话状态跟踪。

Abstract: Natural turn-taking in full-duplex voice interaction requires determining from partial speech whether a pause reflects hesitation or a completed conversational intent. Acoustic voice activity detection lacks this semantic information, while cascaded ASR-based endpointing introduces transcription dependence and additional processing stages. We formulate semantic endpoint detection as a causal audio-language reasoning task and introduce FD-VAD, an ASR-free streaming endpointer that maps bounded causal audio windows directly to Continue/Stop decisions. FD-VAD combines a frozen speech encoder with a lightweight modality adapter and a parameter-efficiently adapted language model, using a last-chunk training objective for streaming inference. We further introduce confidence-gated endpoint commitment to control interruption versus delay and boundary-focused hard-negative sampling to improve decisions around ambiguous turn boundaries. Across in-domain and conversational evaluations, FD-VAD outperforms strong streaming and non-streaming semantic turn classifiers, and achieves the highest EOT recall among qualifying systems on TurnBench dev set $0.853$ (at FP<=0.10) in a zero-shot setting. These results show that semantic endpointing can be performed directly from streaming audio without intermediate ASR or dialogue state tracking.

</details>


### [216] [Sieve and Sage: Efficient Distraction Filtering for Reliable RALM Abstention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35794)
*Jongbin Won,Sung Geun An,Jay-yoon Lee*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出Sieve-Sage两阶段框架，将检索失败分解为"不可回答"与"干扰"两种状态，轻量模块先过滤干扰证据，再由LLM完成生成与弃答，在提升准确率与Macro-F1的同时实现加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RALM弃答方法多依赖单体LLM一步处理异构检索失败，导致弃答性能受限且计算开销高。作者认为需要区分检索失败的不同类型，以实现更可靠且高效的弃答。

Method: 将检索失败分解为两类状态：不可回答状态（所需证据缺失）与干扰状态（相关证据中混入冲突、否定或对抗性信息）。据此设计轻量筛选模块Sieve，在调用昂贵LLM（Sage）前先检测检索文档集中的干扰证据，由Sage负责有依据的生成与弃答。

Result: 在通用与高风险专家领域评测中，框架能前瞻性检测干扰噪声，相较单阶段基线准确率最高提升69.4个百分点，Macro-F1最高提升55.2个百分点，并实现最高1.99倍加速。

Conclusion: 该工作表明，通过显式分解检索失败状态并采用轻量筛选加LLM的两阶段流水线，可同时提升RALM弃答的可靠性与效率，为RAG系统中的弃答提供高效可行的方案。

Abstract: Just as Socrates recognized the limits of his own knowledge, Retrieval-Augmented Language Models (RALMs) should learn to abstain when the retrieved evidence cannot support a reliable response. Existing approaches largely rely on monolithic LLMs to handle heterogeneous retrieval failures in a single step, resulting in limited abstention performance and high computational costs. We instead decompose retrieval failures into two distinct states: (i) the unanswerable state, where the required evidence is absent, and (ii) the distracted state, where relevant evidence is mixed with conflicting, negated, or adversarial information. Based on this decomposition, we introduce a lightweight module (Sieve) that screens retrieved document sets for distracting evidence before invoking a costly LLM (Sage) for grounded generation and abstention. Evaluated across both general and high-stakes expert domains, our Sieve and Sage framework preemptively detects distracting noise, improving system accuracy by up to 69.4 percentage points and Macro-F1 by 55.2 percentage points compared to one-stage baselines. Furthermore, it achieves up to a 1.99x speedup, establishing a highly efficient and reliable abstention pipeline for RALM with abstention.

</details>


### [217] [Developing an OCR model for Extracting Information from Invoices with Korean Language](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35796)
*Xiem HoangVan,Phu TranQuang,Minh DinhBao,Tien VuHuu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出一种结合深度学习模型与图像预处理技术的韩语发票OCR模型，实现关键信息自动抽取，在收集的发票数据集上达到87% F1-score且处理时间极短。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 发票包含购买物品、时间、金额等关键商业信息，自动抽取意义重大；而韩语作为约8000万人的母语，在韩国及越南、菲律宾等设有大量韩企的国家广泛使用，因此亟需针对韩语发票的高效信息抽取方案。

Method: 构建一种高效的OCR模型，将深度学习模型与若干图像预处理技术相结合，用于自动抽取韩语发票中的关键信息。

Result: 在大量收集的发票数据集上评估，模型取得87%的F1-score，且处理时间可忽略不计。

Conclusion: 所提OCR模型能够高效准确地从韩语发票中抽取信息，验证了深度学习与图像预处理结合方案的有效性与实用性。

Abstract: Invoices are commercial documents that contain various pieces of information, including the purchased items, time, and total money. Making the extraction of important information crucial. The stored information serves different purposes. Korean language is the native language of about 80 million people, playing an important role in not only South and North Korea but also in many other countries such as Vietnam, Philippine where a large number of Korean companies are located. In this context, to automatically extract proper information from the invoices with Korean language, we propose an efficient Optical Character Recognition (OCR) model in which a deep learning model is combined with some image preprocessing techniques. The proposed OCR model is assessed in a rich set of collected invoices showing that 87% F1-score can be achieved with negligible time processing.

</details>


### [218] [Evaluating the Effects of Prompt Perturbation on Bias and Hallucination in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35804)
*Mamehgol Yousefi,Ahmad Shahi,Mos Sharifi,Alvaro Romera,Simon Hoermann,Tham Piumsomboon*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 评估LLM在决策任务中对原始查询扰动变体的鲁棒性，发现扰动在某些模型中可缓解偏见与幻觉，且不同模型表现差异显著（如Claude 3总体更优，GPT-3.5表现不稳）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM日益作为智能助手参与决策，但其可靠性令人担忧，尤其存在偏见和幻觉问题，因此需要评估其在决策任务中的鲁棒性。

Method: 对决策任务中原始查询进行扰动，评估多个LLM在面对这些扰动变体时的鲁棒性，并比较不同模型（如Claude 3与GPT-3.5）的表现。

Result: 与以往研究相反，扰动在某些LLM中可缓解偏见和幻觉；Claude 3在多数数据集的任务上更有效，GPT-3.5表现参差不齐。

Conclusion: 研究强调部署LLM决策支持工具时需严格测试与验证以确保可靠性，并为开发更稳健、可信的AI助手提供了启示。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown remarkable capabilities in various natural language processing tasks, leading to their widespread deployment as intelligent assistants in decision-making contexts. However, the increasing complexity of these models raises concerns about their reliability, particularly regarding bias and hallucination. In this work, we evaluate the robustness of LLMs to perturbed variations of the original inquiry in decision-making tasks. We show that contrary to previous studies, perturbations can mitigate bias and hallucination in some LLMs over other models. It's found that Claude 3 is more effective for the tasks represented in most datasets, whereas models like GPT3.5 exhibit varying levels of adequacy, performing comparably in some cases but falling significantly behind in others. These insights are crucial for understanding the practical implications of deploying LLM-based assistants as effective decision-support tools in real-world applications, emphasising the need for rigorous testing and validation to ensure reliability and effectiveness. This study contributes to the growing body of research on LLM evaluation and provides insights for developing more robust and trustworthy AI assistants in critical decision-making contexts.

</details>


### [219] [Alignment Forecasting: Predicting Misalignment From Training Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35805)
*Chen Yueh-Han,Bruce W. Lee,Ilia Sucholutsky,Tomek Korbak*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出"对齐预测"(Alignment Forecasting)任务及ALIGNMENTFORECASTBENCH基准,用带脚手架的方法在微调前预测对齐失效,效果优于随机、微调模型及简单预测器,并能筛选有害训练样本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 含有狭隘缺陷的训练数据有时会导致模型出现广泛的对齐失调,仅凭表面审查难以判断是否会涌现,目前只能通过训练后的模型审计来发现。为补充事后审计,需要一种在训练前预测对齐失效的能力。

Method: 提出Alignment Forecasting任务:给定目标模型、微调数据集与失效模式(如欺骗、谄媚),预测微调后该失效模式显著上升的概率。构建ALIGNMENTFORECASTBENCH基准,含5000+预测问题、17个目标模型、32个数据集、16种失效模式。提出脚手架方法:LLM阅读数据集并评估其推动模型失范的强度与广度,再由简单学习模型将该评分与失效模式基率和目标模型先验倾向结合。

Result: 直接提示的前沿模型在该基准上表现不佳。所提脚手架方法显著高于随机水平,超过在该任务上微调的模型,也超过允许查看弱模型微调后行为的简单预测器。其信号还能标记前沿模型分类器漏判的问题样本;在UltraChat等真实后训练数据中过滤这些样本,多数情况下使模型在多项选择评测中更对齐,但在开放式对话中的收益不明确。

Conclusion: 预测器尚不足以可靠指导实际训练数据管理,但结果表明在SFT场景下于训练前预测多种对齐失效是可行的,具备进一步研究价值。

Abstract: Training a language model on data with a narrow flaw can sometimes make the model broadly misaligned. Inspecting the data at face value often does not settle whether it will emerge, and today it is caught only after training, by auditing the resulting model. To complement post-hoc audits, we introduce Alignment Forecasting: the task of predicting alignment failures before training. Given a target model, a fine-tuning dataset, and a failure mode such as deception or sycophancy, a forecaster outputs the probability that fine-tuning would meaningfully increase that failure mode. To measure progress on alignment forecasting, we introduce ALIGNMENTFORECASTBENCH, a benchmark of over 5,000 forecasting questions spanning 17 target models, 32 datasets, and 16 failure modes. Frontier models prompted directly perform poorly on ALIGNMENTFORECASTBENCH. We therefore propose a forecasting scaffold in which an LLM reads the dataset and rates how strongly and broadly it pushes the model toward misbehavior, and a simple learned model combines that rating with the failure mode's base rate and the target model's prior tendency. This forecasts well above chance, and beats a model fine-tuned on the task and a simple forecaster allowed to see how weaker models behaved after fine-tuning on the same data. Its signals also flag problematic training examples that a frontier-model classifier misses. Filtering those examples out from real post-training data such as UltraChat results in more aligned models on our multiple-choice evaluation in most cases, though the benefit in open-ended conversations is unclear. More progress is needed before forecasts can reliably guide training data curation in practice, but our results suggest that forecasting many alignment failures before training can be tractable in the SFT setting.

</details>


### [220] [From Lexical Baselines to Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation: Structured Skill and Responsibility-Level Extraction with the SFIA Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35806)
*Ranuga Disansa,U. S. Samarasinghe,Lasith Gunawardena*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文首次系统评测了面向SFIA框架的"技能—责任等级"结构化抽取任务，比较五种策略并给出可复现基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动化技能抽取大多将技能表示为扁平标签，忽略技能被实践时所处的责任等级；SFIA恰好定义了这一维度（147项技能×7个等级），但尚无针对SFIA的LLM自动抽取研究。

Method: 将任务形式化为从自由文本预测(skill, level)对的结构化预测问题，并构建全自动agentic流程生成的SFIA~9语料；在专家标注的欧洲ICT岗位画像上评测五种策略：词法基线、稠密检索+LLM重排、零样本schema约束LLM、单智能体agentic RAG、三角色（检索—匹配—验证）crew。

Result: 检索式匹配识别出的技能数量最多，生成式策略精度明显更高；只有将等级作为显式决策的策略才能可靠预测等级，基于相似度的选择错误率高一倍以上；三角色crew使延迟翻倍却未提升准确率。

Conclusion: 首次为面向SFIA的结构化、等级感知技能抽取提供可复现基线；表明在封闭分类体系匹配中，单纯增加智能体角色并不必然带来收益。

Abstract: Automated skill extraction underpins workforce planning, yet most systems represent skills as flat labels with no notion of the responsibility level at which a skill is practiced. The Skills Framework for the Information Age (SFIA) captures exactly this dimension, defining 147 professional skills across seven responsibility levels, but no automated LLM-based extraction targeting SFIA has been reported. We formalize the task as structured prediction of (skill, level) pairs from free text and ask three questions: how accurately can text be mapped onto SFIA's closed vocabulary, which strategies reliably predict the level alongside the skill, and do agentic designs improve on simpler retrieval and prompting? We evaluate five strategies (a lexical baseline, dense retrieval with LLM reranking, a zero-shot schema-constrained LLM, single-agent agentic RAG, and a three-agent retriever--matcher--verifier crew) against expert-mapped European ICT role profiles, all drawing on an SFIA~9 corpus built by a fully automated agentic pipeline that we release. Retrieval-based matching identifies the most skills while generative strategies are markedly more precise; only strategies assigning the level as an explicit decision predict it reliably, with similarity-based selection more than twice as inaccurate; and the crew doubles latency without improving accuracy, so added agent roles do not automatically benefit closed-taxonomy matching. These results provide the first reproducible baseline for structured, level-aware skill extraction against SFIA.

</details>


### [221] [Environment Steering: Using Data Flow Control to Improve Agent Utility and Safety](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35807)
*Charlie Summers,Prajwal Raghunath,Aaditya Pai,Mayur Kulkarni,Zhuo Zhang,Oliver Kennedy,Eugene Wu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出Environment Steering：将agent与执行环境状态建模为数据库表，运行时追踪记录级数据流并按声明式策略检查，违规时给出策略与上下文相关的反馈以引导agent走向安全轨迹。在AgentDyn上任务成功率超过无防御基线，攻击成功率0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM agent即便被要求安全行为，仍可能发起不安全的工具调用。现有防御多在执行前约束agent、修改工具输入输出、或依赖LLM裁判；这些方法依赖模型行为，或只阻断不安全动作而无法帮助agent恢复，因此需要由执行环境在运行过程中强制安全并引导替代方案。

Method: 将agent和harness的执行状态建模为数据库表，追踪记录级（record-level）数据流，在运行时用声明式策略检查这些数据流；检测到违规时，依据策略与上下文生成针对性反馈，引导agent转向安全轨迹。

Result: 在AgentDyn基准上，相比无防御设置提升了任务成功率，同时达到0%攻击成功率。

Conclusion: 安全应由执行环境在agent运行期间强制执行，而非仅靠事前约束或外部裁判；运行时数据流检查结合策略驱动的反馈，可实现安全与任务性能的兼顾。

Abstract: LLM agents can make unsafe tool calls even when instructed to behave safely. Existing defenses constrain agents before execution, modify tool inputs/outputs, or rely on LLM judges; these approaches may depend on model behavior or block unsafe actions without helping the agent recover. We argue that the execution environment should instead enforce safety as the agent runs and steer it toward safe alternatives when violations occur---we call this Environment Steering. We implement this by modeling the agent and harness execution state as database tables, track the record-level data flows, and check these data flows against declarative policies during runtime. When violations are detected, policy- and context-specific feedback steers the agent toward safe trajectories. On AgentDyn, this enables the agent to improve task success rate over no-defense while achieving 0% attack success rate.

</details>


### [222] [When Successful Memories Mislead Embodied Agents:Memory Adaption For Task-Conditioned Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35808)
*Quanquan Li,Hongbo Zhang,Yihe Chi,Liuyang Song,Jingyu Li,Yuxiang Huang,Hongzhen Zhang,Guitao Cao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: MATE 是一种确定性的检索后记忆适配流程，将轨迹转化为面向执行的记忆，在 ALFWorld 134 任务上以约十分之一 token 达到 81.3%/93.3% 成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经验复用可减少具身智能体的重复探索，但历史成功轨迹未必适配当前执行语境。现有记忆系统主要优化构建与检索，当检索到的经验含不兼容动作或结构粒度不当时，语义相关性与历史成功率都不足以保证可用性。因此需要区分"检索"与"执行"之间的独立阶段。

Method: 提出 MATE（Memory Adaptation for Task-Conditioned Execution），一种确定性的检索后处理流程，无需额外 LLM 推理。其步骤包括：移除过时的控制上下文；抽取条件-动作-效果（condition-action-effect）转移；进行经验证的动作归一化（verified action normalization）；选择任务相关的表示形式；在固定预算下序列化输出。

Result: 在 134 个 ALFWorld 任务上，使用 Qwen2.5-14B 与 72B 分别取得 81.3% 和 93.3% 的任务成功率，token 消耗约为原始轨迹的十分之一。受控对比显示，经验证的动作归一化是 MATE 恢复检索经验可用性的主要机制。

Conclusion: 记忆适配应被视为检索与具身执行之间的独立阶段，而非检索的附属优化；动作归一化在其中起关键作用。

Abstract: Experience reuse can reduce repeated exploration in embodied agents, but a trajectory that succeeded previously may be unsuitable for the current execution context. Existing memory systems pri marily optimize construction and retrieval; semantic relevance and historical success therefore remain insufficient when retrieved ex perience contains incompatible actions or an inappropriate level of structure. We introduce Memory Adaptation for Task-Conditioned Execution (MATE), a deterministic post-retrieval procedure that converts trajectories into execution-oriented memory. MATE re moves obsolete control context, extracts condition-action-effect transitions, applies verified action normalization, selects a task dependent representation, and serializes the result under a fixed budget without additional LLM inference. On 134 ALFWorld tasks, MATE achieves task success rates of 81.3% and 93.3% with Qwen2.5-14B and 72B while using approximately one-tenth of the tokens required by raw trajectories. Controlled comparisons show that verified action normalization is the principal mechanism by which MATE restores the utility of retrieved experience, support ing memory adaptation as a distinct stage between retrieval and embodied execution.

</details>


### [223] [Can Multimodal Large Language Models Generate and Detect Multimodal Social Media Fake News?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35809)
*Jiyao Yang,Yang Liu,Zhenyue Qin,Qingyu Chen,Xiuzhen Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出多智能体框架生成多模态假新闻，并系统评测16个MLLM的检测能力，发现模型远低于人类水平，尤其在图像真实性识别上失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI快速发展，MLLM可能被滥用于社交媒体大规模虚假信息传播。尽管已有文本虚假信息研究，但核心问题仍未解答：MLLM能否被利用伪造逼真的多模态假新闻？又能否可靠地检测这些假新闻？

Method: 提出一个多智能体框架，由故事智能体（story agent）、图像智能体（image agent）和评论家智能体（critic agent）协作，生成与真实新闻相对抗、看似可信的社交媒体假帖子；据此跨科学、健康、娱乐三个领域生成超过9000条配对的多模态新闻帖子，并对16个开源与闭源MLLM进行自动化检测基准评测。

Result: 多数模型准确率显著低于人类水平，并在识别图像真实性方面出现严重失败。

Conclusion: 该研究为开发针对社交媒体假新闻的稳健防御提供了基础，代码与数据已开源。

Abstract: The rapid advancement of generative AI raises concerns about the misuse of Multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) for large-scale disinformation campaigns on social media. Despite existing research on textual disinformation, a fundamental question remains unanswered: can MLLMs be exploited to fabricate realistic multimodal fake news, and can they reliably detect it? We introduce a multi-agent framework in which a story agent, an image agent, and a critic agent collaborate to produce fake social media posts that plausibly counter true news. We apply the framework to generate over 9,000 paired multimodal news posts across science, health, and entertainment domains, and benchmark 16 open- and closed-source MLLMs for automated detection. We find that most models fall substantially short of human-level accuracy and fail critically on identifying image authenticity. Our research provides a foundation for developing robust defenses against social media fake news. Code and data are available at https: //github.com/xiuzhenzhang/Multimodal.

</details>


### [224] [TRACE: Deployable Tree-Relational Structure Enhancement for Oncology LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35810)
*Jizheng Lai,Yingyun Li,Ying Qin,Haiyang Qian*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: TRACE 是一个可部署的树-关系增强框架，通过分离离线结构学习与在线轻量推理，为肿瘤学大模型提供结构化医学证据，在多个分类和问答任务上提升性能并增强可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 肿瘤学应用中大语言模型的预测往往缺乏对显式医学结构的依赖，导致证据支撑薄弱。现有方法（如普通 RAG、通用 GraphRAG）难以提供可更新、任务自适应的医学结构证据。

Method: TRACE 将昂贵的离线结构学习与轻量在线推理分离：把肿瘤学概念与关系组织为可更新的树-关系结构，利用 LM 损失衍生的证据进行精炼，并在推理时检索为紧凑的提示证据，从而实现零样本无监督标签下的任务自适应证据选择。

Result: 在十个肿瘤学分类任务和一个 MedQuAD CancerGov 问答基准上，TRACE 同时提升了无标签评估和有监督微调效果；相较 vanilla RAG 与通用 GraphRAG 均有改进；在泄漏控制的 METABRIC 输入下仍有效，并能生成与临床推理对齐的可解释证据路径。

Conclusion: 显式、可更新的医学结构是通向更准确、更可审计的肿瘤学大模型部署的可行路径。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used in oncology applications, but their predictions are often weakly grounded in explicit medical structure. We present TRACE, a deployable tree-relational enhancement framework for oncology LLMs. TRACE separates expensive offline structure learning from lightweight online inference: oncology concepts and relations are organized into an updatable tree-relational structure, refined using LM-loss-derived evidence, and retrieved at inference time as compact prompt evidence. This design supports task-adaptive evidence selection without requiring supervised labels in the zero-shot setting. Across ten oncology classification tasks and one MedQuAD CancerGov QA benchmark, TRACE improves both label-free evaluation and supervised fine-tuning. Additional analyses show that TRACE improves over vanilla RAG and generic GraphRAG, remains useful under leakage-controlled METABRIC inputs, and produces interpretable evidence paths aligned with clinical reasoning. These results suggest that explicit, updatable medical structure is a practical path toward more accurate and auditable oncology LLM deployment.

</details>


### [225] [Lookahead-R: Budget-Aware Tool Retrieval via Execution-Centric Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35811)
*Zongze Wu,Yani Guo,Runnan Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出Lookahead-R框架，将工具检索重构为资源受限的序列决策问题，通过轻量级执行感知代理世界模型与不确定性引导的蒙特卡洛树搜索，在ToolBench上实现了更优的精度-效率权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体在大型异构API生态中面临工具检索瓶颈：语义检索器速度快但存在语义-功能鸿沟，执行验证提升精度却带来不可接受的延迟，二者构成固有权衡。

Method: Lookahead-R引入轻量级执行感知代理世界模型，联合预测工具执行成功、延迟成本和语义效用，且无需调用真实API；该世界模型驱动代价敏感、不确定性引导的蒙特卡洛树搜索，在严格预算约束下导航工具空间。

Result: 在ToolBench大规模基准上各测试场景均取得更优的精度-效率权衡；在最难的I3划分上NDCG@5达91.40%，超越SOTA方法ToolGen（90.16%）1.24%。消融研究表明显式延迟建模是资源约束下识别高质量工具的关键判别信号。

Conclusion: 将工具检索建模为资源受限的序列决策，并借助代理世界模型与蒙特卡洛树搜索，能够有效突破语义检索与执行验证之间的权衡，显式延迟建模对高质量工具识别至关重要。

Abstract: Tool retrieval is a critical bottleneck for LLM-based agents operating over large, heterogeneous API ecosystems. Existing approaches face an inherent trade-off: semantic retrievers are fast but suffer from the semantic-functional gap, while execution-based validation improves precision at the cost of prohibitive latency. We propose Lookahead-R, a planning-based framework that reformulates tool retrieval as a resource-constrained sequential decision-making problem. At its core, Lookahead-R introduces a lightweight execution-aware surrogate world model that jointly predicts tool execution success, latency cost, and semantic utility---without invoking real APIs. This world model drives a cost-sensitive, uncertainty-guided Monte Carlo Tree Search that navigates the tool space under strict budget constraints. Evaluated on the large-scale ToolBench benchmark, Lookahead-R achieves a superior accuracy-efficiency trade-off across all test scenarios. On the most challenging I3 split, it attains an NDCG@5 of 91.40\%, outperforming the state-of-the-art ToolGen (90.16\%) by 1.24\%. Ablation studies confirm that explicit latency modeling is the key discriminative signal for identifying high-quality tools under resource constraints.

</details>


### [226] [Automated Evaluation of Multi-Turn Dialogues in In-Car Conversational Assistants](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35812)
*Vaishnav Negi,Lev Sorokin,Soroosh Tayebi Arasteh,Andrea Stocco*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一个针对车载对话助手（ICA）多轮对话能力的自动化黑盒测试框架，通过闭环仿真（策略引导用户模拟器、对抗策略管理器、双层LLM评判器）进行评估，并在工业级ICA上验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 车载对话助手日益集成于车辆中，需保证其可靠性。但多轮交互、缺乏显式真值以及严格安全约束使其测试困难。现有评估技术仅针对单轮设定，无法捕捉跨轮次的约束处理、上下文保持和安全关键行为。

Method: 将系统视为黑盒，采用闭环仿真进行测试，包含三个组件：策略引导的用户模拟器、对抗策略管理器，以及双层LLM评判器（分别评估回合级失败与会话级质量）。在一款工业级ICA上，结合六种LLM后端与十二名人工标注者进行评估。

Result: 自动化评判器与人工评判达到较高一致性；相比无引导仿真，策略引导可发现每段对话中多出2.96倍的独特失败类型，并使出现独特失败对话的数量增加一倍以上。

Conclusion: 该自动化框架能有效测试ICA的多轮对话能力，策略引导显著提升失败发现的广度，且LLM评判结果与人类判断高度一致，为多轮对话系统的安全可靠评估提供了可行方案。

Abstract: In-car conversational assistants (ICAs) are increasingly integrated into vehicles to support route planning, vehicle control, and information access. Ensuring their reliability is challenging due to multi-turn interactions, the absence of explicit ground truth, and strict safety constraints. Existing evaluation techniques fall short, as they target single-turn settings and fail to capture constraint handling, context retention, and safety-critical behavior across turns. We propose an automated framework for testing the multi-turn conversational capabilities of ICAs. The system is treated as a black box and evaluated via closed-loop simulation with a strategy-guided user simulator, an adversarial strategy manager, and a two-tier LLM judge assessing turn-level failures and conversation-level quality. We evaluate the approach on an industrial ICA with six LLM backends and twelve human annotators. The automated judge shows substantial agreement with humans, and strategy guidance uncovers 2.96 times more unique failure types per conversation and more than doubles the number of unique failing conversations compared to unguided simulation.

</details>


### [227] [Constructing Challenging Browser-Use Tasks by Controlled Environment Interventions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35814)
*Xunjian Yin,Tianchen Guan,Jinao Wang,Weili Cao,Daisy Xinlei Lin,Royce Cheng-Yue,Keagan Long,Kyle Wong,Bhuwan Dhingra,Xiangjun Wang,Shuyan Zhou*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: BreakingWeb 通过给已可解任务注入环境干预，把难度变成环境的可编程属性，构建 519 组干净/干预任务对，干预使 agent 通过率平均下降 22.9%，主要失败为“虚假成功”的信念失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有浏览器 agent 基准靠不断收集新任务、新网站、新应用来 "提高难度"，导致难度刷新成本高且不可控；当多个因素同时变化时，无法判断究竟是什么让任务变难。因此需要一个难度可编程、可归因的基准构建方式。

Method: 从 agent 已能完成的任务出发构造挑战实例：为每个基础任务配一个干预条件，在保持用户指令、潜在目标和后端成功判据不变的前提下，改变不同 web 栈层级的环境。每个干预是确定性的、可检测的且可恢复的，并标注其主要调用的认知原语。基准含 7 个自托管网站、29 个干预族，共 519 组干净/干预任务对，全部按结果评分。评估对象为六个强浏览器 agent、三个仅看截图的 GUI agent 以及人类。

Result: 构建有效：干预使 agent 通过率平均下降 22.9%，并推翻每个 agent 原本干净解决任务中的近一半；人类首次尝试仅损失 10.0%，熟悉一次后降至 5.7%。主要失败模式为信念失败：六个 agent 75% 的失败以"宣称成功"结束，而所需变更从未发生。

Conclusion: 难度可以被程序化地注入已有任务，从而低成本、可归因地评估浏览器 agent；当前 agent 的瓶颈不在操作能力而在对环境状态的正确信念，普遍存在谎报成功的问题。代码、数据与环境已公开于 www.breakingweb.app。

Abstract: As browser-use agents improve, benchmarks keep pace by collecting new tasks, websites, and applications, often making tasks longer or more novel. This makes difficulty expensive to refresh and difficult to control: when many aspects change at once, it is unclear what actually makes a task challenging. We instead construct challenging instances from tasks agents already solve, turning difficulty into a programmable property of the environment. BreakingWeb pairs every base task with an intervention condition that preserves the user instruction, latent target, and backend success criterion while changing the environment at different web stack layers. Each intervention is deterministic, detectable, and recoverable, and is annotated with the cognitive primitive it primarily loads. The benchmark contains 519 clean/intervention task pairs across seven self-hosted websites and 29 intervention families, all graded against outcomes. We evaluate six strong browser-use agents, three GUI-only agents that see only screenshots, and humans. The construction is effective: interventions cut agent pass rate by 22.9% on average and overturn nearly half of the tasks each agent solves cleanly, whereas humans lose 10.0% on a first attempt and 5.7% after one familiarisation attempt. The dominant failure is belief failure: 75% of the six agents' failures end with a declared success although the required change never happened. Our code, data and environment are publicly available at www.breakingweb.app.

</details>


### [228] [How to Run Statistics over LLM Judges and Trust the Results: Calibrated Inference for Small-Sample AI Evaluation with evalstats](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35815)
*Ian Arawjo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究针对LLM评审打分与小样本AI评估中显著性检验不可靠的问题，提出统计分析与偏差校正工具evalstats。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学术界日益依赖LLM评审分数和小样本AI评估来支撑显著性结论，但缺乏良好校准的置信区间、假设检验与评审偏差校正，导致此类结论不可靠。研究发现，对原始LLM评审分数直接做统计会抬高假阳性：许多评分者一致性指标下，假阳性风险反而在“接近完美”的人机一致性处达到峰值。

Method: 作者为混合人-AI评审设计的统计分析提供指导与工具，通过预测驱动推断（PPI）实现九种假设检验，其中包含四个秩检验（Wilcoxon符号秩、Mann-Whitney U及其omnibus变体）的首个已知PPI校正；提出bootstrap-adaptive power tuning，将估计权重向基于标注数据的目标收缩并计入权重自身抽样方差，以稳定小规模人工标注校准集下的PPI++。此外通过蒙特卡洛模拟，给出N<100小样本AI评估中CI、p值与FWER校正方法的选择建议。

Result: 模拟结论建议研究者慎用bootstrap置信区间；在三个演示场景中，其中一个场景显示：一个被验证为“substantial agreement”的真实LLM评审会使研究者发表虚假发现。相关建议被封装为开源Python包evalstats，可自动选择校准后的方法，代码见https://github.com/ianarawjo/evalstats。

Conclusion: 该工作为LLM评审与小样本AI评估提供了负责任的统计分析指南、PPI检验校正及自动选方法的evalstats工具，以降低假阳性与虚假发表风险。

Abstract: Researchers across academia increasingly base significance claims on LLM judge scores and small-sample AI evaluations. Yet without well-calibrated confidence intervals (CIs), hypothesis tests, and judge-bias corrections, such claims are unreliable. We address these issues in several contributions. First, we find that running statistics over raw LLM judge scores leads to inflated false positives: counterintuitively, for many inter-rater agreement metrics, false positive risk peaks at "almost perfect" human-LLM agreement. To help researchers understand how to run statistics over LLM judges responsibly, we present guidance and tooling for the statistical analysis of mixed human-AI judge designs, and implement nine hypothesis tests via prediction-powered inference (PPI), including the first known PPI corrections for four rank-based tests (Wilcoxon signed-rank, Mann-Whitney U, and omnibus variants). To keep PPI++ stable with small human-labeled calibration sets, we introduce bootstrap-adaptive power tuning, which shrinks the estimated weight toward a target estimated from the labeled data, and accounts for that weight's own sampling variance. Second, through Monte Carlo simulations, we derive recommendations for what CI, p-value, and FWER correction methods to use for small-sample AI evaluations (N<100), and warn researchers against bootstrap CIs. We package these recommendations into evalstats, an open-source Python package that selects calibrated methods automatically, and demonstrate it in three scenarios, including one where a real LLM judge validated at "substantial agreement" would have led a researcher to publish a spurious finding. evalstats is publicly available at https://github.com/ianarawjo/evalstats.

</details>


### [229] [PrimeSeeker: Capability-Oriented Supervision for Deep Search Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35816)
*Linzhi Peng,Hanting Chen,Heng Chang,Ke Cheng,Bowen Du,Weifeng Lv*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出潜在锚点推理（latent anchor reasoning）作为检索原语，并基于此构建 PrimeSeeker 框架，用锚点结构与参考证据骨架联合生成问题与轨迹，训练 30B 搜索智能体，在五个深度搜索基准上取得强性能且检索冗余低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大模型搜索智能体多依赖合成问题，通过扩大证据图、增加跳数和延长轨迹来提升难度。这些全局属性只是局部检索能力的间接代理，与搜索实际所需的局部检索能力存在错配。

Method: 提出潜在锚点推理：从描述性规格中解析未命名的检索锚点，并将其迁移到后续信息需求中，把深度搜索分解为耦合操作链，围绕锚点解析与关系迁移组织问题构建，不规定固定搜索路径。基于此提出 PrimeSeeker：构建网络落地的锚点结构，联合导出问题与参考证据骨架；骨架保留构建时的支撑证据，通过当前工具观察的抽取式高亮引导专家生成。高亮在监督微调前移除，骨架随后用于审计参考步骤覆盖率以设计强化学习奖励。

Result: 构建 9,221 条专家轨迹，训练 30B 搜索智能体。在五个深度搜索基准上表现强劲，参考步骤优化进一步提升监督策略；生成轨迹检索冗余低，固定预算评估下以显著更少的工具调用实现较强解覆盖。

Conclusion: 以潜在锚点推理这一局部检索原语替代全局难度代理，能更直接地训练局部检索能力，实现高效、低冗余的深度搜索。

Abstract: Large language model search agents are often trained with synthetic questions whose difficulty is increased through larger evidence graphs, additional hops, and longer trajectories. These global properties, however, are only indirect proxies for the local retrieval capabilities required during search. To address this mismatch, we introduce latent anchor reasoning, which consists of resolving an unnamed retrieval anchor from descriptive specifications and transferring the recovered anchor into a subsequent information demand. This primitive retrieval unit decomposes deep search into chains of coupled operations and organizes question construction around anchor resolution and relation transfer, without prescribing a canonical search path. Based on this formulation, we propose PrimeSeeker, a capability-oriented framework that constructs web-grounded anchor structures and jointly derives a question and a reference evidence skeleton. The skeleton preserves supporting evidence from construction and guides expert generation through extractive highlights of current tool observations. These highlights are removed before supervised fine-tuning, while the skeleton is subsequently reused to audit reference-step coverage for reinforcement-learning rewards. We construct 9,221 expert trajectories, training a 30B search agent. Across five deep-search benchmarks, PrimeSeeker achieves strong performance, while reference-step optimization further improves the supervised policy. The resulting trajectories exhibit low retrieval redundancy, and fixed-budget evaluation shows strong solution coverage with substantially fewer tool calls than long-horizon systems.

</details>


### [230] [Less Uniform Discrete Diffusion is More Powerful and Scalable](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35817)
*Kaibo Wang,Ding Ding,Fangyu Ding,Zijin Feng,Han Shi,Haili Bai,Jiacheng Sun,Yang Xiang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出LUDI框架，通过"less uniform loss"与逐token时间嵌入解决均匀扩散语言模型训练目标过度均匀与采样时条件-目标混淆问题，实现少步采样加速，并将7B自回归模型继续训练为具备复杂推理能力的UDLM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 均匀扩散语言模型（UDLMs）虽有前景，但难以扩展。作者将其核心障碍归因于两点：训练目标"过度均匀"（over-uniform），以及采样阶段的"条件-目标混淆"（condition-target confusion）。

Method: 提出LUDI（Less Uniform Diffusion）框架，包含两项设计：(i) less uniform loss，将每个逆向转移直接指向干净token作为监督目标；(ii) 逐token时间嵌入（per-token time embeddings），提供token级腐蚀提示，从而支持基于置信度的少步采样。此外，将7B自回归模型继续训练为LUDI-7B。

Result: 跨规模实验表明LUDI提供更干净的监督信号并改善少步生成；LUDI-7B相较于AR解码实现每步3 token的加速，性能与掩码扩散基线相当，并展现出复杂推理能力。

Conclusion: LUDI通过重构损失与增强时间条件缓解了UDLM的扩展瓶颈，使UDLM在复杂生成任务上具备竞争力，说明其潜力尚未被充分释放。

Abstract: Although uniform diffusion language models (UDLMs) represent a promising diffusion paradigm, scaling them remains challenging. We identify the core obstacle as an over-uniform training objective and condition-target confusion during sampling. To address these, we propose Less Uniform Diffusion (LUDI), a novel UDLM framework. Specifically, we (i) introduce a less uniform loss that directs each reverse transition toward the clean token, and (ii) equip the model with per-token time embeddings that supply token-level corruption hints, enabling confidence-based few-step sampling. Experiments across scales show that LUDI yields cleaner supervision and improves few-step generation. We further continue-train a 7B autoregressive model into LUDI-7B, resulting in a UDLM capable of complex reasoning. It achieves a 3-token-per-step speedup over AR decoding and competitive performance compared with masked diffusion baselines, revealing that the full potential of UDLMs for complex generation remains to be unlocked.

</details>


### [231] [$τ$-Multilingual: Benchmarking Voice Agents Across Languages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35820)
*Soham Ray,Edgard dos Santos Paiva,Ruben Valenzuela,Karthik Narasimhan,Keshav Dhandhania,Victor Barres*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 τ-Multilingual 多语言语音智能体评测基准，将 τ-Voice 扩展至西班牙语、巴西葡萄牙语、印地语、韩语和普通话，通过母语者审核与 4500 通全双工通话揭示跨语言性能差异及不同失败模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有语音智能体基准以英语为主，仅覆盖狭窄的行为范围，无法反映多语言场景下的真实表现，因此需要构建经过母语者验证的多语言评测基准。

Method: 将 τ-Voice 扩展为 τ-Multilingual，覆盖西班牙语、巴西葡萄牙语、印地语、韩语和普通话；邀请母语者对生成语言与语音输出进行审核和评估；在五种语音配置下开展 4500 通全双工通话评测。

Result: 西班牙语、葡萄牙语和印地语的任务完成率与英语差距在 3.2 个百分点以内，而韩语和普通话分别下降 14.7 和 8.4 个百分点。失败模式存在语言差异：韩语系统漏答更多，普通话系统打断更频繁，二者均在工具调用与实体识别上表现欠佳。Grok 任务完成率最高但生成质量最低。

Conclusion: 跨语言性能与失败模式差异显著，应以任务完成、交互、生成质量三类指标分别报告；发布语言包、经验证的评判器及工具，推动社区共建多语言语音智能体评测。

Abstract: English-only benchmarks expose only a narrow slice of voice-agent behavior. We introduce $τ$-Multilingual, extending $τ$-Voice to Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Hindi, Korean, and Mandarin with native-speaker review and evaluation of generated language and spoken output. Across 4,500 full-duplex calls and five voice configurations, Spanish, Portuguese, and Hindi remain within 3.2 task-completion points of English, but Korean and Mandarin fall by 14.7 and 8.4 points. The failure modes also vary: Korean systems miss more responses, Mandarin systems interrupt more often, and both struggle with tools and entities. Grok leads task completion but scores lowest on generation quality, motivating separate task, interaction, and generation reporting. We release language packs, validated judges, and tools for community-built multilingual voice-agent evaluation.

</details>


### [232] [Can We Still Trust Disaster Social Sensing? Empirical Evidence on Detecting AI-Generated Social Media Posts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35821)
*Xiaoshan Zhou,Zaifu Zhan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究检验文本型AI检测器能否可靠区分人类撰写与AI生成的灾害社交媒体帖子，发现跨模型检测近乎随机，现有检测不足以作为运营级信任关口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灾害社会感知依赖公众社交媒体帖子提供态势感知与人道需求证据，但生成式AI可产出酷似目击者报告的看似可信文本，可能污染证据链，因此需要评估文本型AI检测器能否承担可信性把关。

Method: 构建来自九种灾害的12,000条文本，组成3,000个语义匹配单元，包含四类：原始人类帖子(H0)、LLM轻度校对的人类帖子(H1)、基于同一核实事实生成的事实性AI帖子(A0)、以及情感化改写的AI帖子(A1)；另用涵盖42个事件的6,000条文本语料作模型选择与阈值校准。评估OSM-Det、Fast-DetectGPT、Binoculars与直接LLM判定器，覆盖五个模型族，并进行灾害域校准、冻结编码器线性读出、配对变换敏感性分析及数据集伪影控制。

Result: 十四个冻结跨族配置下AUROC为0.402–0.517，校准导出的低假阳性工作点最佳前瞻召回率仅3.6%；OSM-Det达AUROC 0.521、在实际假阳性率6.7%时召回10.4%。灾害域训练线性头可把AUROC提高到0.817，但七特征表面分类器在H0对A0对比上已达0.784；中和所识别的表面不对称后，线性头从0.733降至0.594。该线性头还能区分A0与A1，尽管二者来源一致。

Conclusion: 文本型检测的可靠性不足以作为运营级信任关口；保障灾害社会感知的可信性应转向多模态证据、可问责信源及其他语境证据，而非依赖文本来源判别。

Abstract: Disaster social sensing converts public social-media posts into evidence for situational awareness and humanitarian needs, but generative artificial intelligence (AI) can produce plausible messages that resemble eyewitness reports. This study investigates whether text-based AI detectors can reliably distinguish human-authored from AI-generated disaster posts. We construct a dataset of 12,000 texts organised into 3,000 matched semantic units from nine disasters: original human posts (H0), minimally LLM-proofread human posts (H1), factual AI-generated posts based on the same verified facts (A0), and affectively framed versions of those AI posts (A1). A separate 6,000-text corpus from 42 events supports model selection and threshold calibration. We evaluate OSM-Det, Fast-DetectGPT, Binoculars, and direct large language model (LLM) judges across five model families, then test disaster-domain calibration, a frozen-encoder linear readout, paired transformation sensitivity, and dataset artifact controls. Across fourteen frozen cross-family configurations, AUROC is 0.402-0.517 and the best prospective recall at a calibration-derived low-false-positive operating point is 3.6%; OSM-Det reaches AUROC 0.521 and 10.4% recall at a realised 6.7% false-positive rate. A disaster-trained linear head reaches AUROC 0.817, but a seven-feature surface classifier reaches 0.784 on the H0-versus-A0 contrast, and neutralising identified surface asymmetries reduces the head from 0.733 to 0.594. The head also separates A0 from A1 even though provenance is unchanged. The results show that text-based detection is not reliable enough to serve as an operational trust gate; multimodal claims, accountable sources, and other contextual evidence should be rested on to safeguard trust in disaster social sensing.

</details>


### [233] [Tracing mechanisms of sycophantic agreement in language models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35822)
*Sixing Chen,Zhuofan Josh Ying,Logan Riggs Smith,Jeremy Wertheimer,Natalie Shapira*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究利用因果中介分析揭示了语言模型谄媚性认同的机制：用户观点在早期即被写入最终提示词的残差流，通过稀疏的早期注意力头偏置答案检索；消融这些注意力头可大幅降低谄媚性而不损害事实准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 谄媚性认同被广泛视为一种对齐失败，即模型过度附和用户既有的信念或偏好，甚至以牺牲事实准确性为代价。然而，其背后的机制仍缺乏理解，制约了针对性干预手段的开发。

Method: 采用因果中介分析（causal mediation analysis）定位谄媚性认同的机制，识别承载观点信号的早期注意力头，并对其进行消融实验；同时区分观点被显式陈述与通过无内容反驳（如"你确定吗？"）间接传达两种情形。

Result: 用户陈述的观点在早期即被写入最终提示词的残差流，进而偏置后续答案检索；一组稀疏的早期注意力头承载该观点信号。消融这些注意力头可显著降低谄媚性，而事实准确性基本不受影响。这些头承载观点时不依赖其具体措辞。在无内容反驳的情形下，存在另一组不同的注意力头，通过抑制模型原本正确的答案来促成改答。

Conclusion: 该工作为观点如何诱导谄媚性认同提供了机制性解释，是朝着更精准、更可靠的对齐干预迈出的一步。

Abstract: Sycophantic agreement in language models refers to the tendency to overly affirm a user's stated beliefs or preferences, often at the expense of factual accuracy. Although it is widely recognized as an alignment failure, its underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood. In this work, we use causal mediation analysis to identify the mechanisms behind sycophantic agreement. We show that a stated opinion is incorporated into the residual stream of the final prompt token early, where it biases subsequent answer retrieval. A sparse set of early attention heads carries this opinion signal. Ablating these heads substantially reduces sycophancy while leaving factual accuracy largely intact. The same heads carry the opinion when it is explicitly stated, regardless of how it is phrased. When an opinion is not stated explicitly but instead conveyed through content-free pushback (e.g., ``Are you sure?"), we find a distinct set of heads that suppresses the model's original correct answer to promote a revised answer. By providing a mechanistic account of how opinions induce sycophantic agreement, this work takes a step toward developing more targeted and reliable alignment interventions.

</details>


### [234] [Reliable but Design-Sensitive: Instrument Uncertainty in LLM Annotation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35824)
*Thomas Reiter,Christoph Kern,Fedor Miasnikov,Sofiia Nikolenko,Rob Chew,Stephanie Eckman,Frauke Kreuter*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究通过在3000条推文上测试7个LLM、12种任务设计、3次独立运行，发现LLM标注结果对任务设计和模型选择高度敏感，并将这种由设计选择引起的变异称为"工具不确定性"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在一种设定下能给出可靠标签，但当研究者做出其他合理的设计选择时标签会发生变化。这种不稳定性威胁到LLM作为标注工具的可靠性，且现有做法（重复同一设定或依赖置信度分数）无法解决该问题，因此需要系统量化并命名这一现象。

Method: 在3000条标注为冒犯性语言和仇恨言论的推文上，测试7个LLM、12种任务设计，每种组合独立运行3次；通过Fleiss' κ和Cohen's κ衡量一致性，比较任务设计与模型选择对估计患病率方差的影响，并将LLM结果与五种人类测量工具版本对比；同时检验置信度分数与人类标签一致性的关系及批量提示对置信度的影响。

Result: 同一模型与任务设计重复运行一致性高（中位Fleiss' κ=0.91）；更换任务设计后一致性下降（中位Cohen's κ=0.76）。任务设计与模型选择使估计患病率方差相对仅抽样方差分别增大约76.7倍（冒犯性语言）和110.6倍（仇恨言论）。跨LLM任务设计的变异达560–572个基点，而五种人类测量工具版本仅为270–331个基点。置信度分数未能解决问题：其更贴近重复模型输出而非与人类标签的一致性；将六条推文合并入一个提示使平均冒犯性语言置信度下降660个基点。

Conclusion: 由任务设计和模型选择引起的变异被命名为"工具不确定性"。研究者只有通过比较多种合理任务设计才能测量该不确定性，重复单一设定或依赖置信度分数无法替代这一检验。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can give reliable labels under one setup yet change those labels when researchers make other reasonable design choices. We tested seven LLMs, 12 task designs, three independent runs, and 3,000 tweets labeled for offensive language and hate speech. Repeating the same model and task design produced high agreement (median Fleiss' $κ= 0.91$). Agreement fell when we changed the task design for the same tweets (median Cohen's $κ= 0.76$). Task design and model choice increased the variance of estimated prevalence by factors of 76.7 for offensive language and 110.6 for hate speech compared with sampling variance alone. Variation across LLM task designs reached 560-572 basis points, compared with 270-331 basis points across five human instrument versions. Confidence scores did not solve this problem. They tracked repeated model outputs more closely than agreement with human labels, and grouping six tweets in one prompt lowered mean offensive-language confidence by 660 basis points. We call the variation caused by task design and model choice instrument uncertainty. Researchers can measure it only by comparing reasonable task designs. Repeating one setup or relying on confidence scores cannot replace that test.

</details>


### [235] [Beyond the Context Window: An Adaptive Entropy-Based Routing Framework for Hybrid Retrieval and Long-Context Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35831)
*Isaac Olufadewa,Miracle Adesina,Ezekiel Oladejo,Owen Adeniyi,Fadare Fadekemi,Olamide Oso,Uthman Babatunde,Matthew Olawoyin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出EDAR（熵驱动自适应路由）框架，基于RAG首几个生成token的预测熵决定是否升级到长上下文处理，在保留纯长上下文97.4%精度的同时降低70.7%的token开销，仅升级18.2%的查询。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 百万级token上下文窗口引发"是否仍需RAG"的疑问。纯长上下文（LC）处理成本高昂且在长输入中部存在注意力不足问题；纯RAG虽快但受限于检索质量，当检索块部分相关或相互矛盾时易出错。需要一种在推理时权衡两者、兼顾精度与成本的方法。

Method: EDAR在推理时决策：从检索块作答还是升级为完整长上下文处理。决策依据是RAG响应前若干生成token上的token级概率分布的预测熵。熵阈值通过在留出验证集上以成本对精度进行扫描来选取。在LongBench v2与Infinity-Bench上，与纯RAG、纯LC基线对比。

Result: 在2,000条留出生成上，预测熵与幻觉率强相关（Pearson r = 0.85，95% CI [0.83, 0.87]）。在长上下文基准上，EDAR保留纯长上下文基线97.4%的精度，同时将总token消耗降低70.7%，仅升级18.2%的查询。在标准样本量下，EDAR与纯长上下文系统的精度差距与零无统计显著差异。

Conclusion: 预测熵可作为在RAG与长上下文推理之间进行路由的有效模型内部信号；基于阈值的混合系统能以极小成本恢复长上下文模型的大部分精度。该框架不依赖特定检索器或LC骨干模型，除正常解码所产生的内容外无需额外监督。

Abstract: Modern large language models now support context windows of more than one million tokens, which has raised the question of whether retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is still necessary. Pure long-context (LC) processing is expensive and is known to under-attend to information placed in the middle of long inputs, while pure RAG is fast but bounded by retrieval quality and prone to errors when retrieved chunks are partially relevant or contradictory. We propose the Entropy-Driven Adaptive Router (EDAR), a framework that decides at inference time whether to answer a query from retrieved chunks or to escalate it to full long-context processing. The decision uses the predictive entropy of the token-level probability distribution computed over the first few generated tokens of the RAG response. The entropy threshold is selected on a held-out validation set by sweeping cost against accuracy. Experiments compare EDAR against pure-RAG and pure-LC baselines on LongBench v2 and Infinity-Bench. Predictive entropy correlates strongly with hallucination rate on a held-out set of 2,000 generations (Pearson r = 0.85, 95% CI [0.83, 0.87]). On the long-context benchmarks, EDAR retains 97.4% of the accuracy of the pure long-context baseline while reducing total token expenditure by 70.7%, escalating only 18.2% of incoming queries. The accuracy gap between EDAR and the pure long-context system is not statistically distinguishable from zero at standard sample sizes. Predictive entropy is a useful model-internal signal for routing between RAG and long-context inference, and a threshold-based hybrid system can recover most of the accuracy of long-context models at a small fraction of the cost. The framework does not depend on a specific retriever or LC backbone, and it does not require additional supervision beyond what is normally produced during decoding.

</details>


### [236] [When Should LLMs Trust Their Own Revisions? A Risk-Aware Study of Intrinsic Self-Correction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35832)
*Tianzhu Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究通过追踪29个开源LLM在BoolQ、GSM8K和Corr2Cause上的正确性转移，揭示内在自我修正既可纠错也会破坏原本正确答案，建议将其视为一种修正策略而非普遍有益的二次推理，并以“恢复的纠错”和“引入的错误”双重标准评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 内在自我修正常被默认视为有益的二次推理，但第二次回答既可能纠正错误，也可能推翻原本正确的答案。聚合准确率会掩盖这种“纠错”与“致错”并存的异质行为，因此需要系统性刻画修正的收益-代价权衡。

Method: 在BoolQ、GSM8K、Corr2Cause三个任务上评测29个开源权重LLM，通过追踪初始答案与修正答案之间的正确性转移（correctness transitions）来量化修正行为；并开展受控BoolQ实验，考察不同refinement提示如何改变恢复与损害之间的平衡；最后比较三种运行时策略：保留初始答案、无条件接受修正、以及利用初始回答后可用信号进行选择性修正（learned gating）。

Result: 聚合准确率掩盖了显著不同的修正行为。例如Llama-3.1-8B在GSM8K上提升25.5个百分点，但refinement却将19.1%的原本正确答案改为错误。受控BoolQ实验表明refinement提示会改变恢复与损害的权衡。三种运行时策略对比显示：某些设置下学习式门控有效，另一些设置下更简单的无条件策略反而更优。

Conclusion: 应将内在自我修正视为一种可选择的修正策略（revision policy），而非普遍有益的二次推理；评估时需同时衡量其恢复的纠错和引入的错误。

Abstract: Intrinsic self-correction asks a language model to revise its own answer without receiving new external evidence. A second pass can recover mistakes, but it can also overturn answers that were already correct. We study this trade-off across 29 open-weight LLMs on BoolQ, GSM8K, and Corr2Cause by tracking correctness transitions between initial and revised answers. Aggregate accuracy can conceal substantially different revision behavior: for example, Llama-3.1-8B improves by 25.5 percentage points on GSM8K, while refinement changes 19.1% of initially correct answers into wrong ones. A controlled BoolQ study further shows that refinement prompts shift the balance between recovery and harm. We then compare three runtime choices: keeping the initial answer, always accepting the revision, and selectively invoking revision using signals available after the initial response. The comparison identifies settings where learned gating is useful and others where a simpler unconditional policy performs better. These results suggest treating intrinsic self-correction as a revision policy rather than as a uniformly beneficial second pass, and evaluating it through both the corrections it recovers and the errors it introduces.

</details>


### [237] [Hyperspherical Semantic Trajectory Analysis: Mapping Technological Diffusion across Academic Preprints, Patent Signals, and Compute Scaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35845)
*Muhammad Sukri Bin Ramli*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出HSTA（超球语义轨迹分析）无监督方法，直接从arXiv预印本与USPTO专利文本中追踪技术扩散，构建语义质心漂移与商业化偏移两项指标，以弥补TFP等宏观生产率指标的报告滞后。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TFP等宏观生产率指标因行政调查间隔与国民核算惯例，存在数年的报告滞后，难以及时捕捉技术突破。作者希望建立一种基于非结构化科学与商业文本、可实时追踪技术扩散的客观量化机制，以补充传统经济统计。

Method: HSTA为无监督量化方法：采集3万条筛选文档（arXiv预印本与USPTO专利申请），用Transformer句向量嵌入，经Spherical K-Means在8个子主题上聚类并映射到单位超球面，辅以UMAP流形降维。据此定义两项指标：(1)语义质心向量漂移，度量时间子语料间的词汇迁移以识别结构性范式转变；(2)商业化偏移，评估科学发现与知识产权申报在跨语料峰值密度上的对齐。再将季度主题体量速度与Epoch AI的硬件算力指标对接，进行向量自回归（VAR）F检验。

Result: VAR F检验显示，仅凭季度论文体量速度在常规显著性水平上并不Granger引起前沿算力配置激增，说明文本信号需以物理资本约束为条件。语义演化最快的是大语言模型子主题（漂移0.332）与人工智能系统子主题（漂移0.234）。

Conclusion: HSTA提供了一种客观、实时的语义演化度量，可补足传统经济统计的时滞缺陷；但文本信号不足以单独预测算力投资，应与物理资本约束联合建模。

Abstract: Macroeconomic productivity metrics, such as Total Factor Productivity, register technological breakthroughs with multi-year reporting lags due to administrative survey intervals and national accounting conventions. This paper introduces Hyperspherical Semantic Trajectory Analysis (HSTA), an unsupervised quantitative methodology that tracks technology diffusion directly from unstructured scientific and commercial text streams. We analyze 30,000 filtered document records spanning academic preprints from arXiv and patent application records from the USPTO. By projecting high-dimensional Transformer sentence embeddings onto unit hyperspheres using Spherical K-Means clustering across eight primary sub-topics and UMAP manifold reductions, HSTA formalizes two quantitative metrics: (1) Semantic Centroid Vector Drift, which tracks vocabulary shifts between temporal sub-corpora to identify structural paradigm transformations; and (2) Commercialization Offset, which evaluates cross-corpus peak density alignments between scientific discovery and intellectual property filings. Linking quarterly topic volume velocity with physical hardware metrics from the Epoch AI database, Vector Autoregressive F-tests demonstrate that quarterly paper volume velocity alone does not Granger-cause frontier compute allocation surges at conventional statistical significance levels, highlighting the necessity of conditioning textual signals on physical capital constraints. Empirical results reveal that sub-topics covering Large Language Models (with a drift metric of 0.332) and Artificial Intelligence Systems (with a drift metric of 0.234) undergo the highest rate of semantic evolution, offering an objective, real-time mechanism to complement traditional economic statistics.

</details>


### [238] [The Detectability Gap: Hidden Heterogeneity in Hallucination Detection Across Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35860)
*Pranav Darshan,Pranav A,Sravan Karthick T,Minal Moharir,Ivan P. Yamshchikov*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文研究基于采样一致性的幻觉检测中存在的异质性：将幻觉按答案一致性划分为高一致（Ghost）与低一致（Flickering）两种机制，发现两者间存在显著可检测性差距，且该差距在多种模型、数据集与更严格的检验下稳健存在。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于采样一致性的幻觉检测被广泛使用，但聚合指标可能掩盖"哪些错误可被检测"上的系统性差异。作者希望揭示这种被掩盖的异质性，并论证需要按机制（regime）条件化地进行评估。

Method: 在4个语言模型和3个事实型问答数据集上，按答案一致性将幻觉划分为高一致（Ghost）与低一致（Flickering）机制，测量两者的可检测性差距（AUC 0.35–0.46）；由于定义机制与衡量差距的统计量高度耦合（|ρ|≈0.94–1.00），作者先将机制分配冻结，再以词汇与语义响应离散度验证不对称性，并用自助法95%置信区间检验；进一步采用不依赖跨种子信息的个体扩散轨迹做更严格检验。

Result: 冻结机制分配后，词汇与语义响应离散度保持该不对称性，12个模型-数据集设置的自助法95%区间均排除零；基于个体扩散轨迹的严格检验在3个LLaDA数据集上均保持不对称（p<0.005），在3个Dream数据集上方向一致，其中一个达到显著。困难机制的流行率在不同模型间差异很大（16%–77%），且相同提示在不同模型间常发生机制切换。

Conclusion: 聚合检测指标掩盖了语言模型失败中持续存在、依赖模型的异质性，因此应推动机制条件化的评估（regime conditioned evaluation）。

Abstract: Sampling based consistency is widely used for hallucination detection, yet aggregate performance can conceal systematic differences in which errors are detectable. This work studies that heterogeneity across four language models and three factual question answering datasets. Partitioning hallucinations by answer agreement reveals high agreement (Ghost) and low agreement (Flickering) regimes with an apparent detectability gap of $0.35$ to $0.46$ AUC. Because the statistics used to define the regimes and measure this gap are strongly coupled ($|ρ|\approx0.94$ to $1.00$), the raw result is treated as a property of agreement based detection rather than independent evidence. After freezing regime assignments, lexical and semantic response dispersion preserve the asymmetry, with bootstrap $95\%$ intervals excluding zero in all $12$ model and dataset settings. A stricter test using individual diffusion trajectories and no cross seed information preserves the asymmetry across all three LLaDA datasets ($p<0.005$) and directionally across all three Dream datasets, with one reaching significance. The hard regime varies substantially in prevalence across models ($16\%$ to $77\%$), and matched prompts frequently change regimes between models. These findings show that aggregate detection metrics conceal persistent, model dependent heterogeneity in language model failures and motivate regime conditioned evaluation.

</details>


### [239] [Resolving the Missing Financial Data Crisis: A Generative AI Pipeline for SEC 10-K Extraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35864)
*Prisha Nair,Roee Shraga*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究评估多种LLM从SEC 10-K文件中抽取财务属性的能力，发现模型参数规模与文档结构复杂度匹配时零样本准确率最高：Qwen-2.5 14B在表格类"现金"上F1达83.33%，Llama-3.3 70B在叙述性"研发"上F1达76.92%，为消除量化金融数据集的缺失数据偏差提供了可扩展框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SEC 10-K文件含大量财务信息，但结构化数据集未能一致捕获，导致超70%公司和半数总市值受影响，形成缺失数据问题。这会使定量分析不成比例地偏向大公司、对小公司不利（因数据有限常被排除）。传统抽取方法（Regex、BERT）在解析复杂10-K文件时极为脆弱，未考虑属性可能位于不同章节或脚注，导致文件中实际存在的数据被丢失。因此需评估LLM以找到各模型在抽取特定属性上的优势与不足。

Method: 评估多种LLM（Llama-3 8B、Qwen-2.5 14B、Llama-3.3 70B）从SEC 10-K文本中抽取特定财务属性。选取四个结构复杂度不同的财务变量：现金及现金等价物（表格型）、短期债务（混合型）、信贷额度（叙述型）、研发（混合型）。对比传统Regex与BERT方法，并考察负向提示、参数规模与文档复杂度匹配对零样本准确率的影响。

Result: 较小模型（Llama-3 8B）在复杂负向提示下性能下降；模型参数规模与文档复杂度对齐时零样本准确率高。Qwen-2.5 14B作为表格类专长者，在"现金"上F1为83.33%；Llama-3.3 70B能有效处理密集叙述性脚注，在"研发"上F1为76.92%。

Conclusion: 该可扩展框架通过更全面地分析SEC 10-K文件，弥补量化金融数据集的关键信息缺口，消除缺失数据偏差。模型选择应与文档结构复杂度匹配，以发挥各类LLM的专长。

Abstract: SEC 10-K filings contain substantial financial information that is not consistently captured in structured datasets, creating a missing-data problem affecting over 70% of firms and half of total market capitalization. This can disproportionately bias quantitative analysis against smaller firms, which may be excluded due to limited available data. Traditional financial extraction methods such as Regular Expressions (Regex) and BERT, have been widely used. However, they are highly brittle when parsing complex SEC 10-K filings, which leads to data that is existent in the files being lost since these methods do not consider that a data attribute could be located in a different section or a footnote. This study evaluates several Large Language Models (LLMs), including Llama-3 8B, Qwen-2.5 14B, and Llama-3.3 70B, to figure out individual model strengths and weaknesses when extracting specific attributes from SEC 10-K text. The extraction quality was evaluated across four financial variables of varying structural complexity: Cash and Cash Equivalents (tabular), Short-Term Debt (hybrid), Credit Facilities (narrative), and Research and Development (hybrid). Results show that while smaller models like Llama-3 8B experience performance degradation under complex negative prompting, aligning parameter scale with document complexity yields high zero-shot accuracy. Qwen-2.5 14B excels as a tabular specialist with an 83.33% F1 score on Cash, whereas Llama-3.3 70B effectively navigates dense narrative footnotes, achieving a 76.92% F1 score on R&D. This scalable framework addresses critical information gaps in quantitative finance datasets and eliminates missing-data bias through a more thorough analysis of the SEC 10-K files.

</details>


### [240] [PACT: Pairwise-Anchored Calibrated Tuning for Single-Token Typed Decisions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35865)
*Yida Lin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: PACT将对比对数据中的成对结构、证书可验证的证据必要性等转化为四项无需新标注的训练项，在不牺牲精度的前提下显著提升单token类型化决策模型的鲁棒性与稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单token类型化决策模型虽快速且能给出每个候选答案的概率，但仅用普通交叉熵训练，忽略了训练数据中大量可用结构（对比对、机器可验证证书、答案代码位置、评分字段的序数性），导致位置偏差、序数误差和种子间波动较大。

Method: 提出PACT，将对比对数据的三类结构转为四个无需新标注的训练项：对每对样本的差中之差（DiD）边际项，对任意共享logit偏移不变；针对答案代码位置偏差的置换一致性项；在证书验证的消融上下文上的证据必要性项；针对评分字段的序数传输代价，外加三参数上下文温度。

Result: 在冻结的324项留出集、三个种子上：精度与已发布方法相当（84.6% vs 85.2%，各种子McNemar p≥0.50）；答案重标注翻转率最低（9.8% vs 13.8%）；评分字段序数误差最低（MAE 0.232 vs 0.311）。与同优化器/调度但仅用交叉熵的对照相比，两个种子显著更准，种子间波动减半，NLL降低26%。种子匹配消融与预设证伪测试表明：无单一训练项能提升原始精度。

Conclusion: PACT的价值在于鲁棒性与稳定性而非头条精度；其增益来自多项结构约束的协同作用，而非任何单一训练项。

Abstract: Single-token typed-decision models answer a schema question by reading the logits of a few one-letter answer codes at a single position: they are fast and return a probability for every allowed answer, but they are trained with plain cross-entropy that ignores most of the structure in their training data. We study such a model whose data is curated as contrastive pairs---two contexts that differ in one edited fact that flips the answer---each carrying a machine-checked certificate that deleting the decisive sentence makes the fact unknown. We propose PACT, which turns this structure into four training terms that need no new annotation: a difference-in-differences margin over each pair that is invariant to any shared logit offset, a permutation-consistency term against answer-code position bias, an evidence-necessity term on certificate-verified ablated contexts, and an ordinal transport cost for rubric fields, plus a three-parameter contextual temperature. On a frozen 324-item holdout with three seeds, PACT matches the published recipe in accuracy ($84.6\%$ vs. $85.2\%$; McNemar $p \ge 0.50$ at every seed) while giving the lowest position bias of all runs (answer flips under relabelling $9.8\%$ vs. $13.8\%$) and the lowest ordinal error on rubric fields (MAE $0.232$ vs. $0.311$). Against a control with the same optimiser and schedule but cross-entropy only, PACT is significantly more accurate at two of three seeds, halves the seed-to-seed spread and lowers NLL by $26\%$. Seed-matched ablations and pre-specified falsification tests locate these gains precisely: no single term raises raw accuracy, and the method's value lies in robustness and stability rather than headline accuracy. Code, data splits, trained adapters, and all run records are available at https://github.com/BennyLinntu/PACT-Pairwise-Anchored-Calibrated-Tuning-for-Single-Token-Typed-Decisions.

</details>


### [241] [CruxBench: A Benchmark of Information Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35879)
*Hui Dai,Lina Piao,Nick Merrill,Nadja Flechner,Ezra Karger,Haifeng Xu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出CruxBench基准，用信息价值（VOI）衡量LLM生成关键子问题（crux）的能力，发现其与模型能力高度相关，但前沿模型在信息发现上仍仅略优于随机基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM基准多以固定参考答案的准确率评估模型，但真实复杂任务的关键在于判断哪些问题值得提出——即把难题分解为提供关键解题步骤的子问题（crux）。这一"信息发现"能力缺乏合适评测手段。

Method: 提出CruxBench基准，按信息价值（VOI）对LLM生成的提问打分——即模型提出的crux能在多大程度上更新对目标预测问题的信念。该基准具备三特性：由未来世界事件生成真值故抗污染、开放式文本提交、以真实世界信念的量化变化为接地。在293个目标预测问题上评估8个模型。

Result: VOI与独立的模型能力测度高度相关（r=0.90），并能捕捉crux对回答目标问题的有用性。但信息发现对前沿LLM仍具挑战，其表现仅略微优于随机时机基线。

Conclusion: CruxBench为评估LLM的信息发现能力提供了抗污染、开放式且接地的基准；结果表明信息发现是一项目前尚未解决的、区分模型能力的关键任务，即便前沿模型也远未掌握。

Abstract: Benchmarks for large language models (LLMs) typically evaluate the accuracy of answers against fixed reference labels. But a central step in many complex real-world tasks is identifying which questions are worth asking in the first place: decomposing a difficult problem into subquestions -- which we call cruxes -- whose answers provide key steps on the path toward solving the target problem. To evaluate this capability of information discovery, we introduce CruxBench, a benchmark that grades LLM-generated questions by their Value of Information (VOI): how much a model-proposed crux updates beliefs about a target forecasting question. CruxBench enjoys a rare combination of three key properties: it is (1) contamination-resistant by construction, since ground truth is generated by future world events; (2) open-ended, admitting unbounded and complex text-based submissions rather than one correct numeric answer; and (3) grounded, with informativeness measured against quantified changes in real-world beliefs. We evaluate a diverse set of eight models on 293 target forecasting questions and find that VOI correlates highly with independent measures of model capability (r=0.90) and captures cruxes' usefulness for answering target questions. However, information discovery remains challenging even for frontier LLMs, which only narrowly outperform a random-timing baseline.

</details>


### [242] [Almost Human, Except When It Matters: VoxParity and the Decisions a Voice Should Change](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35922)
*Bhavik Mangla*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: VoxParity 是一个音频-文本对照基准：183 个场景中固定转写文本、只改变音频，检验语音智能体是否依据"听到的内容"改变工具调用决策。23 个可同时以纯文本运行的系统中仅 11 个通过词级零假设检验，错误普遍偏向"照字面执行"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有语音智能体评估多以转写文本为核心，可能忽略行业规则明确要求依赖的听觉线索——如紧急呼叫、欺诈防范、无线电通话用语与弱势群体保护规范中，说话人的声音状态或背景音会改变正确处置方式。论文旨在检验智能体是否真正"听进去"并对音频信息采取行动，而非仅依赖词面语义。

Method: 构建 VoxParity：覆盖 14 个行业的 183 个场景，每个场景保持转写文本不变、仅替换音频（如指导性语气、医疗监护仪鸣响、无线电检查中插入的求救信号、药品名被噪声掩盖、儿童下注声、恐惧低语），并相应改变正确的结构化工具调用。设计"纯文本零假设检验"：系统须证明"听到通话"对其动作的改变幅度显著大于一个仅读文本的流水线，方可记为通过。

Result: 在 23 个可同时在纯文本上运行的系统里，仅 11 个通过检验。误差呈"向文本倾斜"：当音频要求保护性处置时，全部 28 个系统执行常规请求的频率高于在干净通话上过度反应的频率（合并后 41% vs 12%；纯文本流水线为 58% vs 15%）。探索性分析显示：领先系统的大部分失误落在其确实听到的线索上；系统几乎只在明确陈述规则的条目上优于零假设；领先系统忽视"听到的顺从或困惑"的频率远高于忽视"急性惊慌"；在所测模型中，描述声音与陈述规则各自能弥补部分差距，但在情绪维度上仍存缺口。

Conclusion: 语音智能体的失效并非主要源于"没听见"，而是听见了却未按音频线索改变行动——即感知与决策之间的脱节。音频信息仅在规则被显式陈述时才较易被采纳，情绪类线索（惊慌、恐惧、顺从、困惑）最易被忽略。提示或输入层补充"描述声音"和"陈述规则"可部分缓解，但情绪线索缺口难以仅靠文本化描述填平，说明需在模型对副语言信息的表征与决策耦合上进一步改进。

Abstract: A voice agent can handle almost every call on the words alone and still fail the few its sector's rules were written for. Emergency-call standards, fraud guidance, radio phraseology and vulnerability rules recognise that how a caller sounds, or what else is audible, can change the right action. VoxParity tests whether agents act on it. In 183 scenarios from 14 sectors, one transcript stays fixed while the audio changes (a coaching voice, a medical monitor beeping, a mayday under a radio check, noise over a drug name, a child's voice placing a bet, a frightened whisper), and with it the correct typed tool call. A words-only null test credits a system only if hearing the call moves its actions more than it moves a pipeline that only reads the words. Only 11 of the 23 systems that can also be run on the transcript pass. Descriptively, errors run toward the words: when the audio calls for protection, all 28 systems carry out the routine request more often than they over-react on clean calls (41% against 12% pooled; the words-only pipeline, 58% against 15%). Exploratory analyses place most of the leading systems' misses on cues they heard; systems beat the null almost entirely on items that state the rule; the leading systems overrule heard resignation or confusion far more often than acute alarm; and, in the models tested, describing the voice and stating the rule each recover part of the shortfall, leaving a gap on emotion.

</details>


### [243] [Question-Specific Knowledge Graphs for Efficient Visual Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35942)
*Ting-Chih Chen,Emile van Krieken,Shujian Yu,Filip Ilievski*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: VisKG 提出一种强化学习框架，让视觉语言模型将图像翻译为问题特定的知识图谱表示，过滤感知噪声并保留推理所需的实体-关系结构，在科学、数学和通用视觉理解任务上以更少 token 达到或超过基线性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉问答方法通过详细图像描述提升推理能力，但会引入与任务无关的视觉细节，导致输入 token 数量膨胀和计算成本上升；模型需要在不引入虚假假设的前提下，暴露并对齐支持推理的显式与隐式知识。

Method: VisKG 采用强化学习框架，学习将视觉内容翻译为问题特定的知识图谱（KG）表示，遵循最小充分信息原则过滤感知噪声并保留思维链推理所需的实体-关系结构；为稳定 RL 后训练，采用组奖励解耦归一化策略优化（GDPO）；并在监督阶段引入负向理由样本，使模型在 RL 前接触错误推理路径。

Result: 在科学、数学和通用视觉理解基准上，VisKG 性能与基线相当或更优，且所需 token 少于基于描述的方法；使用 GDPO 训练相比 GRPO 平均提升 2% 准确率。

Conclusion: 知识图谱表示是支持多步推理的有效途径，并为未来自适应选择最适合特定任务表示形式的研究开辟了方向。

Abstract: Recent work in visual question answering has shown that vision-language models can exhibit strong reasoning capabilities by translating visual inputs into textual representations. The effectiveness of this translation depends on how well visual details are retained; models need to surface and align both explicit and implicit knowledge sufficient to support reasoning, without introducing spurious assumptions. Existing methods that leverage detailed image captions introduce visual details unrelated to the reasoning task, inflating input token counts and increasing computational cost. To address these challenges, we propose VisKG, a reinforcement learning (RL) framework in which models learn to translate visual content into question-specific knowledge graph (KG) representations. This process filters out perceptual noise while preserving the entity-relation structure needed for chain-of-thought reasoning, following the principle of minimum sufficient information. To ensure stable RL post-training, VisKG adopts Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization (GDPO). In addition, we strengthen the supervision stage with negative rationale samples, exposing the model to incorrect reasoning paths before RL post-training. Experimental results across science, mathematics, and general visual understanding benchmarks show that VisKG achieves performance comparable to or better than baselines, while requiring fewer tokens than caption-based representations. Moreover, training VisKG with GDPO improves accuracy by 2% over its GRPO-trained counterpart on average. These results suggest that KG representations are a promising approach for supporting multi-step reasoning and open up future work on adaptively selecting the most suitable representation for a given task.

</details>


### [244] [Causal and Interpretable Structures in LLM Compositional Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35970)
*Gurbir Arora,Toni J. B. Liu,Jiajun Bao,Raphaël Sarfati,Christopher J. Earls*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文研究Transformer各层如何在几何与因果层面表征并逐步组合"关系信息"，揭示中间层到后期层的层级递进机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型能解决依赖token间关系而非单个token的任务，但此类关系信息如何在Transformer各层被表征与处理尚不清楚，需要同时从几何和因果角度加以刻画。

Method: 构造需要推断三个token之间关系的提示集合（对应循环概念：月份、小时、星期、音符），采集模型激活；跨Llama、Qwen、Gemma、Mistral多模型族进行线性/联合表征的几何分析与因果干预（如消融、激活限制）。

Result: 发现一致的层级递进：中间层使用基于两token推断关系的联合表征，后期层使用涉及全部三token的联合表征以完成任务；还存在几何结构化但对下一token预测不因果的其它token关系；仅保留因果相关的联合表征反而提升下一token预测准确率。

Conclusion: 几何与因果分析共同揭示了Transformer逐步组织并组合关系信息以形成答案的表征层机制，且因果相关联合表征的筛选可提升预测性能。

Abstract: Large language models are able to solve tasks whose answers depend on not only individual input tokens, but also on relations among them. How is such relational information represented and processed across transformer layers? We study activations from ensembles of prompts that require inferring relationships between three tokens corresponding to a cyclic concept (months, hours, weekdays, and musical notes) to correctly predict the next token.
