Result: 在Qwen3-4B与Qwen3-8B的数学推理任务上，两种设置下均稳定优于标准OPSD，rollout-privileged设置下分别从27.50提升至41.30、从48.80提升至64.44。

Conclusion: 未来学习进度可以反向蒸馏，在保留已获得知识的同时超越产生该进度的优化状态，为自改进模型提供了更广泛的原则。

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) improves large language models by letting a self-teacher with privileged information provide dense token-level supervision on the model's own trajectories. Yet existing methods typically construct the self-teacher from the current, initial, or slowly averaged policy state, leaving the quality of supervision constrained by the teacher's ability to exploit privileged information. We ask whether the model's own optimization progress can instead be recycled into a stronger self-teacher. In this paper, we introduce Bootstrapped On-Policy Self-Distillation (B-OPSD), which temporarily trains the policy ahead to obtain a future teacher, restores the student to the original policy state, and then uses the future teacher to supervise the restarted student. The future teacher improves supervision in two complementary ways, it can generate more reliable privileged trajectories and, conditioned on them, provide more informative token-level targets along the restarted student's on-policy trajectories. Experiments on mathematical reasoning with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B show consistent improvements over standard OPSD in both settings, including gains from 27.50 to 41.30 and from 48.80 to 64.44 in the rollout-privileged setting. Our findings point to a broader principle for self-improving models that future learning progress can be distilled backward, preserving acquired knowledge while bootstrapping beyond the optimization state that produced it.

</details>


### [483] [From Judgment Quality to Downstream Utility: Rethinking LLM-as-a-Judge for Open-Ended Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37145)
*Zheng Zhang,Lufei Li,Xinyue Tan,Yuanhao Zeng,Ziwei Shan,Yexin Li,Kan Ren*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了LLM-as-a-Judge在开放式任务中的评判质量与下游效用，发现二者并不总是一致，Judge协议设计显著影响两者，且Judge引导可将测试时计算有效转化为性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作多将Judge的判断直接作为策略训练的奖励信号，对判断本身的内在质量关注有限，且主要将Judge限制在训练时监督阶段，忽视了其质量的系统评估与更广泛的下游用途。

Method: 从判断获取与判断使用两方面展开：判断获取沿三个维度改变Judge协议——裁决粒度、批评（critique）使用、评估批处理；判断使用除策略训练外，扩展到测试时推理，包括Best-of-N选择、Judge引导的修正与束搜索。

Result: (i) 判断质量与下游效用并不总是对齐；(ii) Judge协议设计对内在判断质量与下游效用均有显著影响；(iii) Judge引导能有效将测试时计算转化为性能增益，且收益随推理策略不同而变化。

Conclusion: 呼吁对开放式任务中的LLM Judge进行多维度评估，同时涵盖内在判断质量与下游效用。

Abstract: LLM-as-a-Judge is increasingly used to evaluate policy responses on open-ended tasks that lack ground-truth answers. Existing work often directly converts the resulting judgments into reward signals for policy training, paying limited attention to intrinsic judgment quality and largely restricting the use of Judges to training-time supervision. We systematically investigate judgment quality and downstream utility by examining both how judgments are elicited and how they are used. For judgment elicitation, we vary the Judge protocol along three dimensions: verdict granularity, critique usage, and evaluation batching. For judgment usage, beyond policy training, we extend Judge to test-time inference through Best-of-N selection, Judge-guided revision, and beam search. We find that, (i) Surprisingly, judgment quality and downstream utility do not always align. (ii) Judge protocol design substantially affects both intrinsic judgment quality and downstream utility. (iii) Judge guidance effectively converts test-time compute into performance gains, with benefits varying across inference strategies. Our results call for a multifaceted evaluation of LLM Judges on open-ended tasks, encompassing intrinsic judgment quality, and downstream utility.

</details>


### [484] [When Tools Silently Lie: Evaluating and Mitigating Blind Compliance in Tool-Augmented Data Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37153)
*Zifu Tao,Changqing Yin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 ToxicBench，用于度量工具增强数据智能体在中毒观测下的“检查”与“采纳”行为，发现中毒使任务成功率下降26–39个百分点，且重复中毒会引发“检查后仍采纳错误答案”。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工具增强数据智能体依赖工具输出做分析决策，但成功执行可能返回“看似合理却错误”的证据，智能体需判断是否信任或核验。理解此类失败需同时考察两件事：通过检查所获得的证据，以及最终采纳的答案。

Method: 提出 ToxicBench，针对数值、标签、模式（schema）与检索四类错误，在固定源数据上配对“干净观测”与“中毒观测”；在118个任务上对GPT及三种适配器进行评估；通过一次性与重复性中毒区分重试效果；在三个公开表格上设置对照以隔离“所供证据”对恢复的影响；冻结评分器后，将其判断与200条轨迹的人工标注进行比对。

Result: 中毒使任务成功率降低26至39个百分点；普通重试在一次性中毒下有效，但重复中毒暴露出“检查后仍采纳错误答案”的现象；评分器与人工标注在任务成功判定上达到96%一致；人工判断支持重试相较Base的增益，并在受审任务上确认了检查后的错误采纳。

Conclusion: 证据可获取性与答案选择是智能体可靠性的两个互补维度；作者发布轨迹、版本化评分以及参考与交付审计，以支撑后续研究。

Abstract: Tool-augmented data agents rely on tool outputs for analytical decisions. Yet successful execution can return plausible but incorrect evidence, requiring agents to decide whether to trust or verify it. Understanding this failure requires examining both the evidence obtained through checking and the answer ultimately adopted. We introduce ToxicBench to measure checking and adoption under numerical, label, schema, and retrieval errors, pairing clean and poisoned observations over fixed source data. In the 118-task GPT evaluation across three adapters, poisoning lowers task success by 26 to 39 percentage points. Ordinary retries help under one-shot poisoning, whereas repeated poisoning reveals wrong-answer adoption after checking. Controls on three public tables isolate how supplied evidence affects recovery. After freezing the scorer, we compare its judgments with human annotations on 200 trajectories, finding 96% task-success agreement. Human judgments support retry gains over Base and confirm adoption after checking on audited tasks. We release trajectories, versioned scoring, and reference and delivery audits. These findings highlight evidence availability and answer selection as complementary dimensions of agent reliability.

</details>


### [485] [From Learner Behavior to Reusable Skills for Effective and Efficient Learner Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37157)
*Zijian Chen,Zheng Zhang,Miao Jia,Xingchen Hu,Weibo Gao,Linan Yue*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出 Learner2Skill，将学习者模拟能力从历史交互中外部化为持久可复用的仿真技能（Simulation Skill）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的学习者模拟方法需要反复处理不断增长的交互历史以重建学习者，带来额外上下文与推理成本，且获得的模拟能力难以在不同 LLM 间复用。

Method: 将历史交互中习得的模拟能力外化为一个持久、可复用的 Simulation Skill；该技能捕捉学习者当前学习状态与反复出现的响应模式，随新交互持续演化，并可通过轻量级的执行器校准（executor calibration）适配到新的 LLM，无需从头重建学习者。

Result: 实验表明，Learner2Skill 在更忠实地复现细粒度学习者行为的同时降低了总体 token 成本，且同一构建的技能可在不同 LLM 执行器间有效复用。

Conclusion: 通过将模拟能力外化为可持久化、可演化、可迁移的技能，Learner2Skill 提升了学习者模拟的保真度与成本效率，并实现了跨 LLM 的能力复用。

Abstract: Learner simulation aims to reproduce how a particular learner behaves on new tasks. Although Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate increasingly fine-grained learning behaviors, existing approaches often need to repeatedly process a growing interaction history to reconstruct the learner. This introduces additional context and inference costs and makes the acquired learner-specific simulation capability difficult to reuse across different LLMs. We therefore propose Learner2Skill, which externalizes the simulation capability acquired from historical interactions into a persistent and reusable Simulation Skill. The Skill captures the learner's current learning state and recurring response patterns, evolves as new real interactions arrive, and can be adapted to a new LLM through lightweight executor calibration without reconstructing the learner from scratch. Experiments show that Learner2Skill more faithfully reproduces fine-grained learner behavior while reducing overall token cost, and that the same constructed Skills can be effectively reused across different LLM executors.

</details>


### [486] [SimpleEvol: An Agent-Loop Framework for LLM-Driven Automated Heuristic Design with Minimal Human Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37172)
*Jianghan Zhu,Cong Zhang,Rongjie Zhu,Chi Zhang,Zhiguang Cao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出衡量AHD框架"人工先验度"(AHI)与"智能转化效率"(ICE)的指标，发现人类先验越少的框架ICE越高，据此提出几乎去除全部人工先验的智能体循环框架SimpleEvol，在三个组合优化问题上取得最高ICE。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前主流的自动化启发式设计(AHD)范式将LLM当作进化框架中固定的狭窄组件（如交叉、变异算子），把通用推理器误用为专用工具，限制其自主性；同时框架中大量人工先验违背了"苦涩教训"——随算力扩展的通用方法终将胜过手工方案。因此需要回答：哪种AHD框架设计最能将更强的LLM能力转化为更好的启发式。

Method: 1) 提出两个度量：框架人工先验度AHI与智能转化效率ICE；2) 在三个具有挑战性的组合优化问题上评测十种LLM，比较不同先验程度框架的ICE；3) 基于"人工先验越少ICE越高"的发现，设计SimpleEvol——一个几乎移除全部人工先验、让LLM自主运作的智能体循环(AI agent loop)式AHD框架。

Result: 评测十种LLM、三个组合优化问题后发现：人工先验更少的框架ICE一致性更高；SimpleEvol在各框架中ICE最高，且往往大幅领先。

Conclusion: 结果挑战了AHD流水线日益复杂的趋势，指向更轻量、更以模型为中心的替代方案；减少人工先验是随模型智能扩展的更有效策略。代码已开源。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have emerged as powerful tools for automated heuristic design (AHD), enabling iterative generation and refinement of heuristics. However, the dominant paradigm embeds LLMs as narrow, fixed components, such as crossover or mutation, within heavily hand-engineered evolutionary frameworks. We argue this misapprehends LLMs. It treats them as specialized tools rather than general reasoners, constrains them to low-level operations, and underutilizes their autonomy. Moreover, the extensive human priors in these frameworks violate the bitter lesson principle that general methods scaling with computation surpass hand-crafted solutions. This raises a key question: which AHD framework designs best convert stronger LLM capabilities into better heuristics? To address this, we propose metrics for LLM-driven AHD framework handcraftedness (AHI) and intelligence conversion efficiency (ICE). Evaluating ten LLMs across three challenging combinatorial optimization problems, we obtain a notable finding that frameworks with fewer human priors consistently yield higher ICE. Based on this finding, we propose SimpleEvol, an agent-loop framework for AHD which removes nearly all human priors and allows the LLM to operate autonomously. SimpleEvol consistently achieves the highest ICE, often by a large margin. Our results challenge the trend toward complex AHD pipelines and point to a lighter and more model-centric alternative, suggesting that reducing human priors is a more effective strategy to scale up with model intelligence. The source code is available at https://github.com/HenryZhu1029/SimpleEvol-Master.

</details>


### [487] [Absorbed in Inertia: Activation Analysis for Computer-Use Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37176)
*Giulio Segalini,Zhi Wen Soi,Jérémie Decouchant,Lydia Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文发现计算机使用型智能体存在"惯性"现象，即虽识别出无效动作仍反复执行，并揭示其对应激活空间的吸收区域，提出R³方法以打破惯性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计算机使用智能体能够基于自然语言指令在实时桌面上执行任务，但作者发现它们会隐蔽地表现出"惯性"（inertia）——即使认识到某些动作无效，仍会重复执行这些无果动作。这一失效模式影响任务完成的可靠性。

Method: 作者假设惯性反映在智能体底层模型的内部状态（激活值）中，提出测量二者关系的协议。通过对高维激活状态的分析，发现惯性对应激活空间中的"吸收区域"（absorbing region），其中激活值在多次动作后乃至尝试引导后都变得陈旧。据此提出R³（Reset, Reroute, Restore）方法：临时重置智能体的上下文轨迹以逃离吸收区域，随后恢复历史上下文以完成任务。

Result: 相较于未修改的智能体，R³在多个模型上使测得的惯性降低了17-55%。

Conclusion: 结果表明，改变上下文比直接引导产生的激活值更能有效中断动作的重复循环。代码已开源。

Abstract: Computer-use agents have become increasingly capable of executing tasks on live desktops through natural-language instructions, based on trajectories of screenshots, actions, and reasoning. We discover that they can stealthily exhibit inertia, in which they repeat fruitless actions despite recognizing that these actions are ineffective. We hypothesize that inertia is reflected in the agent's internal state, i.e., the activation values of the agent's underlying model, and propose a protocol to measure the relationship between the two. Extensive analysis of high-dimensional activation states shows that inertia corresponds to an absorbing region of activation space, where activation values become stale across actions and even after attempts to steer them. We conjecture that drastically changing the agents' activations by re-initializing them is necessary to escape inertia. Specifically, we propose R$^3$ (Reset, Reroute, Restore), which temporarily resets the agent's context trajectory to escape the absorbing region and then restores the historical context to effectively complete the task. Our approach yields 17-55% lower measured inertia across models relative to unmodified agents. These results suggest that changing the context can interrupt recurrence more effectively than directly steering the resulting activations. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/vlm-agent-defense-D076

</details>


### [488] [Accelerated surrogate dynamics for dynamical, stochastic system evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37184)
*Marco Jochum,Ioannis Kouroudis,Gohar Ali Siddiqui,Taher Amine Hamzaoui,Manuel Gößwein,Alessio Gagliardi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出VAE+Temporal Fusion Transformer的代理框架，实现高维随机系统动态的低成本、高保真模拟，并具备不确定性量化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态模拟计算成本高昂，尤其在随机框架下；传统时间序列模型受限于高维特征空间，且仅关注长程或短程效应，长期运行会出现局部或全局漂移，难以作为可靠的模拟代理。

Method: 框架分两步：1) 用带卷积或图基底的变分自编码器（VAE）降维，得到低维潜向量以压缩系统维度；2) 用Temporal Fusion Transformer对潜向量进行时间传播，同时编码长程与短程效应并支持静态协变量。整体可灵活适配新系统，并内置不确定性量化用于实验设计。

Result: 在三个不同案例上验证鲁棒性，结果与原始仿真几乎完全一致，而计算时间仅为仿真的一小部分。

Conclusion: 该框架有效克服高维与长短期效应建模瓶颈，可作为通用、快速、带不确定性量化的动态系统模拟代理，支持针对性实验设计。

Abstract: Dynamic simulations are an entrenched way of gaining insight into the evolution of system dynamics. Their computational cost however is often prohibitively high, especially in cases of stochastic frameworks. Machine learning algorithms are especially suited as simulation surrogates. Nevertheless, they face some very distinct limitations. Firstly, the sheer dimensionality of these systems, however, precludes the use of traditional time series models who struggle with high dimensional feature spaces. Additionally, traditional time series focus exclusively on either long or short range effects, causing local or global drift given enough time. In this paper, we propose a framework that addresses those limitations. Our framework combines a Variational Autoencoder, with a convolutional or graph basis that reduces the dimensionality of the system. This latent vector is propagated in time using a Temporal Fusion Transformer model, which includes both long range and short range effect encoding, as well as static covariate support. We test our framework on three distinct cases, to prove its robustness and in all three we have achieved practically identical to the simulation results at a fraction of the time. Further, our framework is flexible enough to be adapted to any new system and provides an inbuilt uncertainty quantification for targeted experiment design.

</details>


### [489] [V-Engram: Trigger-Indexed External Memory for Modular Text-to-Image Personalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37198)
*Haoran He,Runyuan Cai,Yiming Wang,Lin Yu,Xiaodong Zeng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 V-Engram：为 Stable Diffusion 3.5 引入触发词索引的外部记忆机制，将概念记忆与骨干网络适配解耦，实现少样本视觉身份定制与组合控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练文生图模型虽具备广泛视觉知识，但仅凭少量参考图难以可靠获取或精炼特定视觉身份，同时保持组合控制能力。Token 嵌入方法紧凑但常对身份欠拟合；基于适配器的方法虽提升保真度，却需持久化权重更新，存储成本高，且在概念组合时易相互干扰。

Method: V-Engram 为每个概念分配显式触发词，触发词检索概念专属记忆；记忆的门控方向以相对残差形式注入冻结的文本编码器与 MMDiT 上下文状态。该记忆与骨干适配分离，从而支持提示选择性访问与多概念访问，无需合并模型更新。推理时采用提示匹配加载，仅检索匹配条目。

Result: 整体主体保真度与 DreamBooth-LoRA 相当，在上下文主体保持等场景中表现更优。提示匹配加载仅检索匹配条目，显著减少单概念查询时额外适配状态的加载量。定性结果显示可实现成对触发词组合与同类概念分离；未注册条目的提示仍保持冻结模型的基础行为。

Conclusion: 触发词索引记忆可作为一种模块化接口，在不重写生成器的前提下为模型注入针对性视觉证据。

Abstract: Pretrained text-to-image models contain broad visual knowledge, yet they cannot reliably acquire or refine a specific visual identity from only a few references while preserving compositional control. Token-embedding methods are compact but often underfit identity, whereas adapter-based methods improve fidelity through persistent weight updates that can be costly to store and interfere when concepts are composed. We introduce V-Engram, a trigger-indexed external memory mechanism for Stable Diffusion 3.5. Each concept is assigned an explicit trigger that retrieves concept-specific memory, whose gated directions enter frozen text-encoder and MMDiT context states as relative residuals. Separating this memory from backbone adaptation enables prompt-selective and multi-concept access without merging model updates. Experiments show that V-Engram broadly matches DreamBooth-LoRA in overall subject fidelity while showing advantages in settings such as contextual subject preservation. Prompt-matched loading retrieves only matched entries, reducing most additional adaptation-state loading for a single-concept query. Qualitative results further demonstrate paired-trigger composition and same-class separation, while prompts without registered entries retain the frozen model's base behavior. Together, these results establish trigger-indexed memory as a modular interface for adding targeted visual evidence without rewriting the generator.

</details>


### [490] [Learning to Prove, Not Just to Answer: Reinforcement Learning from Formal Verification for Natural-Language Logical Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37203)
*Qili Zhang,Qianren Mao,Hanze Cai,Kaiming Zhao,Yuening He,Xihan Lei,Yashuo Luo,Hanwen Hao,Yutong Gu,Likang Xiao,Zhijun Chen,Weifeng Jiang,Haoyi Zhou,Jianxin Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Proof-R1是一个基于形式化验证的强化学习框架，通过UNSAT机器可检验验证与答案支撑依赖闭包，训练LLM为自然语言逻辑推理构建可验证证明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然语言逻辑推理中，最终答案易校验但证明过程不易校验。现有方法缺乏对中间结论与答案支撑证明依赖的机器可检验验证，可能将奖励错误分配给无效或与答案无关的推理步骤。

Method: Proof-R1从形式化验证出发，仅当推理动作通过基于UNSAT的机器可检验形式化验证、满足证明义务时，才将生成的结论纳入已验证证明状态；同时恢复答案支撑依赖闭包，追踪最终答案的证明结构，使结果奖励与证明依赖对齐。

Result: 在三个逻辑推理基准和四个骨干模型上，Proof-R1提升了答案准确率；在推理过程可验证性方面，优于免训练智能体方法和基于训练的方法。

Conclusion: Proof-R1表明，将形式化验证的证明义务与依赖闭包引入强化学习，可实现自然语言逻辑推理的可检验证明构建，同时提升答案准确率与过程可验证性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed for natural-language logical reasoning, where the final answer is easy to check but the proof behind it is not. In natural-language logical reasoning, an intermediate conclusion should follow from its premises, and the resulting derivation should support the final answer. Existing methods lack machine-checkable verification of intermediate conclusions and answer-supporting proof dependencies, so they may assign credit to invalid or answer-irrelevant steps. We propose Proof-R1, an RL framework from formal verification that trains LLMs to construct verifiable proofs for natural-language logical reasoning. Proof-R1 admits a generated conclusion into the verified proof state only when the corresponding reasoning action satisfies the proof obligations through UNSAT-based machine-checkable formal verification. Proof-R1 also recovers the answer-supporting dependency closure to trace the proof structure of the final answer and align outcome credit with the proof dependencies. Experiments demonstrate that Proof-R1 improves answer accuracy across three logical reasoning benchmarks and four backbone models and outperforms training-free agents and training-based methods in terms of reasoning-process verifiability.

</details>


### [491] [Information Bottleneck-Guided Adaptive Hypergraph Transformer for Brain Disease Diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37220)
*Jingxi Feng,Xudong Chen,Yifan Zhang,Heming Xu,Hongcheng Han,Xijing Wang,Dong Zhang,Shaoyi Du*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出信息瓶颈引导的自适应超图Transformer（IBAHGT），在统一框架内自适应学习脑网络的高阶相关性与短/长程依赖，实现高精度脑疾病诊断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究缺乏对脑网络中高阶信息与长程依赖信息的统一整合，且不同类型信息存在大量冗余，限制了其在脑疾病诊断中的效果。

Method: IBAHGT包含三个组件：（1）信息瓶颈引导的自适应超图卷积，提出超图信息瓶颈（HIB）原理，自适应学习节点与超边间的消息传递权重，优化信息流，捕获最大信息量、最小冗余（MIMR）的高阶信息；（2）Transformer编码器，通过注意力机制建模脑网络中的短程与长程依赖，捕获全局信息；（3）信息瓶颈引导的节点级自适应融合，基于IB原理为每个节点学习独立权重，实现高阶信息与全局信息的细粒度整合。

Result: 大量实验表明，所提方法优于当前最先进方法，并能识别具有临床应用价值的生物标志物。

Conclusion: IBAHGT通过信息瓶颈原则统一整合高阶与长程依赖信息并抑制冗余，为脑网络分析提供了高效表示，兼顾诊断精度与生物标志物发现。

Abstract: Exploring high-order correlations and long-range dependencies in brain networks holds significant value for both neuroscience research and clinical diagnosis. However, previous studies have lacked a unified integration of high-order and long-range dependency information in brain networks, and there is substantial redundancy behind various types of information. These issues limit their effectiveness in the diagnosis of brain diseases. To address this, we propose an Information Bottleneck-Guided Adaptive HyperGraph Transformer (IBAHGT). By incorporating the information bottleneck (IB) principle, this approach enables adaptive learning of high-order correlations and both short- and long-range dependencies within a unified framework for brain network analysis, achieving high-precision brain disease diagnosis. IBAHGT consists of three key components: an information bottleneck-guided adaptive hypergraph convolution, which introduces a novel hypergraph information bottleneck (HIB) principle to adaptively learn hypergraph message-passing weights between nodes and hyperedges, optimizes information flow and captures high-order information in brain networks that is maximally informative and minimally redundant (MIMR). The Transformer encoder captures global information within brain networks through the attention mechanism, specifically modeling short- and long-range dependencies. An information bottleneck-guided node-level adaptive fusion employs the IB principle to learn independent weights for each node, facilitating the fine-grained integration of high-order information and global information to obtain an efficient representation for downstream tasks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms current state-of-the-art methods and can identify biomarkers for clinical applications.

</details>


### [492] [OptiCom : A Unified Framework for State-Conditioned Composition in LLM-Driven Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37221)
*Chenxing Wei,Sichen Liu,Lizhao Liu,Ningyuan Sun,Chen Bingzhou,Ying He,Bo Jiang,Fei Yu,Yao Shu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出OptiCom统一框架，将LLM优化器建模为共享配置空间C=(A,Q,O,E,M,S)，通过快慢双控制器动态组合优化机制，在32个基准组中取得平均Max-score排名1.72、23组最优的成绩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM被越来越多地用于通过迭代优化求解复杂科学与实际问题，但如何随着候选质量、失败模式和资源预算的变化动态协调多样化的搜索机制仍是关键开放挑战。实证诊断表明机制有效性高度依赖状态，因此需要一个能刻画决策对最终结果影响的统一理论框架来指导机制选择。

Method: 作者首先分析单个决策如何驱动最终结果，将共享预算下的期望终端改进分解为累积决策机会减去累积选择损失，形成"机会—损失"理论基础。基于此提出OptiCom框架：在统一配置空间C=(A,Q,O,E,M,S)（artifact、query、operator、evaluation、memory、strategy）中表示LLM驱动优化器；由快速的LLM Optimization Controller通过结构化Action Packages动态组合即时机制，较慢的Strategy Adapter基于累积轨迹反馈优化长期选择偏好、算子权重与模板。

Result: 在32个基准组上的综合评估显示OptiCom在14种评估配置中平均Max-score排名为1.72，并在23个组中获得最高分，体现了其作为通用鲁棒LLM测试时扩展范式的广泛适用性与高可扩展性。

Conclusion: OptiCom通过机会—损失理论指导与配置空间统一建模，实现了状态自适应的搜索机制协调，验证了其在多样基准上的优越性能，可作为通用LLM测试时扩展范式。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed to solve complex scientific and practical problems via iterative optimization. However, dynamically coordinating diverse search mechanisms as candidate quality, failure modes, and resource budgets evolve remains a critical open challenge. Targeted empirical diagnostics reveal that mechanism effectiveness is highly state-dependent. Motivated by this, we analyze how individual decisions drive final outcomes, decomposing the expected terminal improvement under a shared budget into cumulative decision opportunities minus cumulative selection losses. Guided by this opportunity-loss theoretical foundation, we propose OptiCom, a unified framework that represents LLM-driven optimizers within a shared configuration space: C=(A,Q,O,E,M,S), corresponding to artifact, query, operator, evaluation, memory, and strategy. Operating within this space, a fast LLM-based Optimization Controller dynamically composes immediate mechanisms through structured Action Packages, while a slower Strategy Adapter refines long-term selection preferences, operator weights, and templates based on accumulated trajectory feedback. Comprehensive evaluations across 32 benchmark groups demonstrate the superiority of framework: OptiCom achieves an average Max-score rank of 1.72 among 14 evaluated configurations, securing the top score in 23 groups. Ultimately, these results highlight the broad applicability and high extensibility of OptiCom as a general-purpose paradigm for robust LLM test-time scaling.

</details>


### [493] [Asking for What Was Never Requested: Horizontal and Vertical Proactivity in Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37236)
*Ido Levy,Asaf Yehudai,Segev Shlomov,Asaf Adi,Leshem Choshen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究主动性的"内容"维度，提出水平与垂直主动性两种形式及基于需求图的评测方法，并训练Q&D问题生成器，在检索预算相等下提升主动性并超越15倍大的提示模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有关于主动智能体的研究主要关注"是否、何时"自主行动，而忽略了"应主动获取何种信息"。完成任务常需用户未明示的信息，因此主动性的内容维度是一个未被探索的独立轴。

Method: 提出水平主动性（追求当前上下文已隐含的未言明信息）与垂直主动性（追求仅由更早证据揭示的需求）；从基准自身的任务分解中抽取"需求图"，记录需求间依赖关系，从而无需模型评判即可从对话记录中评分两种主动性及停止时机；提出Q&D（提问者与起草者），训练提问者偏好"其续写能检索到更多必要证据"的问题，无需奖励模型或评判器。

Result: 在三个多跳问答基准的留出划分上，相同检索预算下，训练后的提问者相较同模型提示版本在两种主动性上均有提升；在其中两个基准上超过同角色15倍大的提示模型，且该增益在控制问题数量与长度后仍存在。无需再训练即可将提问者用于模拟客户的交互式客服场景，任务完成更多而提问更少；在零售场景中以更少的客户追问轮次超过15倍大的模型。

Conclusion: 主动性不仅取决于智能体是否在未被要求时行动，还取决于它选择追求什么信息以及何时停止。

Abstract: An agent that uses tools typically responds to what the user explicitly asks, yet completing the task may require information the user never requested. Work on proactive agents mainly studies whether and when an agent should act on its own, not what information it should pursue. We study a distinct axis of proactivity: its content. Horizontal proactivity pursues unstated information that the current context already identifies, and vertical proactivity pursues needs that only earlier evidence reveals. A need graph, recovered from a benchmark's own decomposition, records which needs depend on which, so both forms, and whether the agent stops at the right time, can be scored from a transcript without a model judge. To learn this behavior, we propose Q&D (questioner and drafter), which trains a questioner to prefer the question whose continuation retrieves more of the required evidence, with no reward model or judge. On held-out splits of three multi-hop question-answering benchmarks, at equal retrieval spend, the trained questioner improves both forms of proactivity over the same model, prompted, and outperforms a prompted model $15\times$ larger in the same role on two of the three, and the gain persists after controlling for question volume and length. Without further training, we place the questioner in an interactive customer-service agent with a simulated customer, where it completes more tasks while asking fewer questions, and in retail it outperforms the $15\times$ larger model with fewer follow-up turns from the customer. These results show that proactivity depends not only on whether an agent acts without being asked, but also on what it chooses to pursue and when it stops.

</details>


### [494] [Foundations of Proactive Agents: Principles, Technical Layers, and Proactivity-Gym](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37267)
*Jio Oh,Seunghyun Do,Young-Jun Lee,Steven Euijong Whang,Dongyeop Kang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出以"3T"（Task Capability、Temporal Allocation、Trust）联合原则设计、实现与评测主动式LLM智能体，并给出五维设计空间与PROACTIVITY-GYM仿真评测平台。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主动式LLM智能体可将闲置算力转化为用户未请求前的有用支持，但即便任务执行正确，也可能误读用户情境、带来审查成本或损害信任。因此需要一套同时兼顾有用工作、算力分配与用户信任的设计与评测框架。

Method: 提出3T联合原则（任务能力、时间分配、信任），并将其映射到由任务范围、预判时域、激活触发、处理时机、干预深度五个维度构成的设计空间；说明支撑决策所需的情境与系统建模（用户与环境表示、骨干LLM、智能体运行框架）；构建PROACTIVITY-GYM仿真评测平台，包含多日场景、有状态环境与人格条件化的模拟用户，以评估跨交互的主动辅助后果。

Result: 在23种模型-运行框架配置上的评测揭示了3T各维度上的显著性能差距，并发现LLM评审常将任务能力与信任混为一谈；30名参与者的人体研究显示，干预错位即使结果正确也会导致信任急剧下降，且用户偏好睡眠时段辅助（即便不完美）以保持当前专注。

Conclusion: 研究结果支持通过有用工作、算力分配与动态用户信任的联合考量来设计与评测主动式智能体。

Abstract: Proactive LLM agents can turn idle compute into useful support before users ask. Yet even correct work can misread user context, impose review costs, or undermine trust. This work proposes foundations for designing, realizing, and evaluating proactive LLM agents around three joint principles (3T): Task Capability, anticipating relevant needs and correctly performing useful work; Temporal Allocation, allocating compute according to resource availability and when results are needed; and Trust, sustaining users' confidence and appropriate reliance on the agent. We connect these objectives to a design space organized around five dimensions: task scope, anticipation horizon, activation trigger, processing timing, and intervention depth, and specify the situation and system modeling needed to support its choices, including user and environment representations, backbone LLMs, and agent harnesses. Lastly, we propose PROACTIVITY-GYM, a simulation-based evaluation testbed including multi-day scenarios, stateful environments, and persona-conditioned simulated users that can evaluate the consequences of proactive assistance across interactions. Evaluations across 23 model-harness configurations uncover substantial performance gaps across 3T and reveal that LLM judges often conflate task capability and trust. A human study with 30 participants demonstrates the importance of the joint 3T optimization: participants show sharp trust declines after intervention misalignment despite correct outcomes, and prefer sleep-time assistance, even when imperfect, to preserve ongoing focus. Together, these findings support designing and evaluating proactive agents through the joint consideration of useful work, compute allocation, and evolving user trust.

</details>


### [495] [Task-Relevant Null-Space Residuals for Non-Injective Neural Mappings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37272)
*Bizu Feng,Zhimu Yang,Shuming Wang,Yuan Cheng,Shaode Yu,Xiaojun Qian,Zixin Hu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出任务相关零空间残差（NSR）框架，通过提取非单射线性映射前的零空间分量并对其进行编码、门控与任务特定集成，使下游模型可利用原本被消除的输入差异，同时保持原有聚合规则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经网络中的非单射映射会把不同输入映射到同一表示，从而隐式地在输入空间诱导等价关系。但被映射消除的输入差异可能仍是下游任务所需的，导致"算子诱导的不可区分性"与"任务所需区分性"之间的错配。对当前前向传播中的非单射线性算子而言，其零空间恰好刻画了这些不可见的输入变化。

Method: 提出 Task-Relevant Null-Space Residuals（NSR），一个面向非单射线性映射的通用残差框架。NSR 包含三部分：从映射前表示中提取零空间分量；进行成员级编码与门控；在下游监督下进行应用特定集成，从而在保留原始聚合/合并规则的同时利用潜在任务相关信息。

Result: 在两个结构不同的场景中评估 NSR：token merging 与 graph aggregation。在 token merging 中，NSR 在 36 个评估配置中的 34 个上取得高于对应压缩基线的语义分割性能，强压缩下最大提升 31.51 mIoU。在 graph aggregation 中，NSR 在三种骨干网络上于 Tree-NeighborsMatch（深度 d=2–6）取得 100% 训练准确率，并在异亲节点分类与分子图回归上获得提升。

Conclusion: 结果支持将零空间残差作为非单射线性映射的实用补充，使下游模型能够从原算子输出中不可见的输入差异中学习。

Abstract: Non-injective mappings in neural networks map distinct inputs to the same representation, thereby implicitly inducing equivalence relations in the input space. However, the input differences eliminated by these mappings may still be required by downstream tasks, creating a mismatch between operator-induced indistinguishability and task-required distinctions. For non-injective linear operators realized in the current forward pass, their null spaces exactly characterize these invisible input variations. We propose Task-Relevant Null-Space Residuals (NSR), a general residual framework for non-injective linear mappings. NSR combines null-space component extraction from pre-mapping representations, member-level encoding and gating, and application-specific integration to exploit potentially task-relevant information under downstream supervision while preserving the original aggregation or merging rules. We evaluate NSR in two structurally different settings: token merging and graph aggregation. In token merging, NSR achieves higher semantic segmentation performance than the corresponding compressed baselines in 34 out of 36 evaluated configurations, with a maximum observed gain of 31.51 mIoU points under strong compression. In graph aggregation, NSR achieves 100% training accuracy on Tree-NeighborsMatch at depths d=2--6 across three backbones, alongside gains on heterophilic node classification and molecular graph regression. Together, these results support null-space residuals as a practical complement to non-injective linear mappings, enabling downstream models to learn from input distinctions invisible in the original operator's output.

</details>


### [496] [Transolver-$σ$: Joint Spectral-Physical Subspace Modeling for Neural PDE Solving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37279)
*Haonan Shangguan,Hang Zhou,Haixu Wu,Yuezhou Ma,Jianmin Wang,Mingsheng Long*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 Transolver-σ，通过联合谱-物理子空间建模的神经 PDE 求解器，在五个基准上平均相对误差降低 33.4%，并持续改善自回归推演。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对时间相关问题，强单步精度不一定能转化为可靠的自回归推演。作者观察到仅基于物理状态建模的求解器单步误差更低，而仅基于谱的对应方法在推演的后期步骤可能更准确。这一差异表明单一建模范式存在局限，需要同时利用两种表示。

Method: 提出 Transolver-σ，在每个模块内于专用潜子空间中分别建模自适应物理状态交互与谱变换，并将两者响应重组以实现表示间信息交换。物理子空间中引入 Slice-Residual Physics-Attention（SRPA），保留显式的切片空间恒等路径，同时保持可学习的跨切片交互；并行地使用轴分解傅里叶算子捕获全局谱结构。

Result: 在涵盖稳态预测与时间依赖动力学的五个成熟 PDE 基准上达到 state-of-the-art，相对误差较各指标最强基线平均降低 33.4%，并相比单一算子对应方法持续提升自回归推演精度。在耦合多物理系统以及 RealPDEBench 的真实流体与燃烧测量数据上同样取得显著增益。

Conclusion: 联合谱与物理子空间建模可兼顾单步精度与长程推演稳定性，且在标准仿真基准之外的耦合多物理与真实测量场景中同样有效。

Abstract: Neural solvers offer efficient surrogates for numerical simulation of partial differential equations (PDEs). For time-dependent problems, strong one-step accuracy does not necessarily translate into reliable autoregressive rollout. We observe that a solver based only on physical-state modeling can achieve lower one-step error, whereas its spectral-only counterpart can become more accurate at later rollout steps. Motivated by this observation, we present Transolver-$σ$, a neural PDE solver based on joint spectral--physical subspace modeling. Within each block, adaptive physical-state interactions and spectral transformations are modeled in dedicated latent subspaces, whose responses are recomposed to enable information exchange between the two representations. Within the physical subspace, we introduce Slice-Residual Physics-Attention (SRPA), which preserves an explicit slice-space identity path while retaining learnable cross-slice interaction. In parallel, an axis-factorized Fourier operator captures global spectral structure. Across five well-established PDE benchmarks spanning steady-state prediction and time-dependent dynamics, Transolver-$σ$ achieves state-of-the-art with a benchmark-averaged relative error reduction of 33.4% over the strongest baseline for each metric, while consistently improving autoregressive rollout over single-operator counterparts. Transolver-$σ$ further delivers strong gains on coupled multiphysics systems and real-world fluid and combustion measurements from RealPDEBench, demonstrating its effectiveness beyond standard simulation benchmarks.

</details>


### [497] [AssayRouter: Historical Utility Priors for Frozen Molecular Predictor Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37285)
*Dong Xu,Zhangfan Yang,Jiantao Wu,Shipeng Zhang,Zexuan Zhu,Jiangqiang Li,Jun Zhang,Junkai Ji*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AssayRouter 将已完成的多标签分子测定视为伪目标，用候选预测器加入本地目标预测器后的留出发现损失下降量（post-fit utility）作为标签训练共享回归器，从而为新测定从冻结的预测接口中选择少量来源并拟合凸组合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实验室常遇到标签数仅16–64的新分子测定，而可用预测器的训练数据与参数均不可得（冻结输出）。关键实际问题是如何从这些冻结输出中挑选少量来源纳入一个小型本地模型。

Method: 以已完成的测定作为伪目标（pseudo-targets），将每个候选来源按其拟合后效用打标签：即把该候选加入本地目标预测器后，留出集发现损失的下降幅度。用一个共享回归器在不使用来源身份信息的条件下，从候选在支持集上的行为预测该效用。在新测定上，使用一次冻结排序选出四个来源，再由独立标签拟合凸组合器。仅在已完成的 ChEMBL-MT 测定上训练，在六个冻结接口家族下的24个外部回归测定上评估。

Result: AssayRouter-C 相比 Support-CV@4 将严格的四次调用负对数似然（NLL）降低 0.0409。冻结的候选—标签置换实验证实候选—效用对应关系承载了可迁移信息；留一接口训练（leave-one-interface-out）表明该映射可泛化到未见过的预测器家族。

Conclusion: 已完成的测定可为通过冻结预测接口进行的稀缺标签路由提供可迁移的监督信号。

Abstract: Laboratories often face a new molecular assay with 16-64 labels and a bank of predictors whose training data and parameters are unavailable. The practical question is which frozen outputs to include in a small local model. AssayRouter treats completed assays as pseudo-targets and labels each candidate by its post-fit utility: the reduction in held-out discovery loss when the candidate is added to the local target predictor. A shared regressor learns to predict this utility from candidate behavior on the support set, without source identity; on a new assay, one frozen ranking selects four sources and separate labels fit a convex combiner. We train only on completed ChEMBL-MT assays and evaluate 24 external regression assays across six frozen interface families. AssayRouter-C lowers strict four-call negative log-likelihood (NLL) by 0.0409 relative to Support-CV@4. Frozen candidate-label permutations confirm that candidate-utility correspondence carries the transferred information, and leave-one-interface-out training shows that the mapping generalizes to unseen predictor families. Completed assays therefore provide transferable supervision for scarce-label routing through frozen prediction interfaces.

</details>


### [498] [MetaCtrl: Your Large Language Models Can Reason Better and More Concisely with a Metacognitive Controller](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37304)
*Zhibin Wen,Tao Han,Lei Bai,Can Li,Yang Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出MetaCtrl，一种轻量级元认知控制器，通过强化学习自适应调控冻结的推理模型，动态决定继续、简化、跳过或结束推理，无需预设预算或重训推理器，在提升准确率的同时大幅缩短推理长度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型推理模型通过增加推理计算提升难题表现，但更长推理未必更好，简单问题上会产生大量冗余推理；而过度压缩推理又会损害难题性能。因此需要根据推理器能力和不断演化的解题状态，动态判断额外计算是否有用。现有方法依赖预设预算或干预规则、需重训目标推理器或额外监督，灵活性不足。

Method: 将推理调控建模为序列式元认知控制问题：MetaCtrl观察逐步演化的推理轨迹，决定继续、简化、跳过冗余步骤或结束推理。控制器以强化学习直接训练，奖励在优先保证正确性的同时，在正确解中偏好更短轨迹，且不需要监督式干预轨迹或问题特定预算；调控对象为冻结的推理器。

Result: 在数学、科学、代码共七个基准上，MetaCtrl持续提升大型推理模型准确率并缩短推理长度。在DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B上平均准确率提升4.7分，生成长度减少53.3%；无需再训练即可迁移至未见推理器（如Qwen3-14B），平均准确率提升2.9分，生成长度减少50.3%。

Conclusion: MetaCtrl是一种即插即用的推理控制器，可在减少推理期生成量的同时提升推理准确率，兼具有效性与可迁移性。

Abstract: Large reasoning models improve performance on challenging problems by allocating additional computation before answering, but longer reasoning does not always lead to better results and can introduce substantial redundant reasoning on simple problems. Conversely, aggressively shortening reasoning can degrade performance on difficult ones. Effective reasoning therefore requires dynamically deciding when additional computation is useful based on the reasoner's capabilities and evolving solution state. Existing approaches often rely on predefined budgets or intervention rules, retrain the target reasoner, or require additional supervision. We introduce MetaCtrl, a lightweight controller that adaptively regulates a frozen reasoner without predefined token budgets or reasoner retraining. We formulate reasoning regulation as a sequential metacognitive control problem: MetaCtrl observes the evolving reasoning trace and decides whether to continue, simplify, skip redundant steps, or conclude reasoning. It is trained directly with reinforcement learning using a reward that prioritizes correctness while favoring shorter trajectories among correct solutions, requiring neither supervised intervention trajectories nor problem-specific budgets. Across seven benchmarks spanning mathematics, science, and code, MetaCtrl consistently improves the accuracy of LRMs while reducing their reasoning length. On DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, it improves average accuracy by 4.7 points while reducing generation length by 53.3%. Without further training, the same controller transfers to an unseen reasoner (e.g., Qwen3-14B), improving average accuracy by 2.9 points and reducing generation length by 50.3%. These results establish MetaCtrl as a plug-and-play controller for improving reasoning accuracy while substantially reducing inference-time generation. The code is available at https://github.com/binbin2xs/MetaCtrl.

</details>


### [499] [ReMem: Rethinking Perception and Memory in Long-Context Recommendation Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37311)
*Haohao Qu,Yongcheng Jing,Chun Hin Chan,Shanru Lin,Wenqi Fan,Dacheng Tao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出ReMem推荐智能体框架，融合OCR多模态感知与时间演化动态记忆，通过分块顺序记忆更新和多记忆GRPO实现线性复杂度长上下文建模，在搜索、排序、评判三项任务上平均提升5.16%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推荐智能体（RecAgents）存在两大瓶颈：一是基于噪声大、异构性强的商品页面进行条目感知，导致感知脆弱；二是面对超长用户历史与多步交互轨迹时，长上下文推理效率低下。因此需要一种更类人、平台无关的感知机制，以及可在线性复杂度下保持演化偏好的长时程记忆建模方法。

Method: ReMem将OCR多模态感知与时间演化动态记忆相结合：(1) 不再解析原始HTML，而是通过截图观察商品页面，并用OCR工具抽取结构化多模态信息，实现类人且平台无关的感知；(2) 引入分块顺序记忆更新策略，智能体在处理任意长上下文时有选择地维护固定大小的信息性历史交互记忆，实现线性推理复杂度与有界上下文长度，且不依赖外部记忆模块、不破坏标准自回归生成；(3) 设计多记忆GRPO变体，将最终答案优势传播至所有对最终回复有贡献的中间对话。

Result: 在三个数据集上的大量实验表明，ReMem持续优于最先进基线，在搜索、排序、评判三项推荐智能体任务上平均提升5.16%。

Conclusion: ReMem通过OCR多模态感知替代HTML解析、以固定大小动态记忆支持线性复杂度长上下文推理、并用多记忆GRPO强化中间对话学习，有效缓解了RecAgents的感知脆弱与长上下文推理低效问题，验证了主动式用户侧推荐范式的可行性与有效性。

Abstract: Recent Recommendation Agents (RecAgents) offer a promising alternative by shifting recommendation to an active, user-side paradigm, where generative agents autonomously perceive external platforms, reason over user preferences, and execute decisions. However, existing RecAgents still suffer from two critical limitations: brittle item perception based on noisy and heterogeneous item pages, and inefficient long-context reasoning over extended user histories and multi-step interaction traces. To address these challenges, we propose a novel recommendation agent framework, termed as ReMem, that combines OCR-based multimodal perception with time-evolving dynamic memory. Instead of parsing raw HTML, ReMem observes item pages through screenshots and extracts structured multimodal information via an OCR tool, enabling a more humanoid and platform-agnostic perception mechanism. To support long-horizon preference modeling, ReMem further introduces a chunk-wise sequential memory update strategy, where the agent selectively maintains a fixed-size memory of informative historical interactions while processing arbitrarily long contexts with linear inference complexity and bounded context length. This design allows the agent to preserve evolving user preferences without relying on external memory modules or disrupting the standard autoregressive generation process. To enhance the dynamic memory instruction, we further develop a multi-memory GRPO variant, which propagates the final-answer advantage to all intermediate conversations that contribute to the final response. Extensive experiments on three datasets demonstrate that ReMem consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving an average improvement of 5.16\% across three recommendation agent tasks, namely searching, ranking, and judging.

</details>


### [500] [Mubric: Mutation Testing-Guided Rubric Generation for LLM Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37322)
*Jiayuxuan Yang,Jie M. Zhang,Yiling Lou,Zhenpeng Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Mubric提出一种基于变异测试的评分标准（rubric）自动生成方法：从真实偏好响应对中挖掘缺陷并抽象为变异算子，对参考响应注入缺陷以检验rubric能否有效惩罚，据此迭代优化rubric。在703个任务、四个领域上，其评估准确率超过最强基线7.48个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于rubric的评估被广泛用于评价LLM系统，但自动生成能可靠捕捉任务特定质量要求的rubric仍然困难。现有方法难以保证rubric覆盖关键质量维度并对其有效区分优劣响应。

Method: 受软件测试中的变异测试启发，将测试套件类比为rubric：若rubric捕捉了某质量要求，则在高质响应中注入相应缺陷应使其得分下降。Mubric先从真实偏好/非偏好响应对中挖掘常见缺陷，抽象为可复用的变异算子（每个算子指定如何注入某类响应缺陷）；对新任务，应用相关算子到参考响应，检验注入缺陷是否降低响应质量，并用惩罚不足的缺陷来精炼rubric。

Result: 在四个代表性领域共703个任务上，与六种先进rubric生成方法对比，Mubric取得最高总体评估准确率，比最强基线高出7.48个百分点。

Conclusion: 变异测试为rubric生成提供了有效范式：通过“缺陷注入—惩罚检验—rubric精炼”的闭环，可自动构建更贴近任务特定质量要求的评分标准，显著提升LLM系统评估准确性。

Abstract: Rubric-based evaluation is widely used to assess LLM-based systems by decomposing response quality into task-specific scoring criteria. However, automatically generating rubrics that reliably capture task-specific quality requirements remains challenging. We introduce Mubric, a mutation testing-guided approach to rubric generation. Mutation testing, a classic software testing methodology, evaluates a test suite by injecting faults into programs and checking whether the tests detect them. We draw an analogy between test suites and rubrics: if a rubric captures an important quality requirement, introducing a corresponding defect into an otherwise high-quality response should reduce its score. Mubric first mines common defects from real pairs of preferred and dispreferred responses and abstracts these defects into reusable mutation operators, each specifying how to introduce a particular type of response defect. For a new task, it applies relevant operators to a reference response, checks whether the injected defects reduce response quality, and uses insufficiently penalized defects to refine the rubric. We evaluate Mubric on 703 tasks across four representative domains against six advanced rubric generation methods. Mubric achieves the highest overall evaluation accuracy, outperforming the strongest baseline by 7.48 percentage points.

</details>


### [501] [VISTA: Value-Informed Event Appraisal for Multimodal Emotion Conflict](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37324)
*Jiale Dai,Liuxian Ma,Xiaoke Niu,Wenjing Zhang,Huiying Zhao,Zhaoxiang Liu,Shiguo Lian,Guojie Song*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出VISTA，一种以价值/评价（appraisal）为核心的七字段语义仲裁接口，用评价信息条件化多模态冲突情感的模态仲裁，在CA-MER冲突场景上取得64.5%准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 情感线索在多模态间可能相互冲突但各自均有效（如压抑的语调反映目标受阻，微笑则满足社交义务），其解释取决于事件对当事人的意义。因此需要一种以场景特异性评价为中介的解释机制，而非简单依赖模态门控。

Method: 提出VISTA（Value-Informed Semantic Trust Arbitration）：一个可学习的七字段评价接口，以关切（concerns）、事件关系（event relations）和表达条件（expression conditions）为条件进行模态仲裁，同时保留联合证据残差；并用对数几率分解将情绪期望与线索诊断性分离，使评价能够改变证据的解释方式。采用共享的Qwen2.5-Omni-7B骨干，训练样本与步数匹配。

Result: 在CA-MER上达到64.5%冲突准确率，相比模态门控在冲突上提升2.5个百分点、一致性上提升0.2个百分点；打乱跨场景评价或移除其决策连接会削弱该收益。冻结骨干探针在评价读出上达到0.600 macro CCC，而仅情感微调为0.505。五个基准上的评估将冲突下的识别、评价读出与下游决策使用联系起来。

Conclusion: 分析与实验共同支持“场景特异性评价”作为一种中间表示，有助于解释相互冲突的情感证据。

Abstract: Conflicting emotional cues can be individually valid: a subdued voice may reflect a blocked goal while a smile satisfies a social obligation. Their interpretation depends on what the event means to the person. We introduce VISTA (Value-Informed Semantic Trust Arbitration), a learned seven-field appraisal interface that conditions modality arbitration on concerns, event relations, and expression conditions while retaining a joint-evidence residual. A log-odds decomposition separates emotion expectation from cue diagnosticity, motivating an interface that lets appraisal change how evidence is interpreted. With a shared Qwen2.5-Omni-7B backbone and matched training examples and steps, VISTA reaches 64.5% conflict accuracy on CA-MER, improving on modality gating by 2.5 percentage points on conflict and 0.2 on consistency. Shuffling appraisal across scenes or removing its decision connection reduces this benefit. A common frozen-backbone probe reaches 0.600 macro CCC for appraisal readout, compared with 0.505 for emotion-only fine-tuning. Evaluations across five benchmarks connect recognition under increasing conflict with appraisal readout and downstream decision use. Together, the analyses and experiments support scene-specific appraisal as an intermediate representation that helps interpret conflicting emotional evidence.

</details>


### [502] [Solving Without Stopping: On-Policy Distillation at Small Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37326)
*Hongyang Li,Yiming Zhu,Xiao Li,Caesar Wu,Said Mammar,Pascal Bouvry*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文分析在线策略蒸馏（on-policy distillation）在小规模模型上究竟迁移了什么能力，发现它迁移"解题"能力但不迁移"知道何时停止推理"的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线策略蒸馏常被用于把推理能力传给更小的模型，但其在小规模场景下究竟迁移了哪些能力（尤其是长推理所需的"解题"与"判断何时已解出"两种能力）尚不清楚。

Method: 以 Qwen3-8B 为教师，蒸馏到 Qwen3 4B、1.7B、0.6B 学生；分别在 thinking 模式（长推理后给出答案）与 non-thinking 模式（无独立推理阶段）下进行对比实验，并在两种模式、所有学生规模上全面测量两种能力的上限，同时提出区分"标记答案、正确性、停止"的诊断方法。

Result: 解题能力在所有规模上均提升，但受两个上限约束：学生单次尝试的表现不会超过训练前多次尝试所能达到的最佳水平，且学生越小、距离教师越远。停止行为在两种模式间分化：non-thinking 模式下各规模学生都能持续停止；thinking 模式下学生逐渐不再提前结束推理，且学生越小该能力保留越少。教师几乎只在学生已停止处发出停止信号，因此蒸馏不教新停止点，只是保留落在正确答案上的既有停止；弱学生此类停止点很少，最小模型常能到达正确值却不"表态"——要么极少标记，要么标记后继续写下去。

Conclusion: 在线策略蒸馏主要迁移解题能力而非停止（判断已解出）能力，停止能力取决于学生自身已有的正确停止点数量；研究给出了一套分离答案标记、正确性与停止的诊断框架，刻画了小模型在在线策略蒸馏下的行为特征。

Abstract: On-policy distillation, where a student learns from a stronger teacher's feedback on its own outputs, is a common way to pass reasoning to smaller models. We analyze what it transfers at small scale, distilling Qwen3-8B into Qwen3 4B, 1.7B and 0.6B students, in thinking mode (reason at length, then end the reasoning and answer) and, for comparison, in non-thinking mode (no separate reasoning phase). Long reasoning needs two abilities, solving a problem and knowing when it is solved, and we find that distillation transfers the first, but in thinking mode not the second. Solving improves at every size, up to two ceilings, which we measure comprehensively across both modes and all student sizes: a student's single attempt never exceeds what it could already reach in many attempts before training, and the smaller the student, the further it stays below the teacher. Stopping is where the modes part. In non-thinking mode every student keeps stopping; in thinking mode students stop ending their reasoning early in training, and the smaller the student, the less of this ability survives: the teacher signals a stop almost only where a student already ends its reasoning, so distillation teaches no new stops; it only keeps the student's existing stops that land on a right answer, and a weak student has few such stops. The smallest students often reach the right value but do not commit to it: they either rarely mark it or mark it and write past it. Together, these results describe how small students behave under on-policy distillation, and a diagnostic that separates answer marking, correctness and stopping.

</details>


### [503] [Seek Before You Move: Evidence Seeking for Progress Grounding in Vision-Language Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37353)
*Zhimin Wang,Meiyuan Zhu,Duo Wu,Linjia Kang,Yajun Wang,Yuan Ni,Xiaohang Wang,Tianlu Pan,Jingyan Jiang,Yaowei Wang,Zhi Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SeekVLN证据寻求框架，解决VLM导航智能体"进展近视"问题，通过两阶段训练实现SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于VLM的导航智能体仅对已有观测进行推理，即使任务相关证据缺失仍保持自信，导致"进展近视"（Progress Myopia）失效模式——智能体未能识别不可靠的进展定位，基于不充分证据继续行动而迷路。

Method: SeekVLN将语义进展推理与主动获取任务相关观测相结合，分两阶段训练：1）未来引导逆向生成（FRG），利用未来专家动作扩充离线专家轨迹，加入补充视角与证据标注，通过监督微调建立证据寻求与进展推理的先验；2）反事实对比策略优化（C2PO），将每个证据寻求分支与同一状态下的反事实直接导航分支对比，用对比奖励按后续导航收益为寻求决策分配信用。

Result: 在仿真基准上达到SOTA性能，R2R-CE成功率较基座模型提升12.7%，RxR-CE提升7.5%；仿真与真实世界评估均表现出类人的证据寻求行为。

Conclusion: SeekVLN通过显式建模证据寻求行为，缓解了进展近视问题，实现更可靠的进展定位，具备仿真与真实场景的有效性与泛化性。

Abstract: Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) requires agents to continuously ground task progress from long-horizon instructions and partial egocentric observations. Existing VLM-based navigation agents typically reason only over available observations and may remain confident even when task-relevant evidence is missing. For example, an agent may confidently proceed forward and get lost even though the landmark indicating the next turn lies outside its current field of view. We term this failure mode Progress Myopia: the agent fails to recognize unreliable progress grounding and continues acting on insufficient evidence. To address it, we propose SeekVLN, an evidence-seeking framework that couples semantic progress reasoning with active acquisition of task-relevant observations. SeekVLN is trained in two stages: First, Future-guided Reverse Generation (FRG) uses future expert actions to augment offline expert trajectories with supplementary views and evidence annotations. Supervised fine-tuning on these trajectories establishes a prior for evidence seeking and progress reasoning without additional expert interaction. However, imitation alone does not reveal whether seeking improves subsequent navigation. We therefore introduce Counterfactual Contrastive Policy Optimization (C2PO) for reinforcement fine-tuning. By comparing each evidence-seeking branch with a counterfactual direct-navigation branch from the same state, C2PO uses a contrastive reward to assign credit to seeking decisions based on subsequent navigation benefit. Experiments on simulated benchmarks show that SeekVLN achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving success rate by 12.7% and 7.5% over the base model on R2R-CE and RxR-CE, respectively. Both simulated and real-world evaluations exhibit human-like evidence-seeking behaviors for more reliable progress grounding.

</details>


### [504] [Teaching LLMs to Generate Challenging MILP Instances via Solver Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37356)
*Jitin Singla,Parikshit Pareek,Pratik Jawanpuria,Parag Singla*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出基于挑战者-求解器非对称自博弈的 RL 方法，用求解器阶段成本设计奖励，微调 LLM 生成可行且高难度的 MILP 问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成既可行又计算困难的优化实例对求解器基准测试与学习型优化算法训练至关重要。现有非 LLM 生成器依赖种子实例或参数调优，测试时成本高；现有 LLM 生成器缺乏显式难度度量；近期带验证器反馈的强化学习只评估二元正确性，与"生成困难问题"的目标错位。

Method: 利用求解器在流水线各阶段报告的求解成本设计奖励，同时衡量生成问题的可解性与难度（以分支定界节点数和割后松弛间隙度量）。核心为挑战者-求解器非对称自博弈：LLM 挑战者渐进生成更难实例，求解器验证可行性与难度，无需种子或训练 MILP 实例。用 GRPO 与规模课程将 Gemma-4-12B、Qwen3.5-4B 微调为 OptiScribe-12B/4B，可从自然语言指令生成可行且具挑战性的 MILP 问题。

Result: 在容量设施选址与最大割问题上，OptiScribe-12B 相较基座模型将 SCIP 搜索节点中位数提升 1.7-5 倍、割后间隙提升 1.1-1.7 倍，设施选址可行性提升 9-19 个百分点；OptiScribe-4B 将节点中位数最多提升 15.6 倍。生成问题难度范围覆盖比同规模公开基准更广，能遵循密度与难度指令，并可为公开库缺失的问题族调优求解器设置。

Conclusion: 优化专用奖励在自博弈模式下可教会 LLM 生成高难度优化基准；代码与模型将在录用后公开。

Abstract: Generating optimization instances that are both feasible and computationally challenging is crucial for benchmarking solvers and training learning-based optimization algorithms. Existing non-LLM generators rely on seed instances or parameter tuning, resulting in high test-time computational cost, while existing LLM generators lack explicit hardness measures. Recent reinforcement learning methods with verifier feedback evaluate only binary correctness, which is misaligned with generating challenging problems. We note that an optimization solver reports the cost of solving at several stages of its pipeline, and leverage this to design a reward that scores both the solvability and the hardness of generated problems, measured by branch-and-bound nodes and post-cut relaxation gaps. Our key idea is a challenger-solver asymmetric self-play approach, where an LLM challenger generates progressively harder instances and the solver verifies feasibility and hardness, so no seed or training MILP instances are required. We fine-tune Gemma-4-12B and Qwen3.5-4B with GRPO and a size curriculum into OptiScribe-12B and OptiScribe-4B, which generate feasible yet challenging MILP problems from natural language instructions. On capacitated facility location and max-cut, OptiScribe-12B raises median SCIP search nodes by 1.7-5x and post-cut gaps by 1.1-1.7x over its base model and improves the feasibility rate on facility location by 9-19 points, while OptiScribe-4B raises median nodes by up to 15.6x. The problems cover a wider difficulty range than public benchmarks of the same size, follow instructions on density and difficulty, and can tune solver settings for families that public libraries lack. These results indicate that optimization-specific rewards, used in self-play mode, can teach LLMs to generate high-difficulty optimization benchmarks. We will release our code and models publicly on acceptance.

</details>


### [505] [Predicting Team Performance from Communications in Simulated Search-and-Rescue](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.03791)
*Ali Jalal-Kamali,Nikolos Gurney,David Pynadath*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 通过对话数据推断团队特质，利用主题建模与聚类分析Minecraft搜救实验转录文本，发现团队结果差异可由这些推断特质解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 个体特质对团队绩效的影响具有价值，但特质往往无法直接观测；既有研究多依赖行为数据推断信任等特质，本文尝试从对话数据中推断团队特质并考察其与团队结果的相关性。

Method: 使用基于Minecraft的搜救实验转录文本，采用主题建模（topic modeling）与聚类（clustering）方法，识别关键交互模式并推断团队特质。

Result: 团队结果（teaming outcomes）的差异可由推断出的特质解释；个体特质与团队动态分别提供不同水平的预测力。

Conclusion: 对话数据可用于推断团队特质并预测团队表现，个体特质与团队动态的预测贡献存在差异，为团队协作研究提供了基于语言的分析路径。

Abstract: Understanding how individual traits influence team performance is valuable, but these traits are not always directly observable. Prior research has inferred traits like trust from behavioral data. We analyze conversational data to identify team traits and their correlation with teaming outcomes. Using transcripts from a Minecraft-based search-and-rescue experiment, we apply topic modeling and clustering to uncover key interaction patterns. Our findings show that variations in teaming outcomes can be explained through these inferences, with different levels of predictive power derived from individual traits and team dynamics.

</details>


### [506] [Pretrain Once, Route Anywhere: Towards a Foundation Model for LLM Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37362)
*Guannan Lai,Han-Jia Ye*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出RouteFM，将LLM路由从"针对特定环境局部拟合"转变为"预训练一次、随处路由"的基础模型范式，通过学习可复用的路由能力实现跨任务、跨候选模型和跨部署条件的泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM路由器通常依赖局部拟合：针对特定查询负载和候选池优化，环境变化时常需额外监督或重新训练，缺乏可迁移性。作者希望探索能否以基础模型视角来构建路由能力，使其可复用于多种任务、候选模型和部署条件。

Method: 提出RouteFM，不将路由决策绑定到固定的模型身份或单一环境，而是从行为上下文中刻画匿名候选模型并推理其面向目标的能力。通过跨异构路由环境的episodic预训练获得该能力，冻结的路由器仅凭上下文即可适配新环境。

Result: 实验显示RouteFM可跨领域、模态、候选池和上下文预算的变化实现迁移，在行为证据有限时增益最大。在未参与预训练的MMR-Bench上，每个候选仅用8次观测即比最强基线高出2.23质量分。

Conclusion: 结果支持将LLM路由从反复的局部拟合转向"预训练一次、随处路由"的新范式，代码已公开。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) routing aims to assign each query to the most suitable model from a heterogeneous candidate pool, improving the quality--efficiency trade-off of LLM inference. Existing routers are typically learned through local fitting: a router is optimized for a particular query workload and candidate pool, and often requires additional supervision or retraining as the routing environment changes. We ask whether LLM routing can instead be approached from a foundation-model perspective, learning a reusable routing capability that generalizes across tasks, candidate models, and deployment conditions. To this end, we introduce RouteFM, which learns to characterize anonymous candidate models from behavioral context and infer their target-specific capabilities, rather than binding routing decisions to fixed model identities or a single environment. Through episodic pretraining across heterogeneous routing environments, this capability can be reused by a frozen router and adapted to new environments through context alone. Experiments demonstrate transfer across changes in domains, modalities, candidate pools, and context budgets, with the largest gains when behavioral evidence is limited. On MMR-Bench, which is excluded from pretraining, RouteFM outperforms the strongest baseline by 2.23 quality points with only eight observations per candidate. These results support moving LLM routing from repeated local fitting toward a pretrain once, route anywhere paradigm. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/LAMDA-Model-Reuse/RouteFM.

</details>


### [507] [Beyond Prompt Count: How Data Shapes Transfer in On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37377)
*Jiaxuan Wang,Jiafei Lyu,Yuchen Cai,Siye Wu,Pengyuan Wang,Jiashun Liu,Xiang Cheng,Kai Yang,Yangkun Chen,Saiyong Yang,Lan-Zhe Guo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统研究 on-policy distillation (OPD) 中提示词（prompt）的数量、来源与选择如何影响教师-学生模型间的知识迁移，发现 OPD 具有高提示效率，但提示效用是关系性的而非内在的，有效数据选择取决于具体的教师-学生配对与目标能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OPD 通过教师对学生自采样回复的反馈来训练学生，但"提示词选择如何影响跨教师-学生配对的知识迁移"这一问题尚不清楚。作者希望厘清提示数量、来源与选择策略在迁移中的作用，区分"提示效率"与"提示可互换性"。

Method: 在 RL 与 SFT-continuation 配对及跨模型设定下，系统操纵提示词的数量、来源与选择策略；分析不同提示支持集（prompt supports）与模型配对下的参数变化与函数变化；比较针对性选择与均匀随机采样，并进行过滤劣势来源的对照实验（三次成对支持集抽样）。

Result: OPD 高度提示高效：少量提示即可接近大池性能，4 个 DAPO 提示在数学分数上匹配 3,840 个 DeepMath 提示。但提示效用是关系性的：仅更换教师即可逆转数学与代码提示的相对有效性。与教师的函数对齐随支持集和目标任务变化；在 continuation 配对中，教师对齐的预测变化可与弱参数对齐共存。在有效支持集上继续 OPD 可恢复不利迁移后的性能。针对性选择并不能稳定优于均匀随机采样，过滤单独表现差的来源在三组成对支持集抽样中无一致增益。

Conclusion: 结果区分了提示效率与提示可互换性，表明有效的数据选择依赖于教师-学生配对与目标能力，随机采样在所研究设定中是具有竞争力的基线。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains students using teacher feedback on their own sampled responses, yet how prompt choice shapes transfer across teacher-student pairs remains poorly understood. We systematically study prompt quantity, source, and selection across RL- and SFT-continuation pairs and cross-model settings. We find that OPD can be highly prompt-efficient: a few prompts can approach large-pool performance, with four DAPO prompts matching the observed mathematics score of 3,840 DeepMath prompts. However, prompt utility is relational rather than intrinsic: changing only the teacher can reverse the relative effectiveness of mathematics and code prompts. To characterize these transfer differences, we analyze parameter and functional changes across prompt supports and model pairs. Functional alignment with the teacher varies across supports and target tasks; in continuation pairs, teacher-aligned prediction changes can coexist with weak parameter alignment. Continued OPD on effective supports can restore performance after unfavorable transfer. Finally, targeted selection does not consistently outperform uniform random sampling, and filtering out a source that performs poorly alone yields no consistent gain across three paired support draws. Overall, our results distinguish prompt efficiency from prompt interchangeability and show that effective data choice depends on the teacher-student pair and target capability, with random sampling providing a competitive baseline in the studied settings.

</details>


### [508] [Direct Experience World-Model Optimization: Learning the World Beyond Action Imitation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37398)
*Xiangcheng Zhan,Zirui Chen,Yicheng Zhao,Ziteng Gao,Shuo Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出DEWO（Direct Experience World-Model Optimization），一种面向World-Action Models的后部署学习范式，在动作模仿之外利用视觉经验优化世界表征，通过识别交互转折点、学习成功与失败的未来轨迹以支持classifier-free guidance，并引入value head估计任务进度以在停滞时触发引导。在五个DexJoCo任务和四个真实世界任务（Wuji、Sharpa）上验证有效性，真实任务成功率由51.0%提升至71.7%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前WAMs的后部署学习范式通常只改进行为而不要求更好的世界预测。在灵巧操作中，高维动作空间中的微小执行误差会累积，阻碍策略改进，并使交互超出世界模型的训练分布。因此需要让世界建模成为WAM适配的主动组成部分。

Method: DEWO在动作模仿之外，通过视觉经验精炼世界表征以更好地条件化动作生成：1）识别交互转折点（interaction turning points），从成功与失败的未来轨迹中学习以支持classifier-free guidance；2）引入额外的value head，从视频表征估计任务进度，并在推理时进度停滞时激活引导。

Result: 在五个DexJoCo任务上，DEWO提升了三种WAM形式的平均成功率；消融实验表明，来自成功与失败后续的视觉监督在预测与控制两方面均优于仅动作监督。在Wuji与Sharpa的四个真实世界任务上，3×3网格评估显示两轮部署学习使至少有一次初始成功的格子成功率从51.0%升至71.7%，提升20.7个百分点。

Conclusion: 研究结果支持通过部署经验进行持续预测学习以改进控制，使世界建模成为WAM适配中的主动环节。

Abstract: World-Action Models (WAMs) couple action generation with predictions of how physical interactions unfold. However, current post-deployment learning paradigms typically improve behavior without requiring better world predictions. Especially in dexterous manipulation, small execution errors can compound in high-dimensional action spaces, hindering policy improvement and pushing interactions beyond the world model's training distribution. Motivated by this, we propose Direct Experience World-Model Optimization (DEWO), a post-deployment learning paradigm for WAMs that, alongside action imitation, refines world representations through visual experience to better condition action generation. Specifically, it identifies interaction turning points and learns from successful and failed futures to support classifier-free guidance. An additional value head estimates task progress from video representations and activates guidance when progress stalls during inference. Across five DexJoCo tasks, DEWO improves average success across all three WAM formulations. Ablations show that visual supervision from successful and failed continuations improves both prediction and control beyond action supervision alone. On four real-world tasks across Wuji and Sharpa, 3 x 3 grid evaluations show that two rounds of deployment learning increase success from 51.0% to 71.7% in cells with at least one initial success, a gain of 20.7 percentage points. These findings support continued predictive learning for improving control through deployment experience, making world modeling an active part of WAM adaptation.

</details>


### [509] [Routing Should Pay for Itself: Sparse Supervision for Economical LLM Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37402)
*Guannan Lai,Gelin Bian,Hao-Xuan Ma,Jun-Peng Jiang,Long Chen,Jian-Dong Liu,Zhi-Hao Tan,Han-Jia Ye*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出稀疏监督路由框架SaveRouter，选择性获取模型反馈并跨查询共享能力信息，在保持路由质量的同时将监督开销降至33–41%，并使盈亏平衡部署量降低约1.9–9.5倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM路由通过为每个查询分配合适模型来降低服务成本并保持响应质量，但训练路由器通常需在历史查询上执行多个候选模型以收集查询–模型质量反馈，导致部署前存在不可忽视的监督成本。现有工作多关注服务时效率，忽视了由此产生的节省是否足以回收这笔前期支出。

Method: 提出SaveRouter稀疏监督路由框架：选择性获取信息量高的模型反馈，并在相关查询间共享能力信息，同时保留查询级细化以实现细粒度路由。评估时联合考虑监督支出与后续服务时节省。

Result: 在四个路由基准上，主设置仅使用约33–41%的可用训练反馈，即维持相当或更优的路由质量；相比最快的传统路由器，盈亏平衡部署量降低约1.9–9.5倍。进一步分析表明，获取更多监督并非总是经济上更优：使服务成本最小的监督水平可能不同于实现最早回本的水平。

Conclusion: 路由质量常在收集全部查询–模型反馈前就已饱和，密集监督在经济上可能过度配置；稀疏监督路由可在保证质量的同时显著降低监督成本并加快回本。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) routing reduces serving cost by assigning each query to an appropriate model while preserving response quality. Learning such a router, however, often requires executing multiple candidate models on historical queries to collect query--model quality feedback, creating a nontrivial supervision cost before deployment. Existing work largely focuses on serving-time efficiency, overlooking whether the resulting savings are sufficient to recover this upfront expenditure. We further observe that routing quality often saturates well before all query--model feedback is collected, suggesting that dense supervision can be economically over-provisioned. We propose SaveRouter, a sparse-supervision routing framework that selectively acquires informative model feedback and shares capability information across related queries, while retaining query-level refinement for fine-grained routing. We evaluate routing by jointly accounting for supervision expenditure and subsequent serving-time savings. Across four routing benchmarks, the main setting uses only about 33--41% of available training feedback while maintaining competitive or better routing quality, and reduces the break-even deployment volume by approximately 1.9--9.5 times compared with the fastest conventional router. Further analysis shows that acquiring more supervision is not always economically preferable: the supervision level that minimizes serving cost can differ from the one that achieves the earliest payback. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/LAMDA-Model-Reuse/SaveRouter.

</details>


### [510] [Demistifying Data and Simulator Assumptions in Supervised Causal Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37446)
*Pingchuan Ma,Rui Ding,Bojun Huang,Shuai Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该综述论文系统梳理了截至2026年6月的监督式因果发现方法，提出按预测目标、预测粒度、编码器、结构解码器和训练范式进行分类的框架，区分"可识别性"与"泛化性"两个核心问题，并倡导评估指标与可识别图目标相匹配、测试训练与部署间图/机制/噪声的变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 监督式因果发现依赖仿真数据提供监督，而仿真器同时承载了关于因果图、机制和噪声的假设。由于观测数据本身可能兼容多个因果图，理解预测结果必须考察这些假设如何补充观测信息。现有研究缺乏对"方法预测什么"与"如何使用数据和仿真监督"之间关系的系统梳理，也混淆了可识别性与分布外泛化两个不同问题。

Method: 论文对截至2026年6月的代表性监督式因果发现方法进行综述，按预测目标、预测粒度、编码器、结构解码器和训练范式五个维度组织归类，借此建立方法预测内容与数据/仿真监督使用方式的对应关系，并在此基础上区分"在假设模型类下目标是否可识别"与"训练好的预测器是否能泛化到训练分布之外"这两个问题。

Result: 分析表明，对机制和噪声的限制可使原本模糊的因果方向变得可识别；但在这些限制下取得的预测精度，并不能在限制条件变化时保证迁移能力。因此需要与可识别图目标相匹配的评估指标，并测试训练与部署之间图、机制和噪声的变化。将此类评估扩展到真实数据还需记录基准参考图背后的外部因果证据及其不确定性。

Conclusion: 该分析为监督式因果发现的方法比较提供指导，并指出迁移、测试时适应和不确定性评估方面的开放问题。核心结论是必须区分可识别性与泛化性，并据此设计评估协议。

Abstract: Supervised causal discovery learns to infer causal structure for a new dataset from training datasets paired with structural labels. These training pairs are typically simulated, making the simulator both a source of supervision and a carrier of assumptions about causal graphs, mechanisms, and noise. Understanding the resulting predictions therefore requires examining how these assumptions supplement the information available in observational data, which may be compatible with multiple causal graphs. This paper examines that relationship across representative methods available through June 2026. We organize these methods by prediction target, prediction granularity, encoder, structural decoder, and training regime to relate what each method predicts to how it uses data and simulator-based supervision. Using this framework, we distinguish two questions: whether the target is identifiable under the assumed model class, and whether a trained predictor generalizes beyond its training distribution. Restrictions on mechanisms and noise can make otherwise ambiguous causal directions identifiable, but predictive accuracy under those restrictions does not establish transfer when they change. This distinction motivates evaluation that matches metrics to the identifiable graph target and tests changes in graphs, mechanisms, and noise between training and deployment. Extending such evaluation to real data also requires documenting the external causal evidence and uncertainty behind benchmark reference graphs. Together, these analyses guide method comparison and identify open questions in transfer, test-time adaptation, and uncertainty assessment.

</details>


### [511] [Commitment Hierarchies under Intent Revision: A Belief-Revision Account of Salvage in Tool-Use Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37453)
*Spandan Ghose Chowdhury*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 将“保留/修补/丢弃”缓存子结果的决策从逐节点判定改为一次性分类加确定性传播，即可在多模型上达到成本最优的挽救策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用户任务中途改变意图时，已分解子目标并调用工具的代理需就每个缓存子结果决定保留、修补还是丢弃；重启浪费有效工作，而原样继续则回答的是旧问题，因此需要高效的挽救（salvage）策略。

Method: 将计划建模为承诺层级（commitment hierarchy），把意图变化建模为满足AGM式公设的信念修正算子；理论上证明仅依赖节点局部视图的策略无法同时安全且成本最优，而一次性分类设计可兼顾。实现上由语言模型对整次修订做一次分类，再由确定性层传播该决策。

Result: 挽救质量取决于角色设计而非模型能力：逐节点询问的模型不可靠；单次分类设计在来自两家厂商的三个模型上均达到成本最优的oracle水平；在三个环境中恢复全部可达节省，较重启便宜43%，正确率100%。

Conclusion: 代理缓存复用的关键是把决策集中在一次分类并交给确定性传播，而非依赖模型逐节点自行判断；该设计在安全性和成本最优性上可证明成立并在多环境中验证。

Abstract: When a user changes their mind partway through a task, an agent that has already split the task into sub-goals and paid for tool calls must decide, per cached sub-result, whether to keep, patch, or discard it (salvage), restarting wastes valid work and continuing unchanged answers the old question. Our main finding is that salvage quality is a matter of role design rather than model capability: a language model asked the keep/patch/discard question one node at a time is unreliable, but asked to classify the revision once, with a deterministic layer propagating the decision, it reaches the cost-optimal oracle on all three models tested, from two vendors. Modeling the plan as a commitment hierarchy and the intent change as a belief-revision operator with AGM style postulates, we prove that no policy observing only a node's local view can be both safe and cost optimal, while the single classification design is both. Across three environments the policy recovers the full achievable savings, 43% cheaper than restart, at 100% correctness.

</details>


### [512] [Governing the Edge: Automating Commercial Property and Casualty Insurance Underwriting via a Hybrid Local-Cloud Multi-Agent Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37454)
*Vivek Kumar Singh,Gautam Bhowmick*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出"Governing the Edge"多智能体框架，用13节点LangGraph工作流在数据不出边的约束下自动化商业P&C核保，硬性违规判定100%准确，20场景基准整体合规准确率70%，单设备数分钟完成原需40分钟的手工提交。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 商业财险（P&C）核保人员30–40%的时间耗在行政事务而非风险判断上，单份提交手工处理约需40分钟，效率低。同时敏感提交数据受数据驻留约束不得离域，现有自动化方案难以兼顾效率、隐私边界与合规可审计性。

Method: 设计多智能体框架"Governing the Edge"，围绕数据驻留约束组织：11个智能体加2个确定性控制节点（其一为人工升级中断）构成13节点、两层的LangGraph工作流。接触原始提交的智能体在本地Gemma 2运行，各经工具接口绑定并记录每次调用（原型用合成stub）；仅匿名化评分与非标识字段上传云端Claude Sonnet。合规规则编码为图边条件，不合规提交无法进入定价环节。以一份主驾驶员有严重违规记录的车险提交为例进行端到端演示。

Result: 单台边缘设备上几分钟完成原需40分钟的手工提交，瓶颈为串行的端侧推理。硬停机违规层级上，框架正确且可复现地执行每条规则（因硬停机为对温度0提取字段的确定性谓词）；20场景基准的整体合规准确率为70%，剩余差距集中在较软、需判断的层级。全程保留完整审计轨迹并遵守隐私边界。

Conclusion: 该框架在满足数据驻留和可审计要求的前提下，显著压缩核保行政耗时，硬性合规判定可靠；软性判断层级仍是准率短板。作者开源全部代码、合规规则、工具stub与合成数据集，供后续验证与扩展。

Abstract: Underwriters in commercial Property and Casualty (P&C) insurance spend 30 to 40% of their time on administrative work rather than risk judgment, and a single submission takes about 40 minutes by hand. We present Governing the Edge, a multi-agent framework for that layer, organized around a data-residency constraint: sensitive submission data must not leave the perimeter. Eleven agents and two deterministic control nodes, one a human-escalation interrupt, form a 13-node LangGraph workflow across two tiers. Agents touching raw submissions run locally on Gemma 2, each bound through a tool interface logging every invocation (synthetic stubs in the current prototype); only anonymized scores and non-identifying fields cross to Claude Sonnet in the cloud. Compliance rules are encoded as conditions on graph edges, so a non-compliant submission never reaches pricing. We walk through one full scenario end to end, a commercial auto submission whose principal driver carries serious violations, showing every agent call, every tool invocation, and the resulting routing decision. The framework processes a 40-minute manual submission in a few minutes on a single edge device, dominated by serialized on-device inference. On the hard-stop violation tier the framework enforces every rule correctly and reproducibly, since hard stops are deterministic predicates over fields extracted at temperature 0; overall compliance accuracy across the 20-scenario benchmark is 70%, with the remaining gap concentrated in softer, judgment-based tiers. It keeps a complete audit trail and respects the privacy boundary throughout. We release all code, compliance rules, tool stubs, and synthetic datasets.

</details>


### [513] [VeriWeave Govern: Evidence-Gated Deterministic Runtime Governance for Enterprise AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37457)
*Kabeh Mohsenzadegan,Vahid Tavakkoli,Kyandoghere Kyamakya*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出确定性运行时治理层 VeriWeave Govern，将智能体行动生成与授权解耦，在 GovernBench 的 6 万条样例上实现零聚合误放行与零治理攻击成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业 AI 智能体日益调用工具、修改基础设施并处理受保护数据，亟需将行动生成与行动授权分离，以可控、可审计的方式约束高风险动作。

Method: VeriWeave Govern 对结构化智能体动作进行版本化策略评估、类型化证据校验，采用固定 deny > review > allow 优先级，将重大动作转交有责任主体的人工审核，并记录可重放的防篡改审计状态；通过 GovernBench 在 30 个独立种子、60,000 条 oracle 标注用例上评测，覆盖五个企业域、对抗性证据、分布外动作与策略时序演化，另做六项消融、12/12 端到端场景、40,040 请求并发矩阵及 150 例欧盟/奥地利法规基准（冻结预测 + 两名独立盲审标注者）。

Result: 平均准确率 0.9888，宏 F1 0.9836，观测到的聚合误放行为 0、治理攻击成功率 0；六项消融显示证据门控、deny 优先、分布外失效安全、人工审核、矛盾处理与时序重放各有互补安全贡献；API 通过 12/12 场景与 4 万余请求并发测试且零失败；法规基准上确定性引擎更保守，而 Gemma 4 31B 对比模型与人类共识更接近，揭示安全—效用权衡。

Conclusion: 结果暴露可度量的安全—效用权衡，支持将证据感知、可重放的治理机制作为企业智能体执行的独立控制平面。

Abstract: Enterprise artificial-intelligence agents increasingly call tools, modify infrastructure, and process protected data, creating a need to separate action generation from action authorization. This article presents VeriWeave Govern, a deterministic runtime governance layer that evaluates structured agent actions against versioned policies, validates typed evidence, applies fixed deny > review > allow precedence, routes consequential actions to accountable human review, and records replayable tamper-evident audit state. GovernBench evaluates the design over 30 independent seeds and 60,000 oracle-labelled cases spanning five enterprise domains, adversarial evidence, out-of-distribution actions, and temporal policy evolution. VeriWeave achieves 0.9888 mean accuracy, 0.9836 macro-F1, zero observed aggregate false allows, and zero observed Governance Attack Success Rate on the evaluated cases. Six ablations show that evidence gating, deny precedence, out-of-distribution fail-safe behavior, human review, contradiction handling, and temporal replay contribute complementary safety. The deployed API additionally passes 12/12 end-to-end scenarios and a 40,040-request concurrency matrix with zero failures. A separate 150-case EU/Austria regulation-grounded evaluation uses frozen predictions and two independent blinded human annotators, who agree on all decisions. On this set, deterministic engines remain conservative, while a Gemma 4 31B comparator aligns more closely with the human consensus. The results expose a measurable safety--utility trade-off and motivate evidence-aware, replayable governance as an independent control plane for enterprise agent execution.

</details>


### [514] [CRASM-Gate: Deterministic-First Constraint- and Role-Aware Semantic Mapping with Selective Model Assistance Across Heterogeneous Industrial Standards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37458)
*Kabeh Mohsenzadegan,Vahid Tavakkoli,Kyandoghere Kyamakya*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CRASM——一种确定性的、约束与角色感知的工业标准语义映射方法，以及其可选模型辅助扩展CRASM-Gate，通过"确定性优先"架构在六个标准配对、三类难度、十种配置共14,400条决策上实现F1 0.9938与结构有效率达1.0000。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业标准常通过互不兼容的层级、标识符、角色与结构约束来表达同一工程概念，仅依赖词法或嵌入相似度的最近邻匹配在技术上可能不可用。因此需要一种兼顾约束合规性与角色语义（源端与目标端角色差异）的映射方法，以提升标准间互操作的正确性。

Method: CRASM将流程分解为标准特定规范化、有界检索、确定性规则、目标端与源端角色解读、语义与结构化排序、歧义拒答以及目标校验；CRASM-Gate在此基础上加入置信度/分歧门控，仅在必要时调用候选受限的大语言模型，最终裁决权仍归确定性校验。

Result: 在固定本地模型端点下，CRASM-Gate平均F1为0.9938，结构有效率1.0000；纯确定性CRASM为0.9931且无需生成式模型调用；仅模型基线仅0.5347。相较基线，CRASM将top-1错误从670降至10，延迟为0.0688秒/样本（基线24.5263秒/样本）；CRASM-Gate在1,440例中仅多正确判定1例，延迟升至15.7666秒/样本。

Conclusion: 结果支持一种确定性优先的互操作架构：模型辅助是可选的、可度量的、受候选约束的，且无法绕过结构校验——代价是相较纯确定性方法带来显著延迟增长而收益极为有限。

Abstract: Industrial standards often encode the same engineering concept through incompatible hierarchies, identifiers, roles, and structural constraints, so the nearest lexical or embedding match can still be technically inadmissible. This article presents CRASM, a deterministic constraint- and role-aware semantic mapping method, and CRASM-Gate, its selectively model-assisted extension. The framework separates standard-specific canonicalization, bounded retrieval, deterministic rules, destination-versus-origin role interpretation, semantic and structural ranking, ambiguity refusal, and target validation. CRASM-Gate adds a confidence/disagreement gate that may invoke a candidate-constrained large language model, while final authority remains with deterministic validation. A controlled artifact covers six directed industrial-standard pairs, three difficulty levels, and ten configurations, yielding 14,400 sample-level decisions. With a fixed local model endpoint, CRASM-Gate reaches mean F1 0.9938 and an implemented structural-validity rate of 1.0000; deterministic CRASM reaches 0.9931 without generative-model calls; and the model-only baseline reaches 0.5347. Relative to the model-only baseline, CRASM reduces top-1 errors from 670 to 10 while exhibiting 0.0688 s/sample rather than 24.5263 s/sample observed latency. CRASM-Gate improves CRASM by one additional correct decision out of 1,440, with observed latency increasing to 15.7666 s/sample. The results support a deterministic-first interoperability architecture in which model assistance is optional, measurable, candidate-bounded, and unable to bypass structural validation.

</details>


### [515] [Authority Before Utility: Non-Compensatory Control for Persistent LLM Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37474)
*Wesley Shu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Summary generation failed


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: Persistent memory creates a control problem that retrieval relevance alone does not solve: a memory can remain highly useful after an update, deletion, or revocation makes it inadmissible for the current answer. We formalize this as a separation between utility and authority. A fixed finite penalty applied to an unnormalized utility score cannot guarantee exclusion under arbitrary positive-affine reparameterization of that score; by contrast, rank-normalized compensation is scale-invariant and therefore forms a stronger empirical comparator.
  Our prospectively frozen TIDE/LongMemEval primary was quarantined before a valid HELDOUT comparison because the materialized TIDE adapter conflated historical age with query-relative inadmissibility and the aligned LongMemEval split left no DEV set for the predeclared penalty selection. We therefore report a post-primary replacement diagnostic on Memora Remembering, where update/delete operations provide item-level forgetting state.
