  On Qwen3-8B, DEV selected lambda = 0.6 from a ten-point normalized SOFT family. Across 185 HELDOUT units in 28 dependency clusters, HARD exclusion yields 4.04% balanced construct error versus 19.66% for locked SOFT, a paired difference of 15.61 points with a 20,000-replicate cluster-bootstrap 95% interval of [13.07, 18.76].
  The effect is driven primarily by forgotten-value leakage while current-value recall is preserved. This is same-Q operator-comparison evidence, not a universal claim that scalar control fails, not an evaluation of learned authority inference, and not an independent downstream-harm endpoint.

</details>


### [516] [Boundary-State Control for Tool-Using Language-Model Agents: Commit-Time Consistency under State Drift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37475)
*Wesley Shu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文研究语言模型智能体"提议-提交"间隙的安全问题，提出确定性的效果边界机制 BSC-R，将一次性提交授权绑定到具体动作与授权状态的语义投影，在多个测试集上验证其有效性并明确指出其适用范围局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工具调用型语言模型智能体可能在安全相关状态发生变化后才判定某动作可执行并提交，从而产生"提议-提交间隙"（proposal-to-commit gap）风险。现有机制缺乏对提交时刻状态一致性的确定性约束，因此需要研究如何在提交时刻将授权与动作及授权状态严格绑定。

Method: 提出 BSC-R——一种确定性效果边界机制（boundary kernel），将单次使用的提交授权绑定到确切动作，以及支撑该授权的授权状态的语义投影。在 AgentDojo 攻击回合、冻结提议、边界漂移实验及外部 CONTINUITY 测试套件上进行评估，覆盖未变更提交、变更或重放类别、无效上下文与模糊无释放情形。

Result: 在 2,847 个受攻击 AgentDojo 回合上，边界内核完全保持未受保护智能体行为（效用 80.576%，攻击成功率 1.616%）；在 10,302 个冻结提议上接受所有未变更提交，拒绝全部十类前瞻性指定的变更或重放实例。边界漂移实验中，完全联合绑定对 0/4,403 个无效上下文提交，保留 5,899/5,899 个有效上下文。CONTINUITY 套件（3,460 场景）保留全部 700 个良性案例，阻止 1,200/1,200 个非重放无效效果，正确处理 160/160 个重放生命周期，并拒绝 200/200 个模糊无释放案例。但在更广外部套件中，BSC-R 在全部 2,560 次攻击上的无效效果提交率为 25%，而 CONTINUITY 为 0%。

Conclusion: BSC-R 是一种有明确适用范围的提交时刻一致性机制，而非通用智能体安全方案。它在受控与特定测试条件下表现优异，但在更广泛的外部攻击场景中存在明显局限（25% 无效效果提交率），因此不应被泛化为普适的智能体安全保证。

Abstract: Tool-using language-model agents can decide that an action is permissible and execute it only after security-relevant state has changed. We study this proposal-to-commit gap and introduce BSC-R, a deterministic effect-boundary mechanism that binds a single-use commit authorization to the exact action and to a semantic projection of the authorization state that justified it. On 2,847 attacked AgentDojo episodes, the boundary kernel preserves the unprotected agent's behavior exactly (80.576% utility; 1.616% attack success). On 10,302 frozen proposals, it accepts every unchanged commit and rejects every instance of ten prospectively specified changed or replayed classes. In an independently generated boundary-drift experiment, full joint binding commits 0/4,403 invalid contexts while retaining 5,899/5,899 valid contexts. A prospective external evaluation on the 3,460-scenario CONTINUITY suite retains all 700 benign cases, prevents 1,200/1,200 represented non-replay invalid effects, handles 160/160 replay lifecycles correctly, and withholds 200/200 ambiguous no-release cases. The broader external suite also exposes the method's limit: across all 2,560 attacks, BSC-R has a 25% invalid-effect commit rate versus 0% for CONTINUITY. The result is therefore a scoped commit-time consistency mechanism, not a universal agent-safety claim.

</details>


### [517] [SkillGym: Training Skill-Use Agents with Automatic Verifiable Environment Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37539)
*Renxi Wang,Mingshan Hee,Fajri Koto,Timothy Baldwin,Haonan Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SkillGym：自动构建可验证环境、采集轨迹并训练技能使用智能体的流水线，用6.8k环境与19k验证轨迹做SFT，显著提升2B–122B模型在四个技能使用基准上的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 技能虽已广泛用于LLM智能体以完成长程复杂任务，但如何合成可靠的训练数据、如何训练智能体使用技能仍缺乏研究。

Method: 从互联网爬取大量技能，仅保留工作流可离线可复现运行的技能；通过builder-reviewer流水线构建难度可控、涵盖四类任务的任务集，每个任务配有参考解与可执行验证器；据此构建6.8k环境并采集19k条经验证的成功轨迹用于监督微调。

Result: 在两个基准上，Qwen3.5-9B SFT模型超过397B未训练模型；训练使智能体读取相关技能的比例从28%提升至96%；增益跨推理结构保持，并泛化到少数类任务类型及训练中未出现的技能。

Conclusion: 自动可验证环境与轨迹采集能有效训练技能使用智能体，SFT可跨模型家族与规模（2B–122B）提升技能使用能力并具备良好泛化性。

Abstract: Skills equip LLM agents with professional knowledge and guidance to complete long-horizon and complex tasks. Although skills have been widely adopted in recent agent paradigms and harnesses, how to synthesize reliable training data and how to train agents for skill use remain underexplored. In this work, we propose SkillGym, an automatic pipeline to build verifiable environments, collect trajectories, and train skill-use agents. SkillGym first crawls a large volume of skills from the internet, then keeps those whose workflows can run reproducibly offline. A builder-reviewer pipeline is used to construct difficulty-controlled tasks, spanning four task types, each with a reference solution and an executable verifier. With this pipeline, we build 6.8k environments and collect 19k verified successful trajectories for supervised finetuning. Finetuning on these trajectories improves LLMs of different families and sizes, from 2B to 122B parameters across four skill-use benchmarks; Our Qwen3.5-9B SFT model outperforms the 397B untrained model on two of them. Further analysis shows that training teaches agents to invoke skills, raising the rate of reading the relevant skill from 28% to 96%, and that the gains hold across reasoning structures, extending to task types that form a minority of the training data and to skills held out from training

</details>


### [518] [How Can Recommendation Feedback Evolve Agent Memory?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37544)
*Shanwen Mao,Mingming Li,Hao Zhang,Zhiheng Li,Yige Wang,Penghua Yu,Junxiong Zhu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出TIDE外部记忆进化框架，利用延迟且含噪的推荐反馈进行记忆适应度优化，并定义MEG指标衡量记忆进化增益。在电商内容生成智能体上离线+7.75pp，在线UCTR与激活率显著提升，且在延迟标签基准上MAE/RMSE最低、MEG最高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 内容生成智能体虽能持续获得推荐系统的曝光、点击、转化与负反馈信号，但这些信号延迟且噪声大，受到受众构成、投放位置与推荐策略的混杂影响，并可能由多个记忆共同作用产生，导致准确归因困难。现有方法主要依赖即时反馈或语义检索，难以可靠地将推荐结果转化为记忆适应度。

Method: 提出TIDE（Trajectory-Informed Directed Memory Evolution）外部记忆进化框架，由延迟推荐反馈驱动。将记忆建模为容量受限的经验种群：通过时间与语义信用分配估计上下文适应度，通过责任信用（responsibility credit）依据生成过程中被引用的记忆来分配结果信号；据此对记忆执行强化、交叉、变异或淘汰操作。同时提出Memory Evolution Gain（MEG），衡量进化后记忆在严格未来任务上相对无记忆基线的效用提升。

Result: 在电商会员营销内容生成智能体上，TIDE在离线时间回放中取得+7.75个百分点的MEG，并在在线A/B测试中显著提升独立点击率（UCTR）与激活率。在延迟标签基准上，TIDE在对比方法中取得最低MAE与RMSE以及最高MEG。

Conclusion: TIDE能够将延迟、含噪且混杂的推荐反馈有效转化为记忆适应度，通过信用分配与种群式进化机制实现记忆定向演化，实证表明其离线与在线效果均优于现有方法。

Abstract: Content-generation agents continuously receive impressions, clicks, conversions, and negative feedback from recommendation systems, providing real-world outcome signals for memory evolution. However, these signals are delayed and noisy, confounded by audience composition, placement, and recommendation policies, and may result from the combined influence of multiple memories, making accurate attribution difficult. Existing methods rely primarily on immediate feedback or semantic retrieval and therefore struggle to reliably translate recommendation outcomes into memory fitness. To address this challenge, we propose TIDE (Trajectory-Informed Directed Memory Evolution), an external memory evolution framework driven by delayed recommendation feedback. We further introduce Memory Evolution Gain (MEG), which measures the utility improvement of evolved memory over a no memory baseline on strictly future tasks. TIDE treats memory as a capacity-constrained population of experiences: temporal and semantic credit assignment estimates contextual fitness, while responsibility credit distributes outcome signals according to the memories referenced during generation. These signals are then used to reinforce, crossover, mutate, or evict memories. On an e-commerce membership marketing content-generation agent, TIDE achieves a +7.75-percentage-point MEG in offline temporal replay and significantly improves both unique click-through rate (UCTR) and activation rate in an online A/B test. On a delayed-label benchmark, TIDE achieves the lowest mean absolute error (MAE) and root mean squared error (RMSE) and the highest MEG among the compared methods, demonstrating its effectiveness.

</details>


### [519] [Rational Clarification by Assistive Agents via Value-of-Information Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37588)
*T. Duy Nguyen-Hien,Yee Whye Teh,Wee Sun Lee,Tan Zhi-Xuan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 REVOIR，通过推理时计算提问的“信息价值”来决定是否澄清用户请求，在减少提问次数的同时提升任务表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言智能助手常遇模糊请求，需在直接执行与提问澄清间权衡。常用方法只追求最小化意图不确定性，却忽略了不确定性降低对下游性能的影响、提问与立即行动的成本差异，以及用户可能主动纠错的可能性。因此需要一种更全面的澄清决策机制。

Method: REVOIR（Rational Enquiry via Value-of-Information Reasoning）在推理阶段评估一个问题的信息价值，即该问题答案带来的任务奖励期望提升，并据此决定是否提问。无需训练，属于推理时决策方法。

Result: 在两个助手任务（CondAmbigQA 和 ADAPT）中，REVOIR 相比 prompting、chain-of-thought、fine-tuning 和信息增益方法，以更少提问获得更高成功率。在 ADAPT 上，其偏好满足度比微调澄清策略高 13-15%，无需训练且提问次数少五倍。当允许廉价用户纠错时，REVOIR 能推断提问并非总是高效，表现出自适应性；而普通推理智能体无法自适应澄清，且推理努力增加时提问更少。

Conclusion: 基于信息价值的推理式澄清决策优于仅最小化不确定性的方法，能在安全性与有帮助性之间取得更好平衡，并具备对用户纠错机制的适应性。

Abstract: Users of language-based assistive agents often make ambiguous requests. In response, an assistant can either directly act on its interpretation of the request --- risking misalignment with the user --- or ask a clarifying question. Which option is the most safe and helpful? A common approach is to ask questions that minimize uncertainty about the user's intent until a threshold is reached. However, this neglects the impact of uncertainty reduction on downstream performance, the costs of asking versus acting immediately, and the possibility that users may provide corrections without being asked. To navigate these trade-offs, we introduce Rational Enquiry via Value-of-Information Reasoning (REVOIR). REVOIR makes clarification decisions via inference-time reasoning about the value-of-information of a question, which captures the expected improvement in task reward due to the answer received. In two assistive tasks --- ambiguous question answering (CondAmbigQA) and preference-aligned household task planning (ADAPT) --- we show that REVOIR achieves greater success with fewer questions than approaches based on prompting, chain-of-thought, fine-tuning, or information gain, improving preference satisfaction on ADAPT by 13-15% over a fine-tuned clarification policy while requiring no training and asking five times fewer questions. Furthermore, when the assistant can receive cheap user corrections after acting, REVOIR naturally infers that asking questions is not always efficient, demonstrating the adaptivity of our approach. In contrast, we find that vanilla reasoning agents fail to adaptively clarify user requests, and request fewer clarifications as reasoning effort increases.

</details>


### [520] [FOCUS: Training-Free Decision-Preserving Context Compression for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37590)
*Shantanu Dixit,Anson Bastos,Xuchao Zhang,Chetan Bansal,Saravan Rajmohan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出免训练上下文压缩框架FOCUS，将压缩重构为离散交互单元上的因果决策保持问题，在测试时动态压缩历史，最高减少48%峰值上下文、73%依赖，任务成功率提升8.9个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体的交互历史随任务长度线性增长，导致推理成本二次方级上升及注意力稀释带来的性能退化。现有上下文压缩方法依赖离线学习丢弃策略（对比优化准则、蒸馏压缩器或训练压缩策略），成本高昂，且压缩策略是先验学习的，无法根据测试时不断演化的轨迹动态调整。

Method: 将上下文压缩重新表述为离散交互单元上的因果决策保持问题，提出FOCUS——一个完全在测试时运行、无需训练的上下文压缩框架。该方法无需离线数据收集或微调，与架构无关，可作为模块化压缩层接入任意闭源API前沿模型。

Result: 在涵盖API与工具调用、问答、网页领域及多轮对话等多样化智能体基准上评估FOCUS。方法取得新的最优性能：峰值上下文最多减少48%，依赖度降低73%，相比未压缩执行任务成功率最高提升8.9个百分点。

Conclusion: 通过因果视角识别哪些历史交互真正塑造智能体未来决策，FOCUS证明免训练、测试时动态的上下文压缩可在降低计算成本的同时提升任务表现，为智能体长程交互提供可扩展的通用压缩方案。

Abstract: LLM agents accumulate interaction histories that grow linearly with task length, causing quadratic inference cost scaling and performance degradation from attention dilution. Existing context-compression methods learn what to discard offline: by contrastively optimizing guidelines, distilling compressors, or training compression policies. This incurs a substantial cost. Further, the compression policy is learned a priori and is not dynamically conditioned on the evolving test-time trajectories. In this paper we ask a complementary question: Which past interactions causally shape the agent's future decisions? We recast context compression as a causal decision preservation problem over discrete interaction units and introduce FOCUS, a training-free context compression framework that operates entirely at test time. Our method requires no offline data collection or fine-tuning, and is architecture-agnostic, attaching to any closed-API frontier model as a modular compression layer. We evaluate FOCUS on diverse agentic benchmarks including API and tool-calling, QA, web domain and multi-turn dialogue. Our method establishes new state of the art performance, cutting peak context by up to 48% and dependency by 73% while improving task success by up to 8.9 percentage points over uncompressed execution.

</details>


### [521] [XU-RS: Explaining Credal Width in Random-Set Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37594)
*David Achara,Maryam Sultana,Alexander D. Rast,Fabio Cuzzolin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出XU-RS框架，将随机集分类器中答案的credal width（认知不确定性）归因到输入token上，并用预期梯度估计token贡献；在MedQA上验证高排名token的零掩码比随机掩码引起更大的credal width变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 不确定性估计只告诉我们模型有多不确定，却不说明原因。若不知道输入的哪些部分影响模型不确定性，就无法判断该不确定性是否依赖与任务相关的输入特征。随机集分类器为答案产生上下概率，其差（credal width）表示由训练数据有限导致的认知不确定性，但目前缺乏对这种不确定性的输入归因方法。

Method: 提出XU-RS框架，在基于预训练语言模型的随机集分类器上，将答案的credal width归因到输入token（词或词片）。使用预期梯度（Expected Gradients，一种标准特征归因方法）估计各输入token对credal width的贡献。在MedQA数据集上，使用SmolLM3-3B与Llama-2-7B模型进行评估，采用零掩码（将token嵌入置零）对比高排名token与随机token的影响。

Result: 实验表明，将由XU-RS排名高的token的嵌入置零，比随机选择token置零引起更大的credal width变化，说明归因有效定位了影响不确定性的token。此外发现：归一化可能导致其他答案组影响某答案的width；token归因可能掩盖数值误差；并提出诊断性检查以验证高排名token是否真正有意义地解释模型不确定性。

Conclusion: XU-RS能够将随机集分类器的credal width归因到输入token，且归因结果经零掩码实验验证有效；但需注意归一化带来的答案组间影响、归因掩盖数值误差等问题，并使用诊断检查确保归因的可靠性。

Abstract: Uncertainty estimates tell us how unsure a model is, but not why. Without knowing which parts of an input influences a model's uncertainty, we cannot tell whether that uncertainty score depends on input features that are relevant for the task. We study this problem in randomset classifiers built using pretrained language models. These classifiers assign probability to individual answers and to groups of answers, producing lower and upper probabilities for each answer; The difference between these probabilities, called credal width, is used to represent epistemic uncertainty about an answer arising from limited training data. We propose XU-RS, a framework that attributes an answer's credal width to the input tokens (words or word pieces) supplied to a language model. XU-RS uses Expected Gradients (a standard feature attribution method) to estimate how input tokens contribute to credal width. The proposed framework is evaluated on a MedQA dataset using SmolLM3-3B and Llama-2-7B models, demonstrating that setting the embedding of a token ranked highly by XU-RS to zero (zero-masking) causes larger changes in credal width than zero-masking randomly selected tokens. In addition, we show that normalisation can cause other answer groups to influence an answer's width, reveal how token attribution can mask numerical errors, and provide diagnostic checks to verify whether a token ranked highly by XU-RS meaningfully explains model uncertainty.

</details>


### [522] [Flattening the Connectome Spectrum: A Spectral Filter for FC Induces a Pretraining Target for fMRI Encoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37642)
*Giovanni Marraffini,Victoria Shevchenko,Carlo Alberto Barbano,Demian Wassermann*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文指出基于功能连接(FC)矩阵的核岭回归(KRR)因FC特征值标定不当而估计有偏，提出对每个受试者FC矩阵进行谱滤波重标定，并据此预训练了一个小规模编码器，在5数据集、11分区、6预测目标上达到或超过KRR基线，且以数量级更少的参数媲美已发表的脑基础模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自监督预训练在语言与视觉领域重塑了预测范式，脑基础模型(BFMs)期望从大规模无标注语料中学习表征以捕捉个体功能动态并跨队列泛化。但实证发现，在FC矩阵上拟合的KRR在个体表型预测上仍优于所测的所有BFM，这一矛盾需要解释与解决。

Method: 1) 理论分析：证明KRR的估计被FC特征值加权，而这些特征值对表型预测而言是"失准"的。2) 对每个受试者的FC矩阵施加高效的谱滤波，重标定其特征值，从而释放更多个体间方差。3) 基于该发现，在约4,000小时fMRI（来自162个公开数据集）上预训练一个小型编码器，通过将记录片段嵌入之间的成对相似度与重标定连接组之间的相似度对齐来进行自监督学习。

Result: 在5个数据集、11种分区方案和6个预测目标上，所提方法匹配或超过了KRR基线；预训练编码器以数量级更少的参数量达到与所测6个已发表BFM中最优者相当的性能；在短扫描和较小队列上优于FC，尤其在指纹识别(fingerprinting)任务中表现更好。

Conclusion: FC矩阵特征值的失准是KRR优于BFM的关键原因；谱重标定能有效改善表型预测并指导表征学习。该工作提供了更高效的建模路径，并公开了预训练权重、代码及预处理与分区后的预训练数据。

Abstract: Self-supervised pretraining reshaped prediction in language and vision, and brain foundation models (BFMs) inherited its promise. Representations learned from large unlabelled corpora should capture individual functional dynamics and generalise across cohorts. However, kernel ridge regression (KRR) fitted on functional connectivity (FC) matrices still predicts individual phenotypes more accurately than any BFM we tested. In this paper, we show that KRR is weighted by the eigenvalues of the FC which are miscalibrated for phenotype prediction. We apply an efficient spectral filter to recalibrate the eigenvalues of each subject's FC matrix, enabling the model to exploit more inter-individual variance. Across the 5 datasets, 11 parcellations and 6 prediction targets we tested, we match or exceed the KRR baseline. Based on this finding, we then pretrain a small encoder model on about 4,000 hours of fMRI from 162 open datasets, whereby we align the pairwise similarities between the embeddings of recording snippets with those between the recalibrated connectomes. Our model performs on par with the best of the 6 published BFMs we tested while having an order of magnitude fewer parameters. Our encoder performs better than FC on short scans and in smaller cohorts, especially in fingerprinting. We release the pretrained model weights, the code and the pretraining data, preprocessed and parcellated.

</details>


### [523] [Beyond a single latent space: a dual-latent world model for long-horizon planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37644)
*Delin Zhao,Zhengrong Yue,Shaobin Zhuang,Junlin He,Xiaoyu Chen,Zikang Wang,Yuxin Liu,Limin Wang,Yali Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Dual-WM双潜在世界模型，将局部执行与长程规划解耦为两层状态表征与动力学模型，并配合LoRe多horizon加权训练，在5个视觉目标条件控制任务上显著提升长程规划成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜在世界模型短期预测准确，但长程规划困难：递归rollout导致误差累积；高维潜在空间中的距离集中（distance concentration）削弱了目标判别能力。核心动机是解决这两个长程规划瓶颈。

Method: 提出双潜在世界模型Dual-WM，通过不同状态表征与动力学模型分离局部执行与长程规划：低层模型预测动作条件转移，高层模型使用学到的macro-action在更长时间跨度上规划。同时提出LoRe（Long-Horizon Representation Learning with Weighted Rollout），对两个层级自生成预测进行监督，基于递归误差传播分析导出两个时间尺度上独立的指数horizon权重与衰减率。规划时高层生成潜在subgoal，低层将其细化为动作执行。

Result: 在5个目标条件视觉控制任务上从零训练，与各任务最强且无actor引导proposal的基线对比：目标偏移50步时平均成功率从75.9%提升至84.4%；偏移100步时从61.4%提升至69.5%。在偏移100步时，Dual-WM在全部5个任务上优于基线，平均成功率比LeWM高30.8个百分点。消融与分析表明表征对目标评估更具信息量，递归预测下一致性更强。

Conclusion: 分离时间角色并跨多个horizon进行训练，对可靠的潜在规划具有重要价值。研究强调了双层级设计在缓解递归误差与提升目标判别上的有效性。

Abstract: Latent world models often struggle with long-horizon planning despite accurate short-term predictions. Recursive rollouts accumulate errors, while distance concentration in high-dimensional latent spaces can weaken goal discrimination. We introduce the Dual-Latent World Model (Dual-WM), which separates local execution and long-range planning through distinct state representations and dynamics models. The low-level model predicts action-conditioned transitions, while the high-level model uses learned macro-actions to plan over longer temporal spans. We also propose Long-Horizon Representation Learning with Weighted Rollout (LoRe), which supervises self-generated predictions at both levels. An analysis of recursive error propagation motivates exponential horizon weights with separate decay rates for the two temporal scales. During planning, the high-level model generates latent subgoals that the low-level model refines into actions for precise execution. We evaluate from-scratch Dual-WM on five goal-conditioned visual control tasks against the task-wise strongest baselines without actor-guided proposals. At goal offsets of 50 and 100 environment steps, mean success increases from 75.9% to 84.4% and from 61.4% to 69.5%, respectively. At offset 100, Dual-WM outperforms these baselines on all five tasks and improves mean success over LeWM by 30.8 percentage points. Ablations and supporting analyses provide evidence of more informative representations for goal evaluation and greater consistency under recursive prediction. These results highlight the value of separating temporal roles and training across multiple horizons for reliable latent planning. Our core implementation is available at https://github.com/DeLin1001/Dual-WM-Official.

</details>


### [524] [EnterpriseBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Enterprise-Level Strategic Reasoning and Decision-Making](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37658)
*Min Yang,Yichen Pan,Jinghua Piao,Dandan Song,Yongshun Gong,Yong Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 EnterpriseBench，一个覆盖从静态问答到动态决策的 LLM 智能体企业场景基准，包含统一的基础能力套件与三个专业交互式场景（Consulting、Beer Game、Enterprise Digital Twin），实验表明现有智能体尚不具备稳定、全面、跨任务的可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业工作流任务常涉及信息缺失、不确定性、反馈和长期权衡，但现有企业与金融基准主要考察信息抽取、数值计算、领域知识和金融问答等静态能力，缺乏对交互式、长时程决策能力的评测，存在明显空白。

Method: 将既有企业与金融问答数据集重组为按能力与难度标注的统一基础套件；并设计三个专业交互式设置：Consulting（基于管理咨询式商业案例，通过多轮信息搜寻进行客户问题诊断）、Beer Game（改编自经典供应链管理模拟，考察延迟反馈下的库存控制）、Enterprise Digital Twin（项目制商业模拟器，用于人力、风险与项目规划）。在四种基座模型上评测九种智能体方法。

Result: 实验显示当前智能体在企业场景中尚未达到稳定、全面且跨任务的可靠性。

Conclusion: EnterpriseBench 为在真实企业战略推理与决策场景中评测 LLM 智能体提供了实用基准，揭示了现有方法在交互式与长时程企业任务上的能力不足。

Abstract: LLM agents are increasingly expected to support enterprise workflows, where tasks often involve missing information, uncertainty, feedback, and long-term trade-offs. However, existing enterprise and financial benchmarks mainly test static capabilities such as information extraction, numerical calculation, domain knowledge, and financial QA, leaving interactive and long-horizon decision-making underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce EnterpriseBench, a benchmark that evaluates LLM agents across this spectrum, from static question answering to dynamic decision-making. Specifically, EnterpriseBench reorganizes existing enterprise and financial QA datasets into a unified foundational suite annotated by capability and difficulty, and introduces three professional interactive settings: Consulting, based on management-consulting-style business cases for client problem diagnosis through multi-turn information seeking; the Beer Game, adapted from a classic supply-chain management simulation for inventory control under delayed feedback; and Enterprise Digital Twin, a project-based business simulator for workforce, risk, and project planning. Experiments with nine agent methods under four backbone models show that current agents have not yet achieved stable, comprehensive, and cross-task reliability in enterprise scenarios. These results show that EnterpriseBench provides a practical benchmark for evaluating LLM agents in realistic enterprise strategic reasoning and decision-making.

</details>


### [525] [KUPAS MASTER: Distilling the Tacit Expertise of Master Practitioners into Agent-Ready Experience Corpora](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37673)
*Changmian Wang,Yuchao Ma,Xuchao Lu,Chen Zhang,Ping Sun,Jiazheng Wang,Shan Wang,Xuanwen Chen,Yihe Sun,Ziyu Lu,Jianqiang Huang,Hongzhi Li,Ziqing Xia,Kaihua Tang,Xian-Sheng Hua,Qinghua Zheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出经验工程平台KUPAS MASTER，通过九层认知语料构建将隐性专业经验转化为可追溯、可复用的智能体能力，实验证明其显著优于基线模型与原始语料RAG。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经验丰富的专业人士掌握的不仅是事实与结论，还包括关键线索、判断依据与行动选择，但这些隐性知识常被日常工作记录遗漏，导致LLM智能体难以有效利用专业经验。

Method: 以九层认知语料构建为核心；用情境、线索、判断、行动、边界、结果六要素保留任务过程；沿九个抽取维度组织隐性经验，并存入规则、约束、最佳实践、反例、边缘案例、技能六个库；通过语义对齐、个体经验蒸馏、组织整合与交叉复核保留来源证据、适用条件与未决分歧；将资产封装为具明确输入、步骤、依赖与停止条件的可调用技能，连接经验采集、任务执行与评估反馈。

Result: 以20名随机抽取从业者的授权样本，将1,576个源文件处理为23,024条个体经验记录与13,113项组织资产；在相同任务输入与评分标准下，基础模型、原始语料RAG、KUPAS MASTER智能体得分分别为70.63、79.75、89.58，且在全部七个评分维度上均优于原始语料RAG。

Conclusion: 该平台为从个体隐性经验到组织知识再到智能体能力提供了可落地路径，实现了经验采集到任务执行与评估反馈的闭环。

Abstract: Experienced professionals know more than just facts and conclusions. They know which cues matter, why a judgment is reasonable, and which action to take. Routine work records often leave out this tacit knowledge, making it difficult for Large Language Model (LLM) agents to use professional experience effectively. We introduce KUPAS MASTER, an experience engineering platform built around nine-layer cognitive corpus construction. It turns heterogeneous work records and practitioner interviews into traceable, reusable experience corpora for agents. Six case elements preserve the task process: context, cues, judgment, action, boundaries, and outcomes. Nine-layer cognitive corpus construction organizes tacit experience along nine extraction dimensions and stores the resulting assets in six libraries: rules, constraints, best practices, negative examples, corner cases, and skills. Semantic alignment, individual experience distillation, organizational consolidation, and cross-review preserve source evidence, conditions of use, and unresolved disagreements. The platform packages these assets into callable skills with explicit inputs, steps, dependencies, and stopping conditions, connecting experience collection to task execution and evaluation feedback. Using authorized samples from 20 randomly selected practitioners, the platform processed 1,576 source files into 23,024 individual experience records and 13,113 organizational assets. The evaluation spans multiple professional domains. Under common task inputs and scoring criteria, the base model, raw corpus retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and KUPAS MASTER agent scored 70.63, 79.75, and 89.58, respectively. The KUPAS MASTER agent improved on raw-corpus RAG in all seven scoring dimensions. The platform provides a practical path from individual tacit experience to organizational knowledge and agent capabilities.

</details>


### [526] [MeanFlowAdvantage: Stable Reward Fine-Tuning for Few-Step Average-Velocity Generators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37670)
*Haocheng Tang,Tianchi Xie,Xingqiao Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 MeanFlowAdvantage：针对 MeanFlow 平均速度生成器的带符号优势加权最小二乘目标，在推理部署的均值速度网络上直接优化奖励，保持原生少步采样器，实现 4 步生成达到甚至超越 40 步基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MeanFlow 通过预测区间平均速度实现高效少步生成，但该表示与奖励微调存在错配：现有基于优势的目标通常定义在瞬时速度或等价的 x0 空间预测上，而推理时直接使用学习到的平均速度映射，导致奖励改进难以转移到实际部署的采样器。

Method: MeanFlowAdvantage 是一种面向平均速度生成器的带符号优势加权最小二乘目标。其核心构造使用一个共享的、detached 的 MeanFlow 导数校正项，将奖励目标表达在预测空间中，同时使 rollout 与参考正则化成为对推理时部署的平均速度网络的精确惩罚。该公式保持 MeanFlow 原生少步采样器，并提供将奖励提升直接迁移到部署流映射的机制。

Result: 在 SD3.5-Medium 上，MeanFlowAdvantage 在全部八项指标上均优于匹配的四步 MeanFlowNFT 基线，并且仅用 4 次 NFE 就在八项指标中的六项上达到或超过 40 步 DiffusionNFT 基线。该目标还迁移到 DNA 启动子设计，支持流形生成器的无教师 on-policy RL 与教师引导的奖励分级蒸馏，其中后者在所比较配置中取得最低的一步 Sei profile MSE。

Conclusion: MeanFlowAdvantage 通过统一的平均速度空间奖励微调框架，消除了 MeanFlow 表示与优势目标之间的错配，在图像生成与 DNA 启动子设计任务上均验证了其有效性，实现了少步采样下的高效奖励对齐。

Abstract: MeanFlow enables efficient few-step generation by predicting interval-average velocities, but this representation creates a mismatch for reward fine-tuning: existing advantage-based objectives are typically defined on instantaneous velocities or equivalent $x_0$-space predictions, whereas inference directly uses the learned average-velocity map. We introduce MeanFlowAdvantage, a signed advantage-weighted least-squares objective for average-velocity generators. Our key construction uses a shared, detached MeanFlow derivative correction to express the reward objective in prediction space while making rollout and reference regularization exact penalties on the average-velocity network deployed at inference. The resulting formulation preserves MeanFlow's native few-step sampler and provides a direct mechanism for transferring reward improvements to the deployed flow map. On SD3.5-Medium, MeanFlowAdvantage improves all eight reported metrics over the matched four-step MeanFlowNFT baseline and, with only four NFEs, matches or exceeds the 40-step DiffusionNFT baseline on six of eight metrics. The same objective also transfers to DNA promoter design, where it supports both teacher-free on-policy RL for a generator defined on a manifold and teacher-guided reward-graded distillation, with the latter yielding the lowest one-step Sei profile MSE among the compared configurations.

</details>


### [527] [EngiWorld: What Can Frontier Agents Deliver in Professional Engineering Environments?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37686)
*Hongcheng Gao,Hailong Qu,Yu Lei,Henghui Sun,Haoyang Li,Yipeng Wei,Naihao Xue,Xiaohan Yu,Zhuo Tao,Yihe Zang,Yajiao Wang,Jingyi Tang,Yi Li,Jingjing Zhou,Jie Luo,Bohan Zeng,Chengyu Shen,Hao Jiang,Chong Chen,Bowen Qu,Olive Huang,Zeqiang Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 EngiWorld，首个面向完整工程设计闭环的基准，含 1301 个专家任务、26 个专业软件、GUI/CLI 双接口与 6 类任务；并引入以制品为中心、基于统一领域验证器套件的评测方法，对几何有效性、物理可行性与规则合规性进行程序化校验，并按规格达成度连续打分。七个前沿模型评测显示能力缺口显著：最高 EngiScore 仅 44.3，多软件任务成功率仅 3.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用计算机使用智能体进展迅速，但专业工业工程流程的可靠自动化仍难以实现。其核心难点在于工程工作流需要在软件与设计阶段之间保持几何、物理约束及依赖关系的推理，现有基准缺乏对完整设计闭环与专业工程软件端到端操作的严格衡量。

Method: 构建 EngiWorld 基准：覆盖 CAD、CAE、CAM、BIM、EDA、3D 可视化 6 个工程领域与 26 个专业软件平台，共 1301 个专家标注任务；提供 GUI 与 CLI 两种交互接口；任务类型有 6 种，从软件选择到开放式任务。评测方法为以制品为中心，基于统一领域验证器套件，对最终与中间产物程序化检查几何有效性、物理可行性与规则合规性，并对定量设计任务按规格达成度连续评分而非二值判定。

Result: 对七个前沿模型的评测揭示了显著能力缺口：最强模型 EngiScore 仅为 44.3；涉及多软件协作的任务中，仅 3.6% 的尝试成功。

Conclusion: EngiWorld 为衡量智能体在专业工程软件中端到端作业能力提供了首个严格基础，可推动面向真实工业工程工作流的智能体研究进展。

Abstract: Autonomous agents have made rapid progress in general-purpose computer use, but reliable automation of professional industrial engineering remains out of reach, as engineering workflows demand reasoning over geometric and physical constraints and dependencies preserved across software and design stages. We present EngiWorld, the first benchmark structured around the complete design loop: 1,301 expert-curated tasks spanning 6 engineering domains (CAD, CAE, CAM, BIM, EDA, and 3D visualization) and 26 professional software platforms, with both GUI and CLI interfaces and 6 task types ranging from software-selection to open-ended tasks. We further introduce an artifact-centric evaluation methodology built on a unified domain-verifier suite, which programmatically checks the geometric validity, physical feasibility, and rule compliance of final and intermediate artifacts, and scores quantitative design tasks continuously by specification attainment rather than binary success. Evaluation of seven frontier models reveals a substantial capability gap: the strongest model achieves an EngiScore of only 44.3, and just 3.6% of multi-software attempts succeed. EngiWorld provides the first rigorous foundation for measuring progress toward agents that operate professional engineering software end to end.

</details>


### [528] [Context Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37725)
*Rulin Shao,Shannon Zejiang Shen,Junjie Oscar Yin,Yuetai Li,Minheng Wang,Hamish Ivison,Radha Poovendran,Nathan Lambert,Teng Xiao,Mike Lewis,Wen-tau Yih,Luke Zettlemoyer,Pang Wei Koh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出上下文语言模型（CLM），将上下文视为模型可自主修改的文件，实现内在化的上下文管理，在多项任务上超越现有SOTA策略并显著降低计算量，同时支持上下文管理与参数化学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有上下文管理依赖外部框架（harness）控制，模型无法自主学习应保留哪些关键信息。作者希望将上下文管理从外部控制转变为模型内在行为，使其能自主学习上下文维护策略，并自然扩展到多智能体场景。

Method: 将上下文视为文件，允许模型对其进行无限制更新；用现有模型零样本构建CLM；扩展到多智能体系统中多上下文文件共存；通过自然语言指令（经技能优化循环演化）对CLM进行引导；提出面向CLM的在线强化学习方法；并为CLM服务协同设计Suffix Cache Reuse。

Result: 零样本CLM在多项任务上超越SOTA：BrowseComp-Plus准确率高11.4%且FLOPs少21.5%；12小时EdgeBench得分高5%且FLOPs少59%；24小时多仓库智能体集群任务同等算力下提升65%。技能优化引导使留出准确率提升至多35.9分并降低计算。在线RL使Qwen3.5-9B在BrowseComp-Plus上提升47.6%且FLOPs减少12%。Suffix Cache Reuse在同等性能下比标准SGLang再减少35%服务器端计算。

Conclusion: 将上下文管理由外部控制转为模型内在行为，可同时支持上下文学习与参数化学习，并可通过自然语言指令引导、在线强化学习优化，配合服务端缓存协同设计进一步降低计算成本。

Abstract: We introduce Context Language Models (CLMs), language models that natively manage their own context. We implement this by treating the context as a file and allowing the model to make unrestricted updates to this file. This allows the model to learn what is most important to maintain in context, and naturally extends to multi-agent systems where multiple agent contexts coexist as files. Building CLMs zero-shot with existing models outperforms SOTA context management strategies across a variety of tasks: 11.4% higher accuracy with 21.5% fewer FLOPs on BrowseComp-Plus, 5% higher scores with 59% fewer FLOPs on 12-hour EdgeBench, and 65% greater improvement with the same compute on a 24-hour multi-repository agent-swarm task. Moreover, by shifting context management from external harness control to intrinsic model behavior, CLMs naturally enable both in-context and parametric learning of context-management strategies. We show that CLMs can be steered with natural-language instructions evolved through a standard skill-optimization loop, improving held-out accuracy by up to 35.9 points on a context-management task while reducing compute. We also introduce an online reinforcement learning method for CLMs, improving Qwen3.5-9B performance on BrowseComp-Plus by 47.6% while using 12% fewer FLOPs. Finally, we co-design Suffix Cache Reuse for CLM serving, further reducing server-side compute by 35% relative to standard SGLang at matched performance.

</details>


### [529] [Learning from Shared-Control Overrides: Context-Driven Acceleration Profile Prediction for Personalized Overtaking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37684)
*Ruizheng Xu,Lounis Adouane,Javier Ibañez-Guzmán,Clément Zinoune*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文将驾驶员对ACC的油门超越行为视为人机共享控制的监督信号，提出上下文驱动的个性化ACC框架CoP-ACC，通过层次聚类、上下文分类器与残差回归的混合流程生成个性化加速度曲线，在真实道路数据上实现高重构保真度并减少人工干预。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统ACC按"平均驾驶员"标定，在高速超车等时间关键场景下与个体期望不符，导致驾驶员频繁油门超越；这些超越行为蕴含对系统行为的隐式反馈，但未被系统利用，因此需要将其转化为个性化自适应的监督信号。

Method: 提出CoP-ACC三阶段混合管道：(i) 无监督层次聚类，从超越事件中提取代表性加速度曲线；(ii) 上下文分类器，将机动前的驾驶条件映射到相应曲线；(iii) 残差回归器，将所选曲线精修为平滑且贴合当前上下文的个性化加速度曲线。相较易过度平滑动态响应的端到端回归，该方法保留了曲线结构并加以细化。

Result: 在真实公开道路数据上，以保留的强制ACC基线为对照，方法展现出高重构保真度，所生成的加速度曲线在潜在超越场景中趋向驾驶员期望行为。

Conclusion: 从共享控制的超越行为中学习可实现预见性、个性化的ACC行为，减少人工干预并提升乘坐舒适性，验证了将隐式反馈用于个性化车辆自适应的潜力。

Abstract: Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC) systems are typically calibrated for an average driver, often resulting in a mismatch between vehicle behavior and individual expectations during time-critical maneuvers such as highway overtaking. When the ACC is perceived as too conservative and inconsistent, drivers intervene through throttle overrides, providing implicit feedback on the system's behavior. This paper reframes these override actions as human-in-theloop supervisory signals and proposes a data-driven framework for personalized vehicle adaptation, termed Context-driven Personalized ACC (CoP-ACC). Rather than relying solely on end-to-end regression, which tends to over-smooth dynamic responses, we introduce a hybrid pipeline combining: (i) unsupervised hierarchical clustering to extract representative acceleration profiles from override events; (ii) a context classifier that maps pre-maneuver driving conditions to the appropriate profile; and (iii) a residual regressor that refines the selected profile into a smooth, personalized acceleration profile tailored to the immediate context. Evaluated on real-world public-road data against a withheld forced-ACC baseline, the approach demonstrates high reconstruction fidelity and generates acceleration profiles that tend toward the driver's expected behavior in potential override contexts. The results highlight the potential of learning from shared-control overrides to enable anticipatory, personalized ACC behavior, reducing manual interventions and improving ride comfort.

</details>


### [530] [Can a Cacheable Decision Model Follow Rules?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37832)
*Dushyant Rajput,Nirdesh Chauhan,Siddharth Kosaraju*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文以小型非生成式决策模型 Certo（Qwen3-4B）为对象，考察将"联合打分"改为"独立编码+缓存"后规则敏感性是否保留、能否通过训练弥补，并通过四组实验给出证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联合打分器（同时读取状态、规则与候选）准确但推理成本随候选菜单线性增长；独立编码可让候选只编码一次并跨状态复用（77 个候选时约便宜 5 倍），但把状态与候选分离，可能导致对规则的敏感性下降。作者追问：这种可缓存化改造会损失多少规则敏感性，以及能否通过针对性监督训练回来。

Method: 在 Certo 上进行四组实验：(1) 对比联合打分与可缓存独立编码的规则敏感性，并测试 shortlist+rerank 补救；(2) 使用针对性反事实监督，在留出的合成规则任务（改写、反事实、组合）上评估，跨随机种子复现；(3) 在真实规则上评估，修正截断混杂后比较联合打分与缓存编码；(4) 构建匹配的跨领域真实文本混合数据，检验其增益与对合约准确率的影响。

Result: (1) 可缓存化改造后 recall@1 从 1.00 降至 0.24，联合打分器保持 1.00，shortlist+rerank 补救失败；(2) 反事实监督在留出的合成规则任务上恢复较强性能，且跨种子可复现，但未分离出预测是否依赖所提供的规则；(3) 真实规则上增益不成立：修正截断混杂后，联合打分在短档显著更优（0.861 vs 0.500），困难档呈方向性优势（0.655 vs 0.483，n=29）；(4) 匹配的跨领域真实文本混合无帮助，并使合约准确率下降 9.3 与 16.2 个百分点。

Conclusion: 可缓存编码器可以在其训练分布上被训练得具有规则敏感性，但向未见来源的真实规则迁移尚未得到证实；联合打分器保持优势，代价是放弃缓存带来的成本收益。

Abstract: Certo is a small non-generative decision model (Qwen3-4B): it scores candidate actions from their text and returns a probability, instead of generating an answer. The accurate design reads the state, the rules, and each candidate together (a joint scorer), so cost grows with the menu. Independent encoding lets each candidate be encoded once and reused across states (about 5x cheaper at 77 candidates), but separates state from candidate. We ask how much rule-sensitivity survives that move, and whether it can be trained back.
  Four experiments on Certo: (1) the tested conversion to cacheable scoring loses rule-sensitivity (recall@1 1.00 -> 0.24) while the joint scorer holds 1.00, and a shortlist+rerank rescue fails; (2) targeted counterfactual supervision restores strong performance on held-out synthetic rule tasks (paraphrase, counterfactual, composition; reproducible across seeds), though we do not isolate whether predictions depend on the supplied rule; (3) on real rules the added benefit is not established -- after fixing a truncation confound, the joint scorer wins significantly on the short tier (0.861 vs 0.500) and directionally on the hard tier (0.655 vs 0.483, n=29); (4) a matched cross-domain real-prose mixture did not help and reduced contract accuracy (-9.3, -16.2 points). A cacheable encoder can be made rule-sensitive on its training distribution, but transfer to unseen-source real rules is not established; the joint scorer keeps an edge at the cost of caching.

</details>


### [531] [SelfSearch: Reward-Free Search for Self-Improving Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37968)
*Jungwoo Yang,In Jin Kong,Yohan Jo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 SelfSearch：一种无奖励信号的自我改进搜索方法，让 LLM 智能体利用历史自我修改记录来改进自身，在多个模型-基准组合上提升成功率并降低开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有利用 LLM 智能体编码能力进行自我改进的方法依赖重复的下游评估来搜索更优智能体，代价高且将搜索过程绑定在特定评估任务上，缺乏通用性与效率。

Method: SelfSearch 采用无奖励（reward-free）搜索流程：智能体不依赖下游奖励信号，而是基于以往自我改进回合的记录（包含推理过程、工具动作与结果）来修改自身指令、工具和执行流程，从而同时改进任务求解与自我修改能力。

Result: 在全部六个模型-基准设置中，SelfSearch 相比初始智能体提升了群体平均成功率，单个智能体在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上最高提升 11.2 个百分点；在 SWE-bench Multilingual 上，成功率提升 5.0 个百分点，同时对初始与进化智能体均解决的任务，执行成本降低 38.5%。搜索成本仅 4.03 美元，生成的 harness 在公开九 harness 对比设置下用 DeepSeek V4 Flash 解决 Terminal-Bench 2.1 中 82.0% 的任务，与最高分 harness（Codex）持平。相比评估引导的搜索基线，在更低搜索成本下达到有竞争力的任务成功率。

Conclusion: 通过自我修改积累的经验能够提升智能体的下游能力与效率，SelfSearch 提供了一种低成本、无需下游奖励的自我改进搜索范式。

Abstract: Advances in the coding capabilities of LLM agents allow them to inspect and modify their own instructions, tools, and execution procedures. Existing approaches use this ability to search for improved agents through repeated downstream evaluation, which incurs substantial costs and ties the search to the evaluated tasks. We introduce \textbf{SelfSearch}, a reward-free search procedure in which agents modify themselves using records of previous self-improvement episodes. These records capture the reasoning, tool actions, and outcomes of earlier modification attempts, providing concrete experience for improving both task solving and self-modification. Without downstream reward signals during search, SelfSearch improves population-mean success over the initial agent in all six model--benchmark settings, with individual agents gaining up to 11.2 percentage points on Terminal-Bench 2.1. On SWE-bench Multilingual, an agent improves success by \textbf{5.0} percentage points while reducing execution cost by \textbf{38.5}\% on tasks solved by both the initial and evolved agents. SelfSearch achieves competitive task success with evaluation-guided search baselines at lower search cost. With only \textbf{\$4.03} in search cost, it produces a harness that solves \textbf{82.0}\% of Terminal-Bench 2.1 tasks with DeepSeek V4 Flash under the settings of a public nine-harness comparison, matching the top-scoring harness, Codex. These results suggest that experience gained through self-modification can improve agents' downstream capabilities and efficiency.

</details>


### [532] [WISE-ATTA: When to Ask for Labels in Budgeted Active Test-Time Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37687)
*Muhammad Huzaifa,Lea Schönherr,Thorsten Eisenhofer*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"预算化主动测试时自适应"（budgeted ATTA）问题，并设计WISE-ATTA方法，通过在线轻量信号决定何时施加监督，并结合漂移样本选择，在显著减少标注量的同时取得有竞争力或更优的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有主动测试时自适应（ATTA）方法普遍假设可对每个测试批次请求监督，在长测试流中会带来高昂的标注成本。作者希望将核心挑战从"批次内标注什么样本"转向"何时施加监督"，从而在有限标注预算下提升鲁棒性。

Method: 提出budgeted ATTA设定：仅对一小部分测试批次提供标签。提出WISE-ATTA：1）基于在线计算的轻量信号进行预算感知的监督分配，优先选择监督最有用的时段；2）当某批次被选中时，采用基于漂移的样本选择准则，瞄准仍在进行、未收敛的自适应动态样本，使单一样本即可实现有效更新。

Result: 在ImageNet-C合成损坏以及ImageNet-R/K/A自然分布偏移上评估，WISE-ATTA在标注量大幅减少的情况下，性能达到或超过近期ATTA方法。

Conclusion: 监督的时机（timing）是主动测试时自适应中被长期忽视但至关重要的方面；在有限预算下合理安排监督时机可有效提升自适应效果。代码已开源。

Abstract: Active test-time adaptation (ATTA) improves robustness under distribution shift by updating a deployed model during inference while selectively querying supervision. However, most existing ATTA methods implicitly assume that supervision can be requested for every incoming test batch, which can incur substantial annotation cost over long test streams. In this work, we introduce \emph{budgeted ATTA} in which labels are available for only a fraction of test batches. This formulation shifts the central challenge from deciding \emph{what} to label within a batch to deciding \emph{when} supervision should be applied over time. To address this challenge, we propose a budget-aware approach \emph{WISE-ATTA} that allocates supervision over the test stream based on lightweight signals computed online, prioritizing periods where supervision is likely to be most useful. When a batch is selected for supervision, we further employ a drift-based sample selection criterion that targets samples exhibiting ongoing, unconverged adaptation dynamics, enabling effective updates from a single labeled example. We evaluate this approach on synthetic corruptions (ImageNet-C) and natural distribution shifts (ImageNet-R/K/A). Across settings, WISE-ATTA achieves competitive or improved performance compared to recent ATTA methods while requiring substantially fewer labels. Overall, we find that the timing of supervision is a key, yet underexplored, aspect of active test-time adaptation. Code: https://github.com/Muhammad-Huzaifaa/WISE-ATTA

</details>


### [533] [AdviSD: Learning to Advise Frontier LLMs via Targeted Multi-Turn Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38142)
*Rishabh Agrawal,Hejie Cui,Shasha Li,Shanchan Wu,Sercan Ö. Arık*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 AdviSD 方法：通过选择性自蒸馏，仅对能显著改变执行结果的建议进行监督，从而提升小模型顾问指导冻结大模型执行者的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小模型顾问可从任务奖励及交互反馈中学习以改进建议，但并非所有"看似合理的纠正"都会真正改变执行行为；此类无效纠正若被同等学习，会限制模型在其他语境下的学习效果。作者从理论上证明这一现象，并寻求更优的反馈利用方式。

Method: AdviSD 将结果导向的强化学习与自蒸馏结合：由反思机制提出纠正建议；顾问对同一记录的执行者响应分别在有/无该建议条件下打分，用两者差异幅度来筛选值得监督的决策；选择性从"反馈条件化的顾问副本"中蒸馏。该方法无需执行者似然或额外 rollout。

Result: 在 Qwen3-8B 顾问分别为 Gemini 与 Claude 执行的实验中，AdviSD 在 BFCL-v3 上较 advisor-GRPO 高出 4.2–6.4 个百分点，在 EnvScaler 上高出 3.9–5.1 分。训练后的顾问可泛化到域外任务，并跨执行者版本与模型家族迁移；同时优于等量随机选择，验证了其选择规则的有效性。

Conclusion: 选择性利用反馈（仅监督能显著改变执行的纠正）优于全量学习，AdviSD 能有效提升小顾问引导冻结执行者的表现并具备良好泛化与迁移能力。

Abstract: A small trainable advisor can steer a frozen language-model executor using natural-language advice. In addition to learning from task rewards, the advisor can use feedback from completed interactions to improve its advice. However, a plausible correction need not change execution, yet learning from such corrections can still affect the advisor's future decisions in other contexts. In a shared-parameter model, we prove that such corrections can limit learning if their targets favor useful advice less strongly than those of other corrections. Keeping them less often than the rest improves the model's eventual performance compared to learning from every correction. Motivated by this, our method, Advisor Self-Distillation (AdviSD), pairs outcome-based reinforcement learning with self-distillation from a feedback-conditioned copy of the advisor selectively. Reflection proposes corrections, and the advisor scores the same recorded executor response with and without its issued advice, using the magnitude of the difference to select decisions for supervision. This approach does not require executor likelihoods or additional executor rollouts. Experiments with Qwen3-8B advisors for Gemini and Claude show that AdviSD outperforms advisor-GRPO by 4.2-6.4 percentage points on BFCL-v3 and by 3.9-5.1 score points on EnvScaler. The trained advisors generalize to out-of-domain tasks and transfer across different executor versions and model families. AdviSD also beats matched-count random selection, supporting the value of its selection rule.

</details>


### [534] [Locating Answer-Correctness Signals in Frozen Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37700)
*Yuansen Liu,Yixuan Tang,Anthony Kum Hoe Tung*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了语言模型内部信号对答案正确性的可读性，系统比较隐状态、token概率、残差流特征、注意力及其融合在闭卷与检索增强（含上下文）设置下的预测能力，发现正确性集中于答案跨度的答案token，且不同信号家族互补，融合在分布外最有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有探针通常固定单一信号家族或某一层，在分布偏移下脆弱；在检索增强场景中，许多专用检测器针对段落忠实度，而当检索证据无用或冲突时，忠实度与正确性可能背离。因此需要回答：答案正确性在哪里可读、哪些内部信号家族承载它、如何组合它们。

Method: 将所选读数视为预测性测量而非机制定位，搜索隐状态、token概率、残差流特征、注意力及其融合；在闭卷与含上下文两种设置下分别进行分析，因为上下文会改变哪些读数具有信息量。

Result: 出现一致的结构：正确性集中于答案跨度，即使在检索条件下也能从答案token中恢复；各信号家族互补地承载正确性，融合在分布外收益最大，此时单一信号最弱。

Conclusion: 该协议在两个骨干模型上均有效，并可用于门控检索控制器作为下游用途。

Abstract: Language models expose internal signals that predict whether an answer is correct, readable from a single forward pass of a frozen model without additional generations. Yet existing probes often commit to one signal family or layer and can be brittle under distribution shift; in retrieval-augmented settings, many specialized detectors instead target passage faithfulness, which can diverge from correctness when retrieved evidence is unhelpful or conflicting. We therefore ask where answer correctness is readable, which internal signal families carry it, and how they should be combined. We search over hidden states, token probabilities, residual-stream features, attention, and their fusion, treating the selected readouts as a predictive measurement rather than a mechanistic localization. We run this analysis separately in closed-book and with-context settings, since context can change which readouts are informative. A consistent anatomy emerges: correctness concentrates in the answer span, recovered from the answer tokens even under retrieval, and the families carry it complementarily, so fusing them helps most out of distribution, where a single signal is weakest. The protocol is effective across two backbones and gates a retrieval controller as one downstream use.

</details>


### [535] [Learning Meta-Skills for Agent Harness Design in Test-Time AI4AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38143)
*Cheng Qian,Kunlun Zhu,Beibin Li,Zhenhailong Wang,Heng Ji*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文研究测试时AI-for-AI：在模型权重冻结条件下，让Builder学习为Target构建更优执行环境，并提出可复用的"Meta-Skill"经验形式，实现跨任务环境构建增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agent表现同时取决于推理能力与所处执行环境；已有工作多聚焦提升模型自身能力，而如何让模型在测试时学习"为他人构建更好环境"、并让该经验可复用，仍缺乏系统研究。

Method: 提出Meta-Skill，即以"何时需要支持、应提供何种资源"为内容的元技能原则；Builder在开发集上依据Target的执行反馈学习这些原则，形成冻结的技能库，再用该库为未见任务构建harness，双方模型权重均保持不变。

Result: 在Harness-Bench与NewtonBench上，完整技能库的元技能相比无技能构建使宏平均性能提升8.95个百分点，相比将同一技能库直接交给Target提升12.02个百分点；同一模型同时担任两角色时仍有增益。

Conclusion: 将经验转化为可执行的支持（环境构建）具有明确价值，且同模型双角色的增益提示了通过学习"构建更好环境"实现系统级自我改进的路径。

Abstract: Agent performance depends on both reasoning ability and the environment in which it acts. We study test-time AI-for-AI, asking how a Builder can learn to construct better execution environments for a Target while both models' weights remain fixed. To make the Builder's experience reusable, we introduce Meta-Skill: principles specifying when support is needed and what resources to provide. The Builder learns these principles from Target's execution feedback on the development set, then uses the frozen skill bank to construct harnesses for unseen tasks. Across Harness-Bench and NewtonBench, full-bank meta-skills improve macro-average performance by 8.95 percentage points over no-skill construction, and 12.02 points over direct delivery of the same bank to the Target. These results highlight the value of translating experience into executable support. Gains when the same model serves both roles further suggest a path to system level self-improvement through learning to build better environments.

</details>


### [536] [Generative Interactions: Weaving Multiparty Human Motion with Bilevel Latent Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37708)
*Ojas Shirekar,Yash Surange,Agustinas Jučas,Chirag Raman*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出BRAID，一种用于多人社交交互生成的分层序列隐变量模型，将社交运动生成建模为元迁移学习问题，通过组级与个体级隐状态实现统一表示，并在预测、跟踪、补全和响应生成任务上验证其优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有社交运动模型侧重生成看似合理的轨迹，却将交互状态隐含化，导致难以跨群体、跨任务及部分观测场景迁移。人类社交行为本质是群体动态与个体差异相互塑造的联合过程，需要显式建模交互状态才能提升泛化能力。

Method: 提出BRAID（Bilevel Representations for Agent Interaction Dynamics），一种分层序列隐变量模型。采用元迁移学习框架：跨数据集学习共享交互先验，并通过任意上下文集合（观测到的人和关节）进行适配。模型用组级隐状态捕捉共享交互动态，用个体级隐状态在演化的群体情境下捕捉个体行为。基于统一的SMPL表示进行建模。

Result: 在社交预测、跟踪与补全、响应生成三类任务上评估，指标涵盖重建精度、真实感、多样性、时间对齐与人际协调；结果显示BRAID在完全、稀疏及部分观测下均能实现连贯生成。对分层隐空间的分析表明，其可分离出组级与个体级结构。

Conclusion: BRAID通过显式的分层隐状态将社交交互状态显式化，可作为下游具身智能体系统的社交状态接口，并具备跨群体、跨任务与部分观测的迁移能力。

Abstract: Human social behaviour is not a collection of independent motions, but a jointly organised process in which group dynamics and individual variation continuously shape one another. Yet existing social motion models often prioritise plausible trajectories while leaving interaction state implicit, limiting their ability to transfer across groups, tasks, and partial-observation regimes. To address this gap, we introduce Bilevel Representations for Agent Interaction Dynamics (BRAID), a hierarchical sequential latent-variable model for generative multi-person interaction. BRAID explicitly formulates social motion generation as a meta-transfer learning problem: shared interaction priors are learned across datasets and adapted through arbitrary context sets of observed people and joints. The model represents each scene through a group-level latent state that captures shared interaction dynamics and person-level latent states that capture individual behaviour conditioned on the evolving group context. This modelling choice enables coherent generation under full, sparse, or partial observations while exposing compact social-state vectors that can serve as an interface for downstream embodied-agent systems. We evaluate BRAID under a unified SMPL-based representation on social forecasting, tracking and in-filling, and response generation, using metrics that assess not only reconstruction accuracy but also realism, diversity, temporal alignment, and interpersonal coordination. We further analyse the hierarchical latent space, showing that it captures separable group- and individual-level structure.

</details>


### [537] [Spatiotemporal Hyperedges for EEG Seizure Detection and Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37730)
*Hyunju Kim,Sheo Yon Jhin,Noseong Park,Nabil Imam*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 HyBrain，用少量软超边替代逐时刻成对边建模 EEG 时空耦合，单一 Mamba 编码器统一支持窗口检测、逐秒点检测与发作前预测，在 TUSZ 和 CHB-MIT 上全部设定取得最优 AUROC。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 癫痫发作罕见、时间局部化、并跨多通道协同传播，检测与预测临床重要但困难。现有动态图神经网络以逐时刻成对通道边序列加时序模型来建模，不仅训练开销大，还忽略了构成发作的时空耦合本质。

Method: HyBrain 通过少量软超边而非成对边汇总时空 EEG 证据：逐通道 Mamba 主干为每个 (通道, 秒) 生成一个 token，时空超边块借助软隶属度将这些 token 池化为 E_h 个共享组嵌入，再广播回各 token。同一编码器服务窗口检测、一秒点检测和发作前预测三项任务。

Result: 在 TUSZ 与 CHB-MIT 上，HyBrain 在全部报告设定中相对十个基线均取得最佳 AUROC，在长片段发作前预测上优势最大；训练时间与峰值 GPU 显存也与最高效的基线相当。定性分析显示，单个学习到的超边即可在真实发作片段上清晰刻画 preictal→ictal→postictal 轨迹。

Conclusion: 以软超边建模时空耦合、结合 Mamba 逐通道分词，可在精度与效率上同时超越动态图方法，并具备可解释性，为 EEG 癫痫检测与预测提供一个统一且高效的框架。

Abstract: Seizure detection and prediction from EEG are clinically important but challenging because seizures are rare, temporally localized, and propagate as coordinated events across multiple channels. Recent dynamic graph neural networks model this by running a temporal model over a sequence of per-time-step pairwise channel edges. However, this pairwise construction misses the spatiotemporal coupling that constitutes a seizure, at substantial training cost. We propose HyBrain, which summarizes spatiotemporal EEG evidence through a small set of soft hyperedges rather than pairwise edges. A per-channel Mamba backbone produces one token per (channel, second), and a spatiotemporal hyperedge block pools these tokens into E_h shared group embeddings through soft memberships and broadcasts them back. The same encoder serves three downstream tasks: window-based detection, one-second point-wise detection, and preictal seizure prediction. On TUSZ and CHB-MIT, HyBrain achieves the best AUROC on every reported setting against ten baselines, with the largest gap on long-clip preictal prediction. It also matches the most efficient baselines in training time and peak GPU memory. A qualitative analysis shows that even a single learned hyperedge cleanly captures the preictal -> ictal -> postictal trajectory on a real seizure clip.

</details>


### [538] [ContextRender: From Execution Dependencies to Agent Context](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37743)
*Savini Kashmira,Jayanaka L. Dantanarayana,Lingjia Tang,Jason Mars*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 ContextRender：基于执行依赖图管理 LLM 智能体上下文，利用 Tool-Flow Analysis 追踪工具结果的“观测复用”信号，与时间新近性和语义相关性结合，在 6K 预算下选择保留的工具结果，性能接近或超过全历史输入，同时降低推理成本 10.2%–32.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程任务的智能体累积大量工具结果，后续步骤可能仍需使用。传递完整历史即使未超出上下文窗口也很昂贵，而压缩历史又可能丢失必要信息。现有上下文管理方法忽视早期工具结果在后续执行中的实际使用方式，导致关键信息被排除在上下文之外。

Method: ContextRender 通过持久化的执行依赖图管理上下文。设计 Tool-Flow Analysis 追踪后续操作如何复用早期工具结果的信息，得到“观测复用”（observed reuse）信号。渲染器将该信号与新近性、语义相关性结合，在固定历史预算内选择工具结果，并保留被省略的结果以供后续使用。

Result: 在 AppWorld 与 8-objective QA 上，使用三种执行模型，ContextRender 在 6K 历史预算（远低于模型最大上下文窗口）下优于所评估的上下文管理基线。在该预算内，任务性能接近或超过传入完整历史的方法，且相对于 Full history 平均降低推理成本 10.2%–32.2%。消融实验表明，观测复用提升了任务性能以及对后续被复用结果的保留能力。

Conclusion: ContextRender 证明以执行依赖与工具结果复用为核心的上下文管理，能在显著小于模型上下文窗口的预算下维持甚至提升长时程任务表现，并降低推理成本；观测复用是关键有效信号。

Abstract: LLM agents performing long-horizon tasks accumulate tool results that later steps may need. Passing the full history to every invocation is costly even when it fits within the context window, while reducing it risks omitting needed information. Existing context management methods can overlook how earlier tool results are used in subsequent execution, leaving needed information out of context. We introduce ContextRender, which manages context through a persistent graph of execution dependencies. We develop Tool-Flow Analysis to track how later operations reuse information from earlier tool results, providing a signal called observed reuse. A renderer combines this signal with recency and semantic relevance to select results within a fixed history budget, retaining omitted results for later use. Across AppWorld and 8-objective QA with three execution models, ContextRender outperforms the evaluated context management baselines using a 6K history budget, well below the models' maximum context windows. Within this budget, it achieves task performance close to or above that of passing the full history while reducing mean inference cost by 10.2%-32.2% relative to Full history. Ablations show that observed reuse improves task performance and retention of results reused later.

</details>


### [539] [Cross-Entropy Guided Routing in Mixture-of-Experts Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37751)
*Yury Nahshan,Nati Daniel,Jacob Goldberger,Yoli Shavit*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文为稀疏MoE大语言模型提出“token-error监督”路由机制，通过将路由亲和度与token级误差对齐来改进专家路由，在多个基准上提升准确率且不改变稀疏执行预算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有稀疏MoE的路由器仅依赖负载均衡项和语言建模目标学习亲和度分数，缺乏路由亲和度与token级误差之间的直接对齐，导致路由决策与模型实际错误不匹配。

Method: 提出两种token-error监督形式：(1)预测每个专家的误差分数，其亲和度加权聚合对齐下一token交叉熵损失，个体分数在top-K选择前衰减亲和度；(2)直接将路由器亲和度对齐模型目标，无需额外头或推理时修改。两种形式均采用Itakura-Saito散度或指数负对数似然来对齐亲和度与token误差。

Result: 在两个稀疏MoE骨干和四个多项选择问答基准上评估：在Granite上平均提升约2.3个百分点（相对参数匹配的路由基线）；更强监督下ARC-Challenge提升达2.94个百分点。两种机制均保持原生稀疏执行预算与聚合策略。

Conclusion: 将路由亲和度与token级误差直接对齐可有效提升稀疏MoE的性能，且不增加推理开销或改变稀疏执行策略，为MoE路由监督提供了新方向。

Abstract: Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) large language models scale model capacity by routing each token to a small subset of experts. Their routers are regularized with load balancing terms and learn affinity scores through the language-model objective. However, these objectives do not provide direct alignment between routing affinities and token-level error. We introduce token-error supervision for sparse routing in two forms. The first form predicts an error score per expert. The affinity-weighted aggregate of these scores is aligned to the next-token cross-entropy loss, while the individual scores attenuate affinity before top-$K$ selection. The second directly aligns the router's affinities to the model's objective without requiring an additional head or inference-time modification. Both formulations use the Itakura--Saito divergence or an exponential negative log-likelihood for aligning affinities and token errors. Across two sparse MoE backbones and four multiple-choice question-answering benchmarks, we evaluate both supervision mechanisms. On Granite, our method improves accuracy by approximately 2.3 percentage points on average over a parameter-matched routing baseline. With stronger supervision, the gain on ARC-Challenge reaches 2.94 points. Both mechanisms preserve the native sparse execution budget and aggregation policy. Our code is available in the supplementary materials.

</details>


### [540] [OmniVCBench: Benchmarking Evidence-Grounded Multimodal Reasoning Towards AI Virtual Cells](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37773)
*Manyu Li,Xunkai Li,Yongfu Xiong,Yi Liu,Rong-Hua Li,Guoren Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出OmniVCBench——一个以图表为中心、可溯源的科学基准，用于评估AI虚拟细胞（AIVC）的"解释层"能力，并配套提出AIVC-Judge评判框架与MDHNM困难负样本挖掘策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AIVC基准主要停留在"模拟层"，缺乏对模型如何解释实验证据、提出生物学假设的解释层能力的评估，因此需要互补性的评测基准。

Method: 构建含6,077个单/多子图问答对的图表中心基准，依据Bloom分类学将AIVC的Predict–Explain–Discover议程映射为三个科学推理任务；提出任务条件化的MLLM-as-a-judge框架AIVC-Judge，含类别特定、参考感知的评分量表；并提出MDHNM策略，将模型推理中出现的合理错误转化为MCQ干扰项以实现低成本评测。

Result: 在异构模型池中，MCQ准确率与AIVC-Judge得分呈正相关，两者可提供互补的性能视角。

Conclusion: OmniVCBench与AIVC-Judge为AIVC解释层提供了可溯源、可评判的评测方案，MCQ与开放回答评测相互补充。

Abstract: Artificial Intelligence Virtual Cells (AIVCs) are envisioned as scientific agents that simulate cellular responses, explain underlying mechanisms, and support hypothesis-driven discovery. Existing AIVC benchmarks, however, operate primarily at the simulation layer, motivating complementary evaluation of how models interpret experimental evidence and formulate biological hypotheses. We introduce OmniVCBench, a figure-centric, source-traceable benchmark for the interpretation component of an AIVC. It contains 6,077 curated single- and multi-subfigure question--answer pairs derived from figures and experimental contexts in the scientific literature. Guided by Bloom's taxonomy, we instantiate interpretation-layer counterparts of the AIVC Predict--Explain--Discover agenda through three scientific reasoning tasks. We further introduce AIVC-Judge, a task-conditioned MLLM-as-a-judge framework with category-specific, reference-aware rubrics for evaluating open-ended responses. A complementary Model-Derived Hard-Negative Mining (MDHNM) strategy converts plausible errors observed during model inference into MCQ distractors for lower-cost evaluation. Within the evaluated heterogeneous model pool, MCQ accuracy correlates positively with AIVC-Judge scores, providing a complementary view of performance alongside open-response evaluation. Code and data demo are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/OmniVCBench.

</details>


### [541] [Adam under Generalized Smoothness with Second-Moment-Type Stochastic Gradients](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37787)
*Ruinan Jin,Difei Cheng,Ling Chen,Jun Luo,Hao Zhou,Youzhi Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文证明Adam在广义光滑条件下、仅需随机梯度二阶矩信息（无需几乎必然有界或次高斯等尾部假设）即可收敛，给出高概率收敛速率及紧性下界，并在p<1时给出期望收敛保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Adam在实践中即使目标严重偏离全局光滑性也保持稳定，但在广义光滑框架下，已有分析依赖随机梯度的强尾部假设（如几乎必然有界或次高斯）。Li等(2023)提出开放问题：在仅有随机梯度二阶矩信息、无集中性假设时，Adam能否在广义光滑目标上收敛。本文旨在肯定回答该问题。

Method: 基于Jin等(2026)为经典光滑与有界方差建立的Adam自归一化框架，将停时与去预条件（de-preconditioning）策略拓展至L0-Lp广义光滑条件和广义二阶矩ABC条件，控制随机轨迹并分析其尾部衰减。

Result: 即使随机梯度条件仅提供可能沿轨迹增长的二阶矩信息，Adam轨迹仍保持局部良态光滑区域，并在有界方差和全局光滑下呈现拉伸指数尾部衰减；由此建立p<2全范围内高概率收敛速率，置信度依赖为δ^{-1/2}，步长前置因子仅通过对数因子依赖δ；构造困难实例表明该δ^{-1/2}型依赖在仅有二阶矩信息下是紧的；在p<1时结合轨迹控制与稀有事件多项式增长估计得到期望收敛速率。

Conclusion: 尾部集中假设对Adam的收敛性并非必要：在广义光滑与广义二阶矩条件下，Adam可实现高概率收敛，其置信度依赖δ^{-1/2}为最优，并在p<1情形获得期望意义上的收敛保证。

Abstract: Adam is widely observed to remain stable even when the objective deviates significantly from global smoothness. Under the generalized smoothness framework, however, existing analyses rely on strong tail assumptions on the stochastic gradients, such as almost-sure boundedness or sub-Gaussianity. Whether Adam converges on generalized smooth objectives under only second moment information on the stochastic gradients, without such concentration assumptions, was identified as an important open direction by Li et al. (2023). This paper gives an affirmative answer under fairly general conditions: such tail assumptions are not necessary. Building on the Adam self-normalization framework of Jin et al. (2026), developed for classical smoothness and bounded variance, we extend the stopping-time and de-preconditioning strategy to the $L_0$-$L_p$ generalized smoothness condition and a generalized second moment ABC condition. Even when the stochastic-gradient condition provides only second moment information that may grow along the trajectory, the stochastic trajectory of Adam remains in a locally well-behaved smoothness region, with stretched-exponential tail decay under bounded variance and global smoothness. Consequently, we establish high-probability convergence rate guarantees over the full range $p<2$, with confidence dependence of order $δ^{-1/2}$, while the stepsize prefactor depends on $δ$ only through a single logarithmic factor. We further construct a hard instance showing that, under only second-moment information, this $δ^{-1/2}$-type confidence dependence is sharp. Finally, in the regime $p<1$, we combine the trajectory control with polynomial-growth estimates on rare events to obtain convergence rate guarantees in expectation.

</details>


### [542] [A neural network that maintains and retrieves memories based on context](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37791)
*Hayoung Song,JeongJun Park,Qihong Lu,Giacomo Vedovati,Monica D. Rosenberg,Zachariah M. Reagh,ShiNung Ching*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究构建了带情节记忆缓冲的循环神经网络，用贝叶斯推断持续推断情境，并以低秩方式调制工作记忆（循环连接）、以自注意力键值系统调制情节记忆提取，使模型的活动模式与fMRI下人类观看自然电影时的脑响应最为吻合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 情境（前额叶皮层信号）已知可调制工作记忆与情节记忆，但其算法层面的机制仍不清楚。作者希望在自然情境中刻画情境如何调制信息维持与长期记忆提取的计算机制。

Method: 训练一个增强情节记忆缓冲的RNN，在观看自然主义电影时通过贝叶斯推断持续推断情境并预测即将出现的场景。情境以低秩方式调制RNN的循环连接（工作记忆基础）；同时情境调制情节记忆提取，通过带自注意力的键值系统编码情境，从而实现基于内容相似性与情境相似性的记忆检索。

Result: 当情境以低秩方式调制循环连接时，模型活动模式与观看相同电影的人类fMRI神经响应最匹配。引入情境调制后，模型不仅能更好拟合人脑表征，而且其记忆提取方式更接近人类，且学习速度显著快于无情境调制的模型。

Conclusion: 研究提出了一个计算机制：情境通过低秩调制循环连接影响信息维持，并通过情境一致性检索影响长期记忆提取，从而在自然环境中统一解释情境对工作记忆与情节记忆的调制。

Abstract: Every day, people continuously infer situational context and adjust the way they understand and remember the world. Context, signaled by the prefrontal cortex, is known to modulate working memory and episodic memory, but the algorithmic understanding of this modulation remains limited. Here, we train a recurrent neural network (RNN), augmented with an episodic memory buffer, to infer context using Bayesian inference as it continuously makes predictions of upcoming scenes while watching naturalistic movies. When the inferred context modulates the RNN's recurrent connectivity (the basis of working memory) in a low-rank manner, the model's activity patterns best match neural responses in human participants who watched the same movies during fMRI. Context also modulates episodic memory retrieval, such that the model retrieves memories based on not only content similarity but also context similarity. This is implemented as a key-value system with self-attention, designed to additionally encode context and retrieve context-congruent memories. The resulting model not only better resembles human brain representations but also learns to retrieve memories like humans much faster than a model without context modulation. Together, our findings suggest a computational mechanism by which context modulates information maintenance and long-term memory retrieval in naturalistic environments.

</details>


### [543] [DIET: Deletion-response Expert Trimming for Video Diffusion Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37829)
*Jiachang Zhang,Teng Hu,Bohao Feng,Songhang Shen,Wenqiang Wang,Hongqian Deng,Ran Yi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出免训练专家剪枝框架DIET，基于删除响应签名与ODL准则，在视频DiT-MoE上剪掉50%专家（6144→3072），显存57GB降至30GB，VBench总分反升0.7941→0.8115。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频扩散Transformer（DiT）广泛采用MoE架构以降低激活计算量，但全部专家的存储开销依然高昂。现有的一次性剪枝准则主要依赖静态激活或路由统计，无法刻画专家删除后层级的重路由（re-routing）变化，因此剪枝效果受限；本文旨在引入能反映删除后果的剪枝依据。

Method: DIET为免训练专家剪枝框架，核心为"删除响应"：一次全专家校准前向记录条件与无条件token下各专家输出及路由器状态；候选删除通过缓存张量重放完成，无需额外模型前向。由删除引起的输出变化构成"删除响应签名"，用以刻画每个专家。保留专家选择采用最小化整体多样性损失（ODL），在签名空间中保持方向覆盖度；专家预算分配结合层内局部搜索与层间回归引导搜索。

Result: 在LingBot-Video 30B-A3B上剪除50%专家（6,144→3,072），检查点由57 GB降至30 GB，无需微调即可在48 GB单卡部署。固定284例VBench协议下，VBench Total由0.7941提升至0.8115。在各测试保留预算下，DIET均优于由大语言模型迁移适配的竞争性剪枝基线。

Conclusion: 基于删除响应的免训练剪枝可有效压缩视频DiT-MoE的专家存储与部署成本，且不损失甚至提升生成质量；其优势在于捕捉层间重路由效应，优于静态统计类准则。

Abstract: Video diffusion transformers (DiTs) increasingly adopt mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures to reduce active computation, but their full expert storage remains costly. Existing one-shot pruning criteria mainly rely on static activation or routing statistics and cannot capture layer-level re-routing after expert deletion. We introduce DIET, a training-free expert pruning framework based on deletion responses. A single all-expert calibration pass records expert outputs and router states for matched conditional and unconditional tokens. Candidate deletions are then replayed from cached tensors, requiring no additional model forward passes. The resulting deletion-response signatures characterize each expert by the changes induced when it is removed. DIET selects retained experts by minimizing Overall Diversity Loss (ODL), which preserves directional coverage in signature space, and combines intra-layer local search with an inter-layer regression-guided budget search to allocate experts across layers. On LingBot-Video 30B-A3B, pruning 50% of experts (6,144 to 3,072) reduces the checkpoint from 57 GB to 30 GB and enables single-card deployment on a 48 GB GPU without fine-tuning. Under a fixed 284-case VBench protocol, the VBench Total increases from 0.7941 to 0.8115. Across tested retention budgets, DIET consistently outperforms competitive pruning baselines adapted from large language models.

</details>


### [544] [Mixture of Self-Improving Branches For Agent Harness Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37834)
*Haoyu Dong,Yuhang Zhou,Zihao Lin,Yifan Wu,Bo Peng,Mingyi Wang,Xiangjun Fan,Lizhu Zhang,Zhuokai Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文将 harness 优化中的搜索过程本身变为自适应：通过将搜索组织为多个分支，每个分支使用演化的开发子集和提案策略，从而获得互补的 harness，并用路由器在推理前为新输入选择分支头部。在数学推理与智能体编程基准上相对 Meta-Harness 分别提升 34.8%、11.6% 和 3.8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有 RSI 式 harness 优化方法（如 Meta-Harness）采用迭代代码生成与评估，但保持固定的开发集与提案策略，使演化沿单一搜索轨迹进行，易收敛到局部最优。作者希望让改进过程本身具备自适应性，以避免这一局限并产生互补的 harness。

Method: 将搜索组织为多个分支，每个分支拥有演化的开发子集与提案策略；分支保留被其更多领先 harness 解决、而其他分支领先 harness 较少解决的开发案例，丢弃被所有分支所有领先 harness 都解决的案例，并利用自身搜索历史修订提案策略。部署时使用路由器为每个新输入在执行前选择一个由开发集选出的分支头部。

Result: 在数学推理与智能体编程基准上，相对 Meta-Harness 取得 34.8%（Olympiad 级数学推理）、11.6%（Terminal-Bench 2.0）和 3.8%（SWE-bench Lite）的相对提升；harness 选择与路由器配置仅基于开发数据。

Conclusion: 演化分支目标与提案策略可产生互补的 harness，路由器无需访问测试结果即可组合其优势，表明让改进过程自适应是提升 RSI 式 harness 优化的有效途径。

Abstract: Harness optimization provides a practical setting for recursive self-improvement (RSI), where agent-generated modifications inform subsequent changes through execution feedback. Recent work such as Meta-Harness implements this process through iterative code generation and evaluation, but retains a fixed development set and proposal policy. These constraints channel evolution along a single search trajectory, increasing the risk of converging to a local optimum. We make the improvement process itself adaptive by organizing search into branches with evolving development subsets and proposal policies. Each branch retains development cases solved by more of its leading harnesses than by those of other branches, drops cases solved by every leading harness across all branches, and revises its proposal policy using its own search history. To deploy the resulting complementary harnesses, we propose a router to select one development-selected branch head for each new input before execution. Across mathematical reasoning and agentic coding benchmarks, our system achieves relative improvements over Meta-Harness of 34.8% on Olympiad-level mathematical reasoning, 11.6% on Terminal-Bench 2.0, and 3.8% on SWE-bench Lite, with harness selection and router configuration based solely on development data. These results show that evolving branch objectives and proposal policies can yield complementary harnesses whose strengths a router combines without access to test outcomes.

</details>


### [545] [Active Budget Can Kill Sensitivity: Diagnosing and Repairing TopK Sparse Autoencoder Reliability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37857)
*Zhenting Huang,Junnan Liu,Qianren Mao,Zhixing Tan,Bo Jiang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究TopK稀疏自编码器中特征在语义变化下的稳定性问题，发现扩宽字典主要降低稀有特征的稳定性，其根因在于TopK选择边界（激活预算k）的几何特性，并提出成对秩稳定化方法加以改善。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SAE被不断扩宽以从大语言模型激活中恢复细粒度结构，但一个特征只有在同一语义以不同表层形式出现时仍保持为稳定分析单元，才具有可解释价值。因此需要回答：扩宽字典是否真正提升了特征在语义变化下的可靠性。

Method: 作者通过特征敏感性实验考察TopK SAE的可靠性，并设计宽度×k的受控因子实验区分字典宽度与激活预算k的作用；进一步从TopK选择几何出发，提出"激活边际"（到截断点的距离）作为无需阈值的特征丢失预测指标，并据此提出成对秩稳定化（pairwise rank stabilization）方法，针对截断处的排序失效进行修正。

Result: 实验表明，扩宽仅选择性地降低稀有特征的敏感性，而常见特征相对稳定；宽度×k因子实验确认激活预算k是根本原因，退化源于选择边界而非字典宽度本身。激活边际可在无阈值条件下预测特征丢失。成对秩稳定化使稀有特征敏感性提升8.83个百分点，同时重建质量与存活特征覆盖率保持在基线附近。

Conclusion: 宽TopK SAE的评估不应仅限于重建、稀疏性和特征数量，还应纳入语义变化下的特征可靠性以及边界几何，才能实现稳定可解释性。

Abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are increasingly scaled to wider dictionaries to recover fine-grained structure from large language model activations. However, a feature is useful for interpretation only if it remains a stable unit of analysis when the same meaning is expressed in different surface forms. We study this reliability question for TopK SAEs via feature sensitivity. Experiments demonstrate that scaling selectively reduces the sensitivity of rare features, while common features remain comparatively stable. A controlled width\(\times k\) factorial experiment identifies the active budget k as the root cause: the degradation arises from the selection boundary rather than dictionary width alone. We attribute this failure to the geometry of TopK selection. The active margin, the distance to the cutoff, predicts feature loss without thresholds. Guided by this margin diagnosis, we introduce pairwise rank stabilization. Our method targets ordering failures at the cutoff and improves rare-feature sensitivity by \(8.83\) percentage points, while keeping reconstruction and alive-feature coverage near the baseline. Overall, our results suggest that wide TopK SAEs should be evaluated not only by reconstruction, sparsity, and feature count, but also by feature reliability under semantic variation and boundary geometry for stable interpretability.

</details>


### [546] [Co-PiLOT: Constrained Physics-Informed Latent Optimization for Target-Driven Inverse Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37875)
*Mahish K. Guru,Mayank Nagar,Ayush vyas,Jan Bohlen,Roland Aydin,Noomane Ben Khalifa*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Co-PiLOT 潜在空间逆设计框架，用于镁合金微观组织/织构的逆向设计，结合视觉Transformer编码器、扩散类解码器与物理启发的黑箱优化器 MERIDIAN，在160次仿真预算内取得最优目标驱动性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理系统（分子、器件、微结构）的逆向设计本质上是对高维结构针对昂贵黑箱仿真器的优化问题。直接搜索面临三大困难：结构空间为非欧氏空间、可行性难以编码、单次评估代价高昂，因此需要一种能够降维并高效搜索的方法。

Method: 提出 Co-PiLOT 潜在优化方法：通过生成式编码器-解码器映射候选结构，将解码器作为学得的有效性先验，并在潜在空间中用物理启发的黑箱优化进行搜索。针对镁合金微观组织/织构逆设计，构建基于视觉Transformer（ViT）的编码器，并搭配潜在扩散、扩散Transformer和整流流Transformer解码器，在约80,000个EBSD衍生的微观组织数据集上学习最小瓶颈表示 z。其中 ViT-FMDiT 模型（z=768）重建高保真微观组织图像。自分割取向编解码器将图像转换为晶体塑性求解器所需的输入网格。进一步提出 MERIDIAN 主动潜在优化器，由深度核高斯过程不确定性、失败感知可行性预测、流形感知信赖域和目标感知采集函数驱动。

Result: ViT-FMDiT 模型实现高保真重建，FID为27.86，MS-SSIM为0.178。在160次仿真预算内，ViT-FMDiT 与 MERIDIAN 的组合取得最佳的目标驱动目标分数，在相同解码器下相对目标误差比七个基线（DANTE、TuRBO、BAxUS、CMA-ES、DDOM、SEIKO、DDPO）降低3%–22%。

Conclusion: 实验表明，将生成式潜在表示与物理启发的主动潜在优化相结合，可在有限仿真预算下有效完成高维非欧氏、昂贵黑箱的微观组织逆设计任务，且性能优于多种现有基线方法。

Abstract: Inverse design of physical systems (molecules, devices, microstructures) often reduces to optimizing a high-dimensional structure against an expensive black-box simulator. Direct search is difficult because the space is non-Euclidean, feasibility is hard to encode, and each evaluation is expensive. We present Co-PiLOT, a latent optimization approach that maps candidates through a generative encoder-decoder, uses the decoder as a learned validity prior, and searches the latent space with physics-informed black-box optimization. The framework is applied on the inverse design of magnesium alloy microstructure/texture. We develop a vision transformer based-encoder; paired with latent diffusion, diffusion transformer and rectified-flow transformer-based decoders on $\sim80{,}000$ EBSD-derived microstructure dataset to learn a minimal bottleneck, $z$. The ViT-FMDiT model ($z$=$768$) reconstructs high-fidelity microstructure images (FID $27.86$, MS-SSIM $0.178$), which our self-segmenting orientation codec converts into input grids for crystal plasticity solver. Finally, we introduce MERIDIAN, an active latent optimizer driven by deep-kernel Gaussian-process uncertainty, failure-aware feasibility prediction, manifold-aware trust regions, and target-aware acquisition. Within a budget of $160$ simulations, the ViT-FMDiT and MERIDIAN combination yields the best target-driven objective score, reducing the relative target error by $3$--$22\%$ against seven baselines (DANTE, TuRBO, BAxUS, CMA-ES, DDOM, SEIKO, DDPO) on the same decoder.

</details>


### [547] [Guide, Then Let Go: Gap-Adaptive Teacher Scheduling for Sparse-Reward Agentic RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37898)
*Youling Huang,Tiankuo Xu,Jiaji Liu,Tong Zheng,Shuo Zhou,Shaotong Qi,Junchi Yao,Shiyang Liu,Hao Xu,Pengcheng Xu,Bo Huang,Hongyi Fu,Lin Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出GATS方法，通过自适应调整on-policy蒸馏权重来缓解长视野强化学习的冷启动问题，在多个基准上超过纯奖励GRPO。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长视野智能体强化学习依赖稀疏的结果奖励，早期策略常无法完成任务，导致奖励信号匮乏，产生严重的冷启动问题。

Method: 使用on-policy distillation（OPD）在学生自身rollout上提供token级指导。观察到指导收益取决于师生性能差距：差距大时有帮助，差距缩小甚至反转后继续蒸馏反而有害。据此提出Gap-Adaptive Teacher Scheduling（GATS），在学生的RL目标中加入OPD项，其权重随师生性能差距自适应调整，学生接近教师参考性能时逐步减少指导，达到参考性能后完全撤除，从而可使用比学生更小的任务训练教师。

Result: 在ALFWorld、WebShop和ScienceWorld上，使用三种Qwen2.5师生配置，GATS在所有配置中平均成功率最高，在相同学生rollout预算下比纯奖励GRPO提升4.37%-11.87%。

Conclusion: 自适应调度教师指导可有效缓解冷启动并避免后期负迁移，是一种通用且高效的长视野智能体强化学习方案。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning for long-horizon agents typically relies on sparse outcome-based rewards. This leads to a severe cold-start problem, as early-stage policies often fail to solve sampled tasks, leaving little useful reward signal for learning. To mitigate this problem, we use on-policy distillation (OPD) to provide token-level guidance on the student's own rollouts. We find that the benefit of this guidance depends on the performance gap between the teacher and the student. When the teacher substantially outperforms the student, distillation helps guide the student through the early training stage where outcome rewards provide little learning signal. As the gap narrows and eventually reverses, however, continued distillation becomes less beneficial and may hinder further improvement. Motivated by this observation, we propose Gap-Adaptive Teacher Scheduling (GATS), which augments the student's RL objective with an OPD term whose weight adapts to the teacher-student performance gap. Specifically, GATS gradually reduces teacher guidance as the student approaches the teacher's reference performance and withdraws it once that reference is reached. This enables GATS to leverage task-trained teachers smaller than the student, since teacher guidance is primarily needed during early training. Across ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld with three Qwen2.5 teacher-student configurations, GATS achieves the highest average success rate among the compared methods in all three configurations, improving over reward-only GRPO by 4.37%-11.87% under matched student rollout budgets. Code is available at https://github.com/Ricardo-H/guide-then-let-go.

</details>


### [548] [You Cannot Pick a Provider From the Price List: Market-Aware Routing for Open-Weight LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37902)
*Liang He,Jingbo Wen,Yixiong Chen,Yue Yang,Qizhen Lan,Kangning Cui,Xilu Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 现有LLM路由器仅按静态单价选模型，忽视了"同一模型由谁提供服务"这一维度。跨多家提供商实测显示，同模型在不同提供商间质量、延迟、可用性、价格差异显著，且无法从价目表推断。作者将同模型提供商选择形式化为价格接受者的市场感知路由问题，并提出在线路由器FACET，按(提供商×任务)认证可行域，未认证前回退到锚点。实测表明该策略可在保证质量的前提下节省成本并避开退化端点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM路由研究把每个模型的成本视为静态的，只在"选哪个模型"上做决策，忽略了开放权重推理市场中"选哪个提供商来服务该模型"这一独立的决策轴。由于同一模型可由多个竞争性提供商托管，而各端点在质量、延迟、可用性、价格上表现不一，仅凭价目表无法预判实际服务水平，因此需要一套市场感知的路由方法来捕捉这一被忽视的维度。

Method: 在[nummodels]个开放模型、多家竞争提供商、多种任务类型和三轮测量波次上实测在线端点，考察同模型跨提供商在质量、延迟、可用性、价格上的差异及任务选择性。将同模型提供商选择形式化为价格接受者（price-taker）的市场感知路由问题，提出基于实测地图的简单策略：路由到既质量等价又健康的最便宜提供商。针对地图漂移，进一步提出在线路由器FACET，按(提供商×任务)认证可行性facet，并在服务未认证臂之前安全回退到锚点。

Result: 实测发现：同模型跨提供商在质量、延迟、可用性、价格上差异显著；高价提供商一贯更快，但价格无法可靠预测质量或可用性；提供商可行性具有任务选择性，某部署在知识类任务上近乎正常，但在多步推理上严重退化。简单实测地图策略可实现同质量下的成本节省并避开退化端点。FACET在放宽部署假设下能容忍不完美的任务分配与稀疏反馈，且当存在系统性评估器偏差时暴露出质量信号的可信边界，可通过真实标注探针或审计缓解。线下真实提供商运行进一步确认，认证可将真实流量从高价锚点迁移到显著更便宜的已认证端点。

Conclusion: 市场感知的LLM路由不仅需要测量"用哪个模型"，还必须测量"由谁提供服务"；提供商维度的质量、延迟、可用性和任务可行性差异不可由价目表推断，必须通过实测与在线认证来处理。

Abstract: Existing LLM routers choose among models using static per-model costs. We show that open-weight inference markets introduce a second, largely ignored decision axis: after choosing a model, a client must still choose which provider serves it. Measuring live endpoints across [nummodels] open models, competing providers, multiple task types, and three measurement waves, we find that provider choice cannot be inferred from the price list. The same model can vary sharply in quality, latency, availability, and price across providers; higher-priced providers are consistently faster, but price does not reliably predict quality or availability; and provider feasibility is task-selective, with one deployment nearly normal on knowledge tasks but catastrophically degraded on multi-step reasoning. We formulate same-model provider selection as a price-taker market-aware routing problem.
